literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 当使用 1 μL 病毒 RNA 时,检测限范围从寨卡病毒每个反应 2 基因组 当量到 DENV-3 每个反应 92 基因组 当量。在盲法临床样本中,该床旁检测设备与基于实验室的 RT-PCR 检测结果显示出 90% 的总体一致性。 [10.1021/acs.analchem.5c08263]

经历过 DENV 的个体具有显着更高的 ZIKV 特异性 ADCC 反应峰值(几何平均滴度 [GMT] 15,104 vs 1,819;P 80 天,AUC 953,694 vs 182,004;P=0.0037)。ZIKV ADCC 峰值强度与 DENV 或 ZIKV 抗体中和滴度峰值不相关,并且 ZIKV ADCC 峰值时的 ZIKV 中和效率在组间没有差异。然而,在经历过 DENV 的个体中,归一化为 ZIKV IgG 的 ZIKV ADCC 显着较高(GMT 2,230 vs 735.6;P=0.0107)。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag429]
DF 患者的 IFNγ ELISpot 对 CD4+ 和 CD8+ 肽库的反应从第一个时间点到第二个时间点均显着增加。在 DHF 患者中,与 DF 相比,CD27 和 CD127 显着下调,而 CD8+ T 细胞中 ICOS 表达较高。肥胖个体的 CD8+CD45RA-T 细胞中 CLA 表达最高,并且显着高于瘦个体 (p=0.01)。 [10.1093/cei/uxag049]
纳入的研究中,登革热患者的男女比例约为1:1,其中30-39岁年龄段的病例比例最高。主要血清型是 DENV-1,其次是 DENV-2。主要临床体征和症状包括发烧、乏力和头痛。感染 DENV-1 或 DENV-3 的患者与特定的临床表型相关。 [10.3389/fcimb.2026.1920586]
登革病毒 和其他相关黄病毒,例如 SARS-CoV-2 和 ZIKV,已显示出有希望的溶瘤潜力。这些病毒具有特定的肿瘤趋向性、免疫逃避策略和免疫原性细胞死亡机制,可用于下一代治疗平台。该综述强调了了解这些机制对于改善治疗结果的重要性。 [10.1002/rmv.70167]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The detection limits ranged from 2 genome equivalents per reaction for Zika virus to 92 genome equivalents per reaction for DENV-3 when 1 μL of viral RNA was used. Across blinded clinical specimens, the point-of-care device showed 90% overall agreement with lab-based RT-PCR assays. [10.1021/acs.analchem.5c08263]

DENV-experienced individuals had significantly higher peak ZIKV-specific ADCC responses (geometric mean titers [GMT] 15,104 vs 1,819; P 80 days, AUC 953,694 vs 182,004; P=0.0037). [10.1093/infdis/jiag429]

IFNγ ELISpot responses to both CD4+ and CD8+ peptide pools significantly increased from the first to the second time point in DF patients. In DHF patients, CD27 and CD127 were significantly downregulated compared to DF, while ICOS expression was higher in CD8+ T cells. [10.1093/cei/uxag049]

Among included studies, the male-to-female ratio of dengue patients was approximately 1:1, with the highest proportion of cases in the 30–39 age group. The predominant serotype was DENV-1, followed by DENV-2. Major clinical signs and symptoms included fever, asthenia, and headache. [10.3389/fcimb.2026.1920586]
Children with obesity had 1.89-fold higher DENV binding antibodies (95% CI 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies compared to normal-weight children. [10.64898/2026.08.14.26360483]

news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 发布了《2026 年国家登革热审查》,确定了加强斯里兰卡登革热防备和应对工作的优先事项。这是世界卫生组织的官方声明。 [news-70dcf8ae10c66886]
SPC和WHO报告的多国登革热暴发;截至 2026 年 8 月 14 日,多个 PIC 中正在进行 传播。 [news-3dcd9d05f677581e]
一项 2a 期随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验评估了 抗病毒药物 mosnodenvir 预防登革热的作用;结果显示 DENV-3 RNA 水平和登革热相关症状呈剂量依赖性降低,支持潜在的预防性使用。德宾等人报道。在新英格兰医学杂志上。 [news-133e1ae2dd15c890]
夏威夷卫生部报告了另一起与旅行相关的 登革病毒 病例,证实该地区存在 登革病毒。 [news-8267b8b08db4df9c]
卫生部报告了夏威夷 2026 年第 7 例与旅行相关的 登革热 病例。卫生部的官方声明证实了这一点。 [news-68fb374cc4a9a5ee]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: The World Health Organization (WHO) released a National Dengue Review 2026 that identifies priorities to strengthen Sri Lanka's dengue preparedness and response. This is an official statement from the WHO. [news-70dcf8ae10c66886]
Multicountry dengue outbreaks reported by SPC and WHO; ongoing transmission in several PICs as of 14 August 2026. [news-3dcd9d05f677581e]

A phase 2a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluated the investigational antiviral mosnodenvir for dengue prophylaxis; results showed dose-dependent reductions in DENV-3 RNA levels and dengue-related symptoms, supporting potential prophylactic use. Reported by Durbin et al. [news-133e1ae2dd15c890]
The Hawaiʻi Department of Health reported another travel-related dengue virus case, confirming the presence of dengue virus in the region. [news-8267b8b08db4df9c]
The DOH reported Hawaii's 7th travel-related case of dengue fever in 2026. This is confirmed by the official statement from the DOH. [news-68fb374cc4a9a5ee]

papers.title: Detection and structural characterization of bat-associated dengue virus serotype 2: A country-level first detection in Pakistan
papers.abstract: Bats (order Chiroptera) are recognized as reservoirs for diverse zoonotic viruses, including members of the Flavivirus genus. Despite global reports of bat-associated Dengue Virus (DENV), its presence in Pakistan has remained undocumented. This study investigates DENV circulation in bat populations across Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Lahore, Mardan, Swat, and Lower Dir. Fecal samples were screened using CprM-specific primers, yielding 14 amplified viral isolates (BatDENV01-BatDENV14). Phylogenetic analysis confirmed all sequences as Dengue Virus serotype 2 (DENV-2), clustering with bat-associated isolates from Costa Rica (KY461760-KY461769), mosquito-derived (KY461759), and human-derived strains (AY692466, AY692469), and suggests a potential cross-species viral link. Comparative amino acid analysis revealed several substitutions in the CprM region, some of which were unique to the Pakistani bat isolates. These substitutions may reflect host-specific adaptation or regional viral evolution. Secondary structure prediction using SOPMA and PSIPRED indicated conserved α-helices and β-strands, while tertiary modeling via Robetta and visualization in PyMol showed structural homology with reference DENV-2 proteins, and minor modifications were observed. This study provides the first molecular and structural evidence of DENV-2 circulation in Pakistani bats, suggesting a possible ecological link between bat, mosquito, and human transmission cycles. These findings underscore the need for expanded molecular surveillance and structural characterization of bat-associated Flaviviruses to better understand their zoonotic potential and inform public health strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the circulation of Dengue Virus (DENV) in bat populations across Pakistan, addressing the gap in knowledge about the presence of DENV in this region. Bats are recognized as reservoirs for diverse zoonotic viruses, including members of the Flavivirus genus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Lahore, Mardan, Swat, and Lower Dir, focusing on bat populations. Fecal samples were collected and screened using CprM-specific primers, resulting in the identification of 14 amplified viral isolates (BatDENV01-BatDENV14).
analysis.methods: The study employed molecular screening using CprM-specific primers to detect DENV in fecal samples. Phylogenetic analysis and comparative amino acid analysis were used to classify and compare the sequences, while secondary structure prediction and tertiary modeling were conducted using SOPMA, PSIPRED, Robetta, and PyMol.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic analysis confirmed all sequences as Dengue Virus serotype 2 (DENV-2), clustering with bat-associated, mosquito-derived, and human-derived strains. Comparative amino acid analysis revealed several substitutions in the CprM region, some of which were unique to the Pakistani bat isolates.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest a potential cross-species viral link and highlight the structural homology of the Pakistani bat isolates with reference DENV-2 proteins, indicating possible ecological interactions between bat, mosquito, and human transmission cycles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide critical molecular and structural evidence of DENV-2 circulation in Pakistani bats, which may inform public health strategies by highlighting the need for expanded molecular surveillance and understanding of zoonotic viral potential.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on fecal samples and the absence of direct host interaction data. However, the molecular and structural evidence is robust, supporting a high confidence assessment in the identification of DENV-2 in bat populations.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first molecular and structural evidence of Dengue Virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) in bat populations across Pakistan, highlighting its potential ecological link with mosquito and human transmission cycles. The research aimed to address the lack of documentation on DENV presence in the region, employing fecal sample screening with CprM-specific primers and phylogenetic analysis. The results showed that all isolates were classified as DENV-2, with unique amino acid substitutions in the CprM region. Structural analysis using SOPMA, PSIPRED, Robetta, and PyMol revealed homology with reference DENV-2 proteins. These findings underscore the importance of expanded molecular surveillance of bat-associated Flaviviruses to better understand their zoonotic potential and inform public health strategies. The evidence is strong, but the study's reliance on fecal samples and lack of direct host interaction data limit its generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 登革病毒 (DENV) 在巴基斯坦各地蝙蝠种群中的传播情况,弥补对该地区 DENV 存在的了解空白。蝙蝠被认为是多种人畜共患病毒的 储存宿主,其中包括黄病毒属的成员。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在伊斯兰堡/拉瓦尔品第、拉合尔、马尔丹、斯瓦特和下第尔进行,重点关注蝙蝠种群。收集粪便样本并使用 CprM 特异性引物进行筛选,鉴定出 14 种扩增病毒分离株 (BatDENV01-BatDENV14)。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用 CprM 特异性引物进行分子筛选来检测粪便样本中的 DENV。使用系统发育分析和比较氨基酸分析对序列进行分类和比较,同时使用SOPMA、PSIPRED、Robetta和PyMol进行二级结构预测和三级建模。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析证实所有序列均为 登革病毒 血清型 2 (DENV-2),与蝙蝠相关、蚊子来源和人类来源的菌株聚类。比较氨基酸分析揭示了 CprM 区域的多个取代,其中一些是巴基斯坦蝙蝠分离株所独有的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明存在潜在的跨物种病毒联系,并强调了巴基斯坦蝙蝠分离株与参考 DENV-2 蛋白的结构同源性,表明蝙蝠、蚊子和人类 传播 循环之间可能存在生态相互作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了 DENV-2 在巴基斯坦蝙蝠中循环的关键分子和结构证据,这可能通过强调扩展分子 监测 的需要和了解人畜共患病毒潜力来为公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖粪便样本且缺乏直接的 宿主 相互作用数据而受到限制。然而,分子和结构证据是强有力的,支持在蝙蝠种群中鉴定 DENV-2 的高置信度评估。

papers.title: Multiplexed RT-LAMP Assays in Handheld Devices for In-Situ Detection of Chikungunya, Dengue, Mayaro, and Zika Viruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne viruses pose a significant global health challenge, particularly in resource-limited settings where multiple viruses often cause illnesses with similar symptoms that require different treatment. We introduce the first 7-plex reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification (RT-LAMP) assay in a hand-held device capable of detecting the presence of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus serotypes (DENV 1-4), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Zika virus (ZIKV) in a single test. If the result is positive from the single-plex device for the 7-plex assay, 3-plex and 4-plex devices are then used to identify the exact virus within a specimen. In-situ detection is achieved by integrating valve-enabled, paper-based sample preparation with fluorescence detection using a blue LED flashlight as a light source and a yellow plastic film as a filter, allowing visual discrimination between positive and negative samples by the naked eye or by recording images using a smart phone. The detection limits ranged from 2 genome equivalents (GE)/reaction (for ZIKV) to 92 GE/reaction (for DENV-3) across 7 types of viruses when 1 μL of viral RNA was used. We observed 90% overall agreement between the point-of-care (POC) device and lab-based reverse transcription polymerase chain reactions (RT-PCR) when blinded clinical specimens were tested. This assay and device have a potential to address critical surveillance gaps in endemic regions, enabling timely detection of multiple mosquito-borne viruses to guide appropriate clinical management and public health countermeasures in settings where laboratory resources are scarce.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 蚊媒病毒是全球主要的健康负担,特别是在资源有限的环境中,重叠的临床表现使 诊断 和 治疗 变得复杂。该研究解决了对快速、多重检测工具的需求,以区分流行地区的登革热和其他虫媒病毒。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究引入了集成到手持设备中的 7 重 RT-LAMP 检测,用于在一次测试中检测基孔肯雅病毒、登革病毒 血清型 1-4、Mayaro 病毒和寨卡病毒。该检测采用纸质样品制备,通过蓝色 LED 手电筒进行荧光检测,并通过智能手机成像进行视觉辨别。
elements_zh.methods: 原位检测是通过将支持阀门的纸质样品制备与使用蓝色 LED 手电筒和黄色塑料过滤器的荧光检测相结合来进行的,从而能够通过视觉或智能手机记录区分阳性和阴性样品。7 重设备的阳性结果会触发使用 3 重或 4 重设备进行后续测试,以识别特定病毒。
elements_zh.main_results: 当使用 1 μL 病毒 RNA 时,检测限范围从寨卡病毒每个反应 2 基因组 当量到 DENV-3 每个反应 92 基因组 当量。在盲法临床样本中,该床旁检测设备与基于实验室的 RT-PCR 检测结果显示出 90% 的总体一致性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了多重手持式 RT-LAMP 检测快速原位检测多种蚊媒病毒(包括登革热血清型)的可行性。新颖之处在于第一个集成到便携式设备中的 7 重 RT-LAMP 检测,无需专门设备即可进行视觉辨别。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该检测可以通过及时检测登革热和相关虫媒病毒来解决流行地区的关键 监测 差距,以指导资源有限环境中的临床管理和公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究报告与 RT-PCR 的一致性为 90%,但没有提供详细的临床敏感性或特异性指标,这限制了诊断性能的信心。由于缺乏全面的验证数据和样本选择的潜在偏差,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Severe Dengue and Dengue–Malaria Coinfection: A Case Series from a Referral Hospital in Montería, Colombia
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Severe dengue and dengue–malaria coinfection represent major diagnostic and therapeutic challenges in tropical endemic settings, where overlapping clinical manifestations may delay recognition of deterioration. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究在转诊医院中检查了 重症登革热、有警告信号的登革热以及登革热-疟疾合并感染,重点关注登革热流行地区的临床和流行病学特征以及诊断挑战。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 回顾性病例系列回顾了 2018 年至 2023 年登革热患者的医疗记录,排除了那些没有警告信号的患者,并使用 WHO 2009 标准对病例进行了分类,并通过厚血涂片确认疟疾;收集社会人口统计学、临床、实验室、地理和结果变量,并使用费舍尔精确检验进行描述性分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在53名患者中,重症登革热(47.17%)在女性和儿童中占主导地位,而有预警症状和合并感染的登革热在男性中更为常见,并且分布在儿童和青少年时期;重症登革热 中水肿、血细胞比容升高、严重血浆渗漏和血流动力学损害更为常见,所有患者均出现发热。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究没有对疟原虫种类的合并感染结果进行分层,也没有评估长期后遗症,而且样本量小限制了普遍性;高 死亡率(10 例死亡,6 例合并感染患者)强调了合并感染管理中诊断和治疗的不确定性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先考虑流行环境中登革热-疟疾双重感染的差异诊断算法,评估物种特异性疟原虫对登革热严重程度的影响,并针对高危人群(患有 重症登革热 的儿童和双重感染的青少年)实施有针对性的 监测,以减少识别延迟并改善结果。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究在转诊医院中检查了 重症登革热、有警告信号的登革热以及登革热-疟疾合并感染,重点关注登革热流行地区的临床和流行病学特征以及诊断挑战。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 回顾性病例系列回顾了 2018 年至 2023 年登革热患者的医疗记录,排除了那些没有警告信号的患者,并使用 WHO 2009 标准对病例进行了分类,并通过厚血涂片确认疟疾;收集社会人口统计学、临床、实验室、地理和结果变量,并使用费舍尔精确检验进行描述性分析。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在53名患者中,重症登革热(47.17%)在女性和儿童中占主导地位,而有预警症状和合并感染的登革热在男性中更为常见,并且分布在儿童和青少年时期;重症登革热 中水肿、血细胞比容升高、严重血浆渗漏和血流动力学损害更为常见,所有患者均出现发热。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究没有对疟原虫种类的合并感染结果进行分层,也没有评估长期后遗症,而且样本量小限制了普遍性;高 死亡率(10 例死亡,6 例合并感染患者)强调了合并感染管理中诊断和治疗的不确定性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先考虑流行环境中登革热-疟疾双重感染的差异诊断算法,评估物种特异性疟原虫对登革热严重程度的影响,并针对高危人群(患有 重症登革热 的儿童和双重感染的青少年)实施有针对性的 监测,以减少识别延迟并改善结果。

papers.title: Bulk transcriptomics of peripheral blood mononuclear cells delineates systems-level immune dysregulation in pediatric dengue infection
papers.abstract: Children are disproportionately at a greater risk of developing severe dengue disease, yet the molecular mechanisms driving the heightened susceptibility remains poorly understood. To elucidate the immune determinants of pediatric dengue pathogenesis, we profiled the transcriptomic landscape by performing RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from laboratory-confirmed cases of primary and secondary pediatric dengue, as well as pediatric healthy controls. Differential gene expression (DEG) and pathway analyses were performed to delineate the transcriptional alterations. Pediatric dengue was marked by extensive transcriptional changes with altered expression of genes associated with the complement cascade macrophage-associated genes as well as immune checkpoint molecules. Notably, secondary infection had significant alterations in immune checkpoint molecules and genes associated with macrophage activation, suggesting the onset of immune exhaustion during reinfection. Differences between the primary and secondary dengue cohorts were modest relative to the transcriptional differences observed between either of the groups and healthy controls, with immune checkpoint genes showing the most consistent divergence between the two dengue cohorts. While our initial findings provide early insights into the transcriptional patterns potentially associated with disease outcomes, the dysregulated transcriptomic signatures reported here are preliminary requiring systemic functional validation to determine their biologic role in the immunopathogenesis of pediatric dengue infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Children are disproportionately at greater risk of severe dengue disease, yet the molecular mechanisms driving this heightened susceptibility remain poorly understood, motivating a systems-level investigation of immune dysregulation in pediatric dengue infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: To elucidate immune determinants of pediatric dengue pathogenesis, RNA sequencing was performed on peripheral blood mononuclear cells from laboratory-confirmed primary and secondary pediatric dengue cases and pediatric healthy controls.
analysis.methods: Differential gene expression and pathway analyses were conducted to delineate transcriptional alterations associated with pediatric dengue infection.
analysis.main_results: Pediatric dengue was marked by extensive transcriptional changes with altered expression of genes linked to the complement cascade, macrophage-associated genes, and immune checkpoint molecules, while differences between primary and secondary infection cohorts were modest.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Secondary infection showed significant alterations in immune checkpoint molecules and macrophage activation genes, suggesting immune exhaustion during reinfection, with immune checkpoint genes showing the most consistent divergence between dengue cohorts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight dysregulated transcriptomic signatures that may inform future studies on immune mechanisms in pediatric dengue and potential targets for diagnostic or therapeutic development.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The dysregulated transcriptomic signatures are preliminary and require systemic functional validation to determine their biological role in pediatric dengue immunopathogenesis, indicating a moderate strength of evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study used RNA sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells to profile transcriptional changes in pediatric dengue infection, comparing primary and secondary cases with healthy controls. Extensive gene expression alterations were observed, including dysregulation in the complement cascade, macrophage-associated genes, and immune checkpoint molecules. Differences between primary and secondary infections were modest, but secondary infections showed significant alterations in immune checkpoint and macrophage activation genes, suggesting immune exhaustion during reinfection. The authors note that these transcriptomic signatures are preliminary and require functional validation to clarify their biological role in disease pathogenesis.

papers.source_body_en: Children are disproportionately at a greater risk of developing severe dengue disease, yet the molecular mechanisms driving the heightened susceptibility remains poorly understood. To elucidate the immune determinants of pediatric dengue pathogenesis, we profiled the transcriptomic landscape by performing RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from laboratory-confirmed cases of primary and secondary pediatric dengue, as well as pediatric healthy controls. Differential gene expression (DEG) and pathway analyses were performed to delineate the transcriptional alterations. Pediatric dengue was marked by extensive transcriptional changes with altered expression of genes associated with the complement cascade macrophage-associated genes as well as immune checkpoint molecules. Notably, secondary infection had significant alterations in immune checkpoint molecules and genes associated with macrophage activation, suggesting the onset of immune exhaustion during reinfection. Differences between the primary and secondary dengue cohorts were modest relative to the transcriptional differences observed between either of the groups and healthy controls, with immune checkpoint genes showing the most consistent divergence between the two dengue cohorts. While our initial findings provide early insights into the transcriptional patterns potentially associated with disease outcomes, the dysregulated transcriptomic signatures reported here are preliminary requiring systemic functional validation to determine their biologic role in the immunopathogenesis of pediatric dengue infection.

papers.title: Dengue Fever in Patients with Hematological Malignancies and Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation Recipients: Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a hyperendemic arboviral infection with a broad clinical spectrum, ranging from self-limited illness to severe disease with shock and multiorgan dysfunction. Immunosuppressed individuals, particularly patients with hematological malignancies and those who have undergone hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT), may be at increased risk for severe manifestations. However, data regarding dengue infection in this population remain limited, especially in endemic settings. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective, single-center observational study including adult patients with hematological malignancies who were diagnosed with laboratory-confirmed dengue virus infection between February and July 2024. Patients were stratified according to prior HCT status (HCT vs non-HCT). Dengue severity was classified according to Brazilian Ministry of Health criteria. Clinical characteristics, laboratory findings, outcomes, and 30-day overall survival were analyzed. Logistic regression models were used to identify factors associated with dengue warning signs. RESULTS: A total of 53 patients were included, of whom 17 (32%) had previously undergone HCT (71% autologous and 29% allogeneic). Age and sex distribution were similar between groups, while underlying hematological diagnoses differed, with multiple myeloma predominating in the HCT group and lymphoma in the non-HCT group (p=0.04). Dengue warning signs were significantly more frequent among HCT recipients (71% vs. 22%, p<0.001), as was grade C dengue (65% vs. Hypotension requiring vasopressor support occurred exclusively in the HCT group (18% vs. Severe thrombocytopenia at diagnosis (platelet count <20,000/μL) was more common in HCT patients (47% vs. In multivariate analysis, male sex (OR 71.11, 95% CI 2.72-1856.76), prior HCT (OR 40.60, 95% CI 2.13-775.62), and platelet count <20,000/μL (OR 17.15, 95% CI 1.47-199.53) were independently associated with dengue warning signs. Thirty-day overall survival was lower in the HCT group (88% vs. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue infection in patients with hematological malignancies, particularly those with prior hematopoietic cell transplantation, is associated with increased disease severity, higher rates of warning signs, and worse short-term outcomes. Heightened clinical suspicion, early diagnostic testing, and close monitoring are essential to improve outcomes in this high-risk population in dengue-endemic regions.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue is a hyperendemic arboviral infection with a broad clinical spectrum, ranging from self-limited illness to severe disease with shock and multiorgan dysfunction. Immunosuppressed individuals, particularly patients with hematological malignancies and those who have undergone hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT), may be at increased risk for severe manifestations. However, data regarding dengue infection in this population remain limited, especially in endemic settings. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective, single-center observational study including adult patients with hematological malignancies who were diagnosed with laboratory-confirmed dengue virus infection between February and July 2024. Patients were stratified according to prior HCT status (HCT vs non-HCT). Dengue severity was classified according to Brazilian Ministry of Health criteria. Clinical characteristics, laboratory findings, outcomes, and 30-day overall survival were analyzed. Logistic regression models were used to identify factors associated with dengue warning signs. RESULTS: A total of 53 patients were included, of whom 17 (32%) had previously undergone HCT (71% autologous and 29% allogeneic). Age and sex distribution were similar between groups, while underlying hematological diagnoses differed, with multiple myeloma predominating in the HCT group and lymphoma in the non-HCT group (p=0.04). Dengue warning signs were significantly more frequent among HCT recipients (71% vs. 22%, p<0.001), as was grade C dengue (65% vs. Hypotension requiring vasopressor support occurred exclusively in the HCT group (18% vs. Severe thrombocytopenia at diagnosis (platelet count <20,000/μL) was more common in HCT patients (47% vs. In multivariate analysis, male sex (OR 71.11, 95% CI 2.72-1856.76), prior HCT (OR 40.60, 95% CI 2.13-775.62), and platelet count <20,000/μL (OR 17.15, 95% CI 1.47-199.53) were independently associated with dengue warning signs. Thirty-day overall survival was lower in the HCT group (88% vs. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue infection in patients with hematological malignancies, particularly those with prior hematopoietic cell transplantation, is associated with increased disease severity, higher rates of warning signs, and worse short-term outcomes. Heightened clinical suspicion, early diagnostic testing, and close monitoring are essential to improve outcomes in this high-risk population in dengue-endemic regions.

papers.title: Optimal control strategies for dengue transmission under varying adult prevalence of Wolbachia -carrying mosquitoes: a deterministic mathematical modeling study
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to develop prevalence-informed post-release dengue control strategies for settings in which Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes have become established through population replacement and to quantify how optimal supplementary intervention intensity and duration vary with adult Wolbachia prevalence, pW. METHODS: A deterministic human-mosquito model was formulated that included Wolbachia-free and Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes and incorporated cytoplasmic incompatibility, maternal transmission, and reduced vector competence. Two bounded supplementary controls were optimized over a 3-year horizon: reduction of effective human-mosquito contact and conventional adult mosquito suppression, represented by increased adult mortality. A quadratic-cost optimal-control problem was solved numerically using the Pontryagin maximum principle and a forward/backward sweep algorithm. Outcomes were compared across representative pW scenarios and prevalence scans. RESULTS: The optimal policies applied high-intensity supplementary control early in the planning horizon and then relaxed control as infection pressure declined. Higher pW reduced the uncontrolled infection burden, decreased the incremental benefit of additional intervention, and shortened the duration of maximum control. In coarse scans with umax=0.30, the terminal dengue infection near-elimination indicator, defined as IH (T)≤10-4 at T=3 years, changed between pW=0.45 and pW=0.50 for all tested cost-weight combinations. A separate refined continuation example demonstrated non-monotonic mean control use and a sharp decrease in cumulative incidence. CONCLUSION: Adult Wolbachia prevalence measured through entomological surveillance may represent an actionable index for post-release dengue management. The identified transition band is a model-based planning indicator, not a universal field threshold or evidence of mosquito population elimination.

analysis.summary_en: This modeling study addressed how to optimize supplementary dengue control strategies in settings where Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes have been established. Using a deterministic human–mosquito model, the authors formulated and numerically solved a quadratic-cost optimal-control problem to determine the intensity and duration of two bounded supplementary interventions—reducing human–mosquito contact and adult mosquito suppression—over a 3-year horizon. Optimal policies front-loaded high-intensity control and tapered it as infection pressure declined. Higher adult Wolbachia prevalence reduced uncontrolled infection burden, decreased the incremental benefit of additional intervention, and shortened the duration of maximum control. A model-based transition band between Wolbachia prevalence of 0.45 and 0.50 was identified as a planning indicator for near-elimination, though the authors caution it is not a universal threshold. The findings suggest adult Wolbachia prevalence could serve as an actionable surveillance index to guide post-release dengue management.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本研究旨在针对携带沃尔巴克氏体的埃及伊蚊已通过种群更替而定居的环境制定基于 患病率 的发布后登革热控制策略,并量化最佳补充干预强度和持续时间如何随成年沃尔巴克氏体 患病率、pW 的变化而变化。方法:制定了确定性人类蚊子模型,其中包括不含沃尔巴克氏体和携带沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子,并纳入细胞质不相容性、母体 传播 和降低的 媒介 能力。在 3 年范围内优化了两个有界补充控制措施:减少人与蚊子的有效接触和传统的成蚊抑制,以增加成蚊 死亡率 为代表。使用庞特里亚金极大值原理和前向/后向扫描算法对二次成本最优控制问题进行了数值求解。对代表性 pW 场景和 患病率 扫描的结果进行了比较。结果:最优政策是在规划初期实施高强度的补充控制,然后随着感染压力下降而放松控制。较高的 pW 减少了不受控制的感染负担,降低了额外干预的增量效益,并缩短了最大控制的持续时间。在umax = 0.30的粗略扫描中,对于所有测试的成本权重组合,终端登革热感染接近消除指标(定义为T = 3年时的IH(T)≤10-4)在pW = 0.45和pW = 0.50之间变化。一个单独的精炼延续示例演示了非单调均值控制的使用以及累积 发病率 的急剧下降。结论:通过昆虫学 监测 测量的成虫沃尔巴克氏体 监测 可能代表释放后登革热管理的可行指标。确定的过渡带是基于模型的规划指标,而不是通用的现场阈值或蚊子种群消除的证据。

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of machine learning strategies for short-term dengue forecasting in Brazilian capital municipalities.
papers.abstract: Dengue is an arboviral disease of high public health relevance, characterized by pronounced temporal variability, nonlinearity, and recurrent outbreaks, which pose challenges to epidemiological surveillance and decision-making. This study evaluated the performance of machine learning methods for short-term forecasting of the weekly dengue morbidity rate in the 27 Brazilian capital cities, comprising the 26 state capitals and Brasília, Federal District, with horizons up to 4 weeks. Epidemiological, climatic, and socioeconomic data were compiled for these capital cities and used to compare a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network, formulated as a Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) model, and a Gradient Boosting model (CatBoost), implemented using a Direct forecasting strategy with horizon-specific models. Validation was conducted using a walk-forward approach, with evaluation based on absolute error metrics and the coefficient of determination. The results indicated that the GRU architecture presented recurring limitations, including underfitting, temporal lag, and low capacity to anticipate epidemic peaks. In contrast, the CatBoost model demonstrated greater robustness and better adaptation to the variability of epidemiological time series, showing superior performance in most of the analyzed capitals. The findings reinforce that greater architectural complexity does not necessarily imply better operational performance and highlight the potential of ensemble-based methods for short-term epidemiological surveillance applications. These findings contribute to dengue forecasting by showing that, under a common validation framework, ensemble-based strategies may provide greater operational robustness than recurrent MIMO architectures for short-term prediction in heterogeneous epidemiological settings.
authors: Darllan Collins da Cunha E Silva
Pedro Cesar Madureira de Godoy Camargo
Raphael de Vicq Ferreira da Costa

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是一种与公共卫生高度相关的虫媒病毒疾病,其特点是明显的时间变异性、非线性和复发性,这对流行病学和决策提出了挑战。这项研究评估了机器学习方法对巴西 27 个首府城市(包括 26 个州首府和巴西利亚联邦区)每周登革热发病率短期预测的性能,预测期限长达 4 周。我们为这些首府城市编制了流行病学、气候和社会经济数据,并用于比较门控循环单元 (GRU) 神经网络(制定为多输入多输出 (MIMO) 模型)和梯度提升模型 (CatBoost)(使用特定水平模型的直接预测策略实现)。使用步进方法进行验证,并根据绝对误差指标和确定系数进行评估。结果表明,GRU 架构存在反复出现的局限性,包括拟合不足、时间滞后和预测流行高峰的能力较低。相比之下,CatBoost 模型表现出更强的鲁棒性和更好的适应流行病学时间序列变化的能力,在大多数分析的首都都表现出优越的性能。研究结果强调,更高的架构复杂性并不一定意味着更好的操作性能,并强调了基于集成的方法在短期流行病学 监测 应用中的潜力。这些发现有助于登革热预测,表明在通用验证框架下,基于集合的策略可以比循环 MIMO 架构提供更高的操作鲁棒性,用于异质流行病学环境中的短期预测。

analysis_zh.methods: 使用流行病学、气候和社会经济数据来训练和比较作为多输入多输出 (MIMO) 模型的门控循环单元 (GRU) 神经网络和使用特定水平模型的直接预测策略实现的梯度提升模型 (CatBoost)。
analysis_zh.main_results: GRU 模型反复出现局限性,例如欠拟合、时间滞后和预测流行病峰值的能力较差,而 CatBoost 模型则表现出更强的鲁棒性和对流行病学时间序列变化的更好适应能力。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,更高的架构复杂性并不能保证更好的性能,并表明基于集合的方法可以为不同环境下的短期登革热预测提供更高的操作稳健性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于开发更可靠的短期登革热预测工具,可以增强流行病学 监测 并支持异构环境中的公共卫生决策。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于前瞻性验证方法,该方法可能无法完全解释所有现实世界的复杂性,并且由于依赖历史数据而没有对 登革病毒 进行直接生物学测试,因此证据是温和的。

papers.title: Emerging and Re-Emerging Viral Pathogens in Oncolytic Virotherapy: A Comprehensive Review.
papers.abstract: Oncolytic virotherapy has recently emerged as a promising immuno-oncological strategy, utilising the natural cytolytic potentials of viral pathogens to selectively target and destroy malignant cells. Although various engineered viruses, such as adenoviruses, vaccinia virus, and herpes simplex virus, are currently in clinical evaluation, emerging and re-emerging viruses with intrinsic oncolytic potential, including Zika virus (ZIKV), Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), Dengue virus (DENV), and West Nile virus (WNV), have also shown promising results. These emerging and re-emerging viral pathogens show specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and immunogenic cell death mechanisms that could be harnessed for next-generation therapeutic platforms. Nonetheless, concerns related to safety, viral pathogenicity, host immune responses, and the risk of uncontrolled viral dissemination present significant translational challenges. The present review provides a comprehensive overview of novel viral candidates, including ZIKV, SARS-CoV-2, DENV, and WNV, in oncolytic virotherapy, their molecular mechanisms of tumour targeting, and current advancements in genetic engineering aimed at improving therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. Moreover, this review describes clinical perspectives, regulatory considerations, and future directions in integrating emerging virotherapeutic agents into precision oncology.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on dengue virus (DENV) and its role in oncolytic virotherapy, examining its tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and immunogenic cell death mechanisms. It also explores the potential of DENV as a therapeutic agent in the context of precision oncology.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of emerging and re-emerging viral pathogens in oncolytic virotherapy, including DENV. It discusses the molecular mechanisms of tumour targeting and current advancements in genetic engineering to enhance therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. The review does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria for included studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Dengue virus and other related flaviviruses, such as SARS-CoV-2 and ZIKV, have shown promising oncolytic potential. These viruses possess specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and mechanisms of immunogenic cell death that could be leveraged for next-generation therapeutic platforms. The review highlights the importance of understanding these mechanisms to improve therapeutic outcomes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Safety concerns, viral pathogenicity, and host immune responses remain unresolved challenges in the use of DENV for oncolytic virotherapy. The review notes that the risk of uncontrolled viral dissemination and the need for further clinical evaluation are significant barriers to translation. Additionally, there is a lack of detailed data on the long-term effects and optimal dosing of DENV-based therapies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritise the development of genetically engineered DENV variants with enhanced therapeutic efficacy and biosafety. Clinical trials are needed to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of DENV-based oncolytic virotherapy in various cancer types. Regulatory frameworks must also be established to facilitate the integration of DENV into precision oncology practices.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of dengue virus (DENV) in oncolytic virotherapy, highlighting its specific tumour tropism, immune evasion strategies, and mechanisms of immunogenic cell death. While DENV and related viruses like SARS-CoV-2 and ZIKV show promise, safety concerns, viral pathogenicity, and host immune responses present significant challenges. The review underscores the need for further research into genetic engineering of DENV to enhance therapeutic outcomes and the development of regulatory frameworks for its clinical application. These findings suggest that DENV-based therapies could be a valuable addition to precision oncology, provided that these challenges are addressed.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 登革病毒 (DENV) 及其在溶瘤病毒治疗中的作用,检查其肿瘤趋向性、免疫逃避策略和免疫原性细胞死亡机制。它还探讨了 DENV 作为精准肿瘤学背景下的治疗剂的潜力。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对溶瘤病毒疗法中新出现和重新出现的病毒病原体(包括 DENV)进行了全面分析。它讨论了肿瘤靶向的分子机制以及基因工程的最新进展,以提高治疗效果和生物安全性。该综述没有明确报告数据库、检索日期或纳入研究的资格标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 登革病毒 和其他相关黄病毒,例如 SARS-CoV-2 和 ZIKV,已显示出有希望的溶瘤潜力。这些病毒具有特定的肿瘤趋向性、免疫逃避策略和免疫原性细胞死亡机制,可用于下一代治疗平台。该综述强调了了解这些机制对于改善治疗结果的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 使用 DENV 进行溶瘤病毒治疗时,安全性问题、病毒致病性和 宿主 免疫应答 仍然是未解决的挑战。该评论指出,不受控制的病毒传播的风险和进一步临床评估的需要是转化的重大障碍。此外,缺乏有关 DENV 疗法的长期效果和最佳剂量的详细数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先开发具有增强治疗功效和生物安全性的基因工程 DENV 变体。需要临床试验来评估基于 DENV 的溶瘤病毒疗法在各种癌症类型中的安全性和有效性。还必须建立监管框架,以促进 DENV 融入精准肿瘤学实践。

papers.abstract_zh: 溶瘤病毒疗法最近成为一种有前途的免疫肿瘤学策略,利用病毒病原体的天然溶细胞潜力来选择性地靶向和破坏恶性细胞。尽管各种工程病毒,如腺病毒、牛痘病毒和单纯疱疹病毒,目前正处于临床评估阶段,但具有内在溶瘤潜力的新出现和重新出现的病毒,包括寨卡病毒(ZIKV)、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)、登革病毒(DENV)和西尼罗河病毒(WNV)也显示出有希望的结果。这些新出现和重新出现的病毒病原体表现出特定的肿瘤趋向性、免疫逃避策略和免疫原性细胞死亡机制,可用于下一代治疗平台。尽管如此,与安全性、病毒致病性、宿主 免疫应答 以及不受控制的病毒传播风险相关的担忧提出了重大的转化挑战。本综述全面概述了溶瘤病毒治疗中的新型候选病毒,包括 ZIKV、SARS-CoV-2、DENV 和 WNV、它们的肿瘤靶向分子机制,以及旨在提高治疗效果和生物安全性的基因工程的最新进展。此外,这篇综述描述了将新兴病毒治疗药物整合到精准肿瘤学中的临床观点、监管考虑因素和未来方向。

papers.title: Severity-associated changes in ICOS, CD27, CD127 and CLA expression and expansion of virus-specific T Cells in acute dengue
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Currently the role of dengue virus (DENV) specific T cell responses in disease pathogenesis and protection are not well understood, including potential differences in those who have obesity. We sought to investigate the functionality and phenotype of T cells in patients with acute dengue fever (DF) or dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF). Methods T cell function was assessed in paired samples (first sample on ≤4 days and second 5-6 since onset of illness) in patients with DF (n=50) and DHF (n=12), using 109 peptides representing CD8+ epitopes and 90 peptides targeting CD4+ T cell epitopes. Phenotypic analysis was in DF (n=21) and DHF patients (n=21), recruited between days 6–8 since onset of illness, by multicolor flow cytometry. Results The frequency of ex vivo IFNγ ELISpot responses to both the CD4+ and CD8+ peptides pools significantly increased from the first (F) to second time (S) point in patients with DF (p 50% of the T cells in 9/21 patients with DHF, with 92.7% expressing CD38. CLA expression was highest in the CD8+CD45RA- of obese individuals, which was significantly higher compared to lean individuals (p=0.01). CD27 and CD127 were both significantly downregulated in patients with DHF compared to DF, with ICOS expression being significantly higher in CD8+ T cells in DHF. Discussion Patients with DHF and obese individuals had impaired T cell functionality compared to patients with DF and lean individuals, with an expansion of activated, skin-homing CD8+ T cells exhibiting downregulation of CD27 and CD127. Our data suggest a contributory role of dysfunctional skin-homing T cells in disease pathogenesis, meriting further investigation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the insufficient understanding of dengue virus (DENV)-specific T cell responses in disease pathogenesis and protection, particularly in relation to disease severity and obesity. The authors aimed to investigate phenotypic and functional differences in T cells between patients with dengue fever (DF) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF).
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a prospective cohort study that enrolled patients with acute DF (n=50) and DHF (n=12), with paired sampling at ≤4 days and 5–6 days post-illness onset for functional assays. Phenotypic analysis was performed in a subset of DF (n=21) and DHF (n=21) patients recruited between days 6–8 post-illness onset using multicolor flow cytometry.
analysis.methods: T cell function was assessed using IFNγ ELISpot assays with 109 CD8+ and 90 CD4+ epitope peptide pools. Phenotypic markers (ICOS, CD27, CD127, CLA) were measured by flow cytometry, and comparisons were made between DF and DHF patients, as well as between obese and lean individuals.
analysis.main_results: IFNγ ELISpot responses to both CD4+ and CD8+ peptide pools significantly increased from the first to the second time point in DF patients. In DHF patients, CD27 and CD127 were significantly downregulated compared to DF, while ICOS expression was higher in CD8+ T cells. CLA expression was highest in CD8+CD45RA- T cells of obese individuals and significantly higher than in lean individuals (p=0.01).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating impaired T cell functionality in DHF and obese individuals, with an expansion of activated, skin-homing CD8+ T cells exhibiting downregulation of CD27 and CD127. They proposed a contributory role of dysfunctional skin-homing T cells in dengue pathogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that phenotypic and functional profiling of T cells could inform risk stratification and targeted immunotherapies in dengue, particularly for severe cases and obese patients. They also highlight the need for further investigation into skin-homing T cell dysfunction in disease pathogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by a small sample size, particularly for DHF (n=12), and lacked longitudinal follow-up beyond the acute phase. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential confounding by obesity and unmeasured host factors, and the generalisability is constrained by the single-centre design.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated T cell responses in acute dengue, comparing patients with dengue fever (DF) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF). Functional assays showed increased IFNγ ELISpot responses over time in DF patients, while DHF patients exhibited significant downregulation of CD27 and CD127 and higher ICOS expression in CD8+ T cells. Obese individuals had higher CLA expression in CD8+CD45RA- T cells compared to lean individuals. The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of impaired T cell functionality in DHF and obesity, suggesting a role for dysfunctional skin-homing T cells in disease pathogenesis. The study highlights potential avenues for risk stratification and immunotherapeutic targeting in dengue, though limitations include small sample size and single-centre design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了对疾病 发病机制 (DENV) 特异性 T 细胞反应和保护的认识不足,特别是与疾病严重程度和肥胖相关的问题。作者旨在研究 登革热 (DF) 和登革出血热 (DHF) 患者 T 细胞的表型和功能差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,入组了急性 DF (n=50) 和 DHF (n=12) 患者,并在发病后 ≤4 天和 5-6 天配对采样进行功能测定。使用多色流式细胞术对发病后 6-8 天期间招募的 DF (n=21) 和 DHF (n=21) 患者亚组进行表型分析。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 IFNγ ELISpot 测定法对 109 个 CD8+ 和 90 个 CD4+ 表位肽池评估 T 细胞功能。通过流式细胞术测量表型标记物(ICOS、CD27、CD127、CLA),并对 DF 和 DHF 患者以及肥胖和瘦个体之间进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: DF 患者的 IFNγ ELISpot 对 CD4+ 和 CD8+ 肽库的反应从第一个时间点到第二个时间点均显着增加。在 DHF 患者中,与 DF 相比,CD27 和 CD127 显着下调,而 CD8+ T 细胞中 ICOS 表达较高。肥胖个体的 CD8+CD45RA-T 细胞中 CLA 表达最高,并且显着高于瘦个体 (p=0.01)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明 DHF 和肥胖个体的 T 细胞功能受损,活化的皮肤归巢 CD8+ T 细胞扩增,表现出 CD27 和 CD127 的下调。他们提出功能失调的皮肤归巢 T 细胞在登革热 发病机制 中发挥了重要作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,T 细胞的表型和功能分析可以为登革热的风险分层和靶向免疫治疗提供信息,特别是对于重症病例和肥胖患者。他们还强调需要进一步研究 发病机制 疾病中的皮肤归巢 T 细胞功能障碍。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量较小的限制,特别是对于 DHF(n = 12),并且缺乏急性期之后的纵向随访。由于肥胖和未测量的 宿主 因素的潜在混杂,证据强度中等,并且普遍性受到单中心设计的限制。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 目前登革病毒(DENV)特异性T细胞应答在登革热(DF)发病机制与保护中的作用尚不明确,包括在肥胖患者中的潜在差异。我们旨在探究急性登革热(DF)或登革出血热(DHF)患者T细胞的功能性与表型特征。方法 采用109个CD8+表位肽段与90个CD4+表位肽段,对DF(n=50)和DHF(n=12)患者在发病≤4天(首次样本)与发病5-6天(第二次样本)的配对样本进行T细胞功能评估。表型分析在DF(n=21)与DHF患者(n=21)中进行,样本采集时间为发病后第6-8天,采用多色流式细胞术。结果 在DF患者中,外周血IFNγ ELISpot反应频率在CD4+与CD8+肽段池刺激下,从首次(F)到第二次(S)时间点均显著升高(p < 0.05)。在DHF患者中,CD8+ T细胞中≥50%的细胞在9/21例患者中表达CD38,且92.7%表达CD38。CLA表达在CD8+CD45RA-细胞中在肥胖个体中最高,显著高于瘦个体(p=0.01)。与DF患者相比,DHF患者的CD27与CD127均显著下调,而ICOS在DHF患者的CD8+ T细胞中表达显著升高。讨论 与DF患者和瘦个体相比,DHF患者与肥胖个体的T细胞功能受损,并伴有活化皮肤归巢CD8+ T细胞的扩增,这些细胞同时下调CD27与CD127。我们的数据提示功能失调的皮肤归巢T细胞在登革热发病机制中可能发挥促进作用,值得进一步研究。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了对疾病 发病机制 (DENV) 特异性 T 细胞反应和保护的认识不足,特别是与疾病严重程度和肥胖相关的问题。作者旨在研究 登革热 (DF) 和登革出血热 (DHF) 患者 T 细胞的表型和功能差异。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,入组了急性 DF (n=50) 和 DHF (n=12) 患者,并在发病后 ≤4 天和 5-6 天配对采样进行功能测定。使用多色流式细胞术对发病后 6-8 天期间招募的 DF (n=21) 和 DHF (n=21) 患者亚组进行表型分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 IFNγ ELISpot 测定法对 109 个 CD8+ 和 90 个 CD4+ 表位肽池评估 T 细胞功能。通过流式细胞术测量表型标记物(ICOS、CD27、CD127、CLA),并对 DF 和 DHF 患者以及肥胖和瘦个体之间进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: DF 患者的 IFNγ ELISpot 对 CD4+ 和 CD8+ 肽库的反应从第一个时间点到第二个时间点均显着增加。在 DHF 患者中,与 DF 相比,CD27 和 CD127 显着下调,而 CD8+ T 细胞中 ICOS 表达较高。肥胖个体的 CD8+CD45RA-T 细胞中 CLA 表达最高,并且显着高于瘦个体 (p=0.01)。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,T 细胞的表型和功能分析可以为登革热的风险分层和靶向免疫治疗提供信息,特别是对于重症病例和肥胖患者。他们还强调需要进一步研究 发病机制 疾病中的皮肤归巢 T 细胞功能障碍。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量较小的限制,特别是对于 DHF(n = 12),并且缺乏急性期之后的纵向随访。由于肥胖和未测量的 宿主 因素的潜在混杂,证据强度中等,并且普遍性受到单中心设计的限制。

papers.title: Prior Dengue Virus Exposure is Associated with Enhanced Zika Virus-Specific ADCC Activity in a Longitudinal Human Cohort
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Prior dengue virus (DENV) infection is common in regions affected by Zika virus (ZIKV) and may shape immune responses to subsequent ZIKV infection. Although cross-reactive neutralizing and disease-enhancing antibodies have been extensively studied, the effect of prior DENV immunity on antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) responses to ZIKV remains unclear. Methods Longitudinal serum samples were obtained and analyzed from a prospective cohort of 46 PCR-confirmed ZIKV cases enrolled at two U.S. sites between 2016-2018 (follow-up visits 6-409 days). ZIKV cases were classified as DENV-experienced (n=13) or DENV-naïve groups (n=33) based on detection of DENV neutralizing antibodies at baseline. ZIKV-specific ADCC activity was measured using a natural killer cell cytotoxicity assay. Results DENV-experienced individuals had significantly higher peak ZIKV-specific ADCC responses (geometric mean titers [GMT] 15,104 vs 1,819; P 80 days, AUC 953,694 vs 182,004; P=0.0037). Peak ZIKV ADCC magnitude did not correlate with peak DENV or ZIKV antibody neutralizing titers, and ZIKV neutralization efficiency at the time of peak ZIKV ADCC did not differ between groups. However, ZIKV ADCC normalized to ZIKV IgG was significantly higher among DENV-experienced individuals (GMT 2,230 vs 735.6; P=0.0107). Conclusions Prior DENV infection was associated with greater ZIKV-specific ADCC magnitude, despite similar ZIKV neutralization, suggesting that prior DENV exposure shapes Fc-mediated flavivirus immunity beyond neutralization. Future studies are needed to assess the clinical implications of these antibodies in immunopathology and protection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of prior dengue virus (DENV) infection on antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) responses to Zika virus (ZIKV) in a longitudinal human cohort. Serum samples from 46 PCR-confirmed ZIKV cases were analyzed, with participants classified as DENV-experienced or DENV-naïve based on baseline DENV neutralizing antibodies. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 先前的 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染在受寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 影响的地区很常见,并且可能会影响 免疫应答 后续的 ZIKV 感染。该研究旨在调查先前的 DENV 免疫对 ZIKV 抗体依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC) 反应的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自 2016 年至 2018 年间在美国两个地点登记的 46 例 PCR 确诊的 ZIKV 病例的前瞻性 队列研究 血清样本进行了一项纵向研究。根据基线时 DENV 中和抗体的检测,将参与者分为经历过 DENV 的 (n=13) 或未接触过 DENV 的 (n=33)。
elements_zh.methods: 从 2016 年至 2018 年期间在美国两个地点登记的 46 例 PCR 确诊的 ZIKV 病例的前瞻性 队列研究 中获取并分析了纵向血清样本(随访 6-409 天)。使用自然杀伤细胞的细胞毒性测定来测量 ZIKV 特异性 ADCC 活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 经历过 DENV 的个体具有显着更高的 ZIKV 特异性 ADCC 反应峰值(几何平均滴度 [GMT] 15,104 vs 1,819;P 80 天,AUC 953,694 vs 182,004;P=0.0037)。ZIKV ADCC 峰值强度与 DENV 或 ZIKV 抗体中和滴度峰值不相关,并且 ZIKV ADCC 峰值时的 ZIKV 中和效率在组间没有差异。然而,在经历过 DENV 的个体中,归一化为 ZIKV IgG 的 ZIKV ADCC 显着较高(GMT 2,230 vs 735.6;P=0.0107)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管 ZIKV 中和作用相似,但既往 DENV 感染与更大的 ZIKV 特异性 ADCC 强度相关,这表明既往 DENV 暴露使 Fc 介导的黄病毒免疫超出中和作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,先前的 DENV 暴露可能会影响 免疫应答 到 ZIKV,这可能对了解免疫病理学和针对黄病毒的保护具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到观察设计和潜在混杂因素的限制,但由于使用了纵向血清样本和明确的 队列研究,证据很充分。

papers.title_zh: 先前的 登革病毒 暴露与纵向人类 队列研究 中寨卡病毒特异性 ADCC 活性的增强有关
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Prior dengue virus (DENV) infection is common in regions affected by Zika virus (ZIKV) and may shape immune responses to subsequent ZIKV infection. Although cross-reactive neutralizing and disease-enhancing antibodies have been extensively studied, the effect of prior DENV immunity on antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) responses to ZIKV remains unclear. Methods Longitudinal serum samples were obtained and analyzed from a prospective cohort of 46 PCR-confirmed ZIKV cases enrolled at two U.S. sites between 2016-2018 (follow-up visits 6-409 days). ZIKV cases were classified as DENV-experienced (n=13) or DENV-naïve groups (n=33) based on detection of DENV neutralizing antibodies at baseline. ZIKV-specific ADCC activity was measured using a natural killer cell cytotoxicity assay. Results DENV-experienced individuals had significantly higher peak ZIKV-specific ADCC responses (geometric mean titers [GMT] 15,104 vs 1,819; P 80 days, AUC 953,694 vs 182,004; P=0.0037). Peak ZIKV ADCC magnitude did not correlate with peak DENV or ZIKV antibody neutralizing titers, and ZIKV neutralization efficiency at the time of peak ZIKV ADCC did not differ between groups. However, ZIKV ADCC normalized to ZIKV IgG was significantly higher among DENV-experienced individuals (GMT 2,230 vs 735.6; P=0.0107). Conclusions Prior DENV infection was associated with greater ZIKV-specific ADCC magnitude, despite similar ZIKV neutralization, suggesting that prior DENV exposure shapes Fc-mediated flavivirus immunity beyond neutralization. Future studies are needed to assess the clinical implications of these antibodies in immunopathology and protection.

papers.title: Development of a potential vaccine against dengue and chikungunya virus co-infection using immunoinformatics and structural evaluation
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) co-infection poses a growing challenge in regions where both arboviruses co-circulate, highlighting the need for integrated vaccine strategies. Here, we designed a multi-epitope subunit vaccine candidate targeting conserved regions of the DENV NS1 protein and the CHIKV NSP1 protein using an immunoinformatics-based approach. Conserved CTL, HTL, and B-cell epitopes were selected on the basis of antigenicity, safety-related screening, and population coverage, then assembled with immunologically appropriate linkers and an N-terminal human β-defensin-2 adjuvant. The construct displayed favourable physicochemical features and acceptable structural quality after three-dimensional modeling and validation. Docking analysis indicated stable interaction with human TLR4, which was further examined by normal-mode analysis and 100-ns all-atom molecular dynamics simulations performed in AMBER v24 with the ff19SB force field. Trajectory analyses supported conformational stability of the vaccine-TLR4 complex, and MM/GBSA calculations suggested favourable binding energetics. Codon optimization supported expression feasibility in the E. coli pET-28a(+) system. In silico immune simulation further predicted induction of both humoral and cellular immune responses, with increased antibody production and immune-memory development. These results support the proposed construct as a rational candidate for further experimental evaluation toward a vaccine strategy against DENV-CHIKV co-infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study used immunoinformatics to design a multi-epitope subunit vaccine candidate targeting conserved regions of the DENV NS1 protein and the CHIKV NSP1 protein. Conserved epitopes were selected for antigenicity, safety, and population coverage, assembled with linkers and an adjuvant, and subjected to structural modeling and molecular dynamics simulations. Docking and trajectory analyses demonstrated stable interaction with human TLR4 and favourable binding energetics. In silico immune simulations predicted robust humoral and cellular immune responses, including antibody production and immune memory. The authors propose this construct as a rational candidate for further experimental evaluation against DENV-CHIKV co-infection. However, the evidence is confined to computational and in vitro predictions without animal or human validation, limiting its current scientific and public-health significance.

papers.title: Dengue outbreaks in China during 2005-2023: a systematic analysis
papers.abstract: Objectives Dengue fever is a major global public health concern. While China has not yet established stable, local transmission of the disease, imported cases frequently lead to local dengue epidemics throughout the year. This paper aims to outline the characteristics of dengue outbreaks in China between 2005 and 2023. Methods We collected literature on dengue in China from various databases and extracted relevant data for analysis. This data included patients’ sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations, which we then summarized and compared, evaluating the relationship between dengue virus (DENV) serotypes and clinical manifestations, and analyzing the monthly and regional distribution patterns of dengue fever cases based on case data obtained from the China Public Science and Health Data Center (CPC). Results In the included studies, the ratio of male to female was approximately 1:1, The age group with the highest proportion of dengue patients is those aged 30 to 39. Their occupations were predominantly business service, and the predominant serotype of the infection was DENV-1, followed by DENV-2. The major clinical signs and symptoms in dengue patients were fever, asthenia, and headache. Patients infected with DENV-1, 3 were associated with some specific clinical phenotypes. Dengue cases typically peak between September and October each year. Although these cases are primarily concentrated in the southern regions of China, there is a noticeable trend of increasing incidence in northern areas over time. Conclusions This study offers an in-depth examination of the molecular epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and the seasonal and geographic distribution of dengue cases in China from 2005 to 2023. The findings provide valuable insights for future research on dengue epidemics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever remains a major public health concern globally, and China has not yet established stable, local transmission despite frequent imported cases leading to local epidemics throughout the year. This study was needed to characterize the epidemiology of dengue outbreaks in China from 2005 to 2023.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study systematically collected and analyzed literature on dengue in China, extracting patient sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations. Data were summarized and compared using case data from the China Public Science and Health Data Center (CPC).
analysis.methods: The authors collected literature on dengue in China from various databases and extracted relevant data including patients’ sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations. They summarized and compared these data, evaluating the relationship between DENV serotypes and clinical manifestations, and analyzing monthly and regional distribution patterns of dengue fever cases.
analysis.main_results: Among included studies, the male-to-female ratio of dengue patients was approximately 1:1, with the highest proportion of cases in the 30–39 age group. The predominant serotype was DENV-1, followed by DENV-2. Major clinical signs and symptoms included fever, asthenia, and headache. Patients infected with DENV-1 or DENV-3 were associated with specific clinical phenotypes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provides an in-depth examination of the molecular epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and seasonal and geographic distribution of dengue cases in China from 2005 to 2023, highlighting the predominance of DENV-1 and DENV-2 and their association with clinical phenotypes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer valuable insights for future research on dengue epidemics, particularly for surveillance strategies and clinical management in regions with imported cases and emerging local transmission risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on literature-derived data and aggregated case reports, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective nature of the data and lack of primary laboratory confirmation in all included studies.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic analysis examined dengue outbreaks in China from 2005 to 2023, synthesizing literature-derived data on patient demographics, serotype distribution, and clinical features. The study found a balanced male-to-female ratio among cases, with the highest burden in adults aged 30–39 years. DENV-1 was the predominant serotype, followed by DENV-2, and infections with DENV-1 or DENV-3 were associated with distinct clinical phenotypes. Dengue cases peaked between September and October, with a historical concentration in southern China and a rising incidence in northern regions. The findings underscore the need for enhanced surveillance and targeted interventions to mitigate local transmission risks driven by imported cases.

elements_zh.methods: 作者从各种数据库中收集了有关中国登革热的文献,并提取了相关数据,包括患者的社会人口学特征、血清型组成和临床表现。他们对这些数据进行了总结和比较,评估了DENV血清型与临床表现之间的关系,并分析了登革热病例的每月和区域分布模式。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究对2005年至2023年中国登革热病例的分子流行病学、临床特征以及季节和地理分布进行了深入研究,强调了DENV-1和DENV-2的优势及其与临床表型的关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来登革热流行研究提供了宝贵的见解,特别是对于有输入病例和新出现的本地 监测 风险地区的 监测 策略和临床管理。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever remains a major public health concern globally, and China has not yet established stable, local transmission despite frequent imported cases leading to local epidemics throughout the year. This study was needed to characterize the epidemiology of dengue outbreaks in China from 2005 to 2023.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study systematically collected and analyzed literature on dengue in China, extracting patient sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations. Data were summarized and compared using case data from the China Public Science and Health Data Center (CPC).
analysis_en.methods: The authors collected literature on dengue in China from various databases and extracted relevant data including patients’ sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations. They summarized and compared these data, evaluating the relationship between DENV serotypes and clinical manifestations, and analyzing monthly and regional distribution patterns of dengue fever cases.
analysis_en.main_results: Among included studies, the male-to-female ratio of dengue patients was approximately 1:1, with the highest proportion of cases in the 30–39 age group. The predominant serotype was DENV-1, followed by DENV-2. Major clinical signs and symptoms included fever, asthenia, and headache. Patients infected with DENV-1 or DENV-3 were associated with specific clinical phenotypes.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provides an in-depth examination of the molecular epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and seasonal and geographic distribution of dengue cases in China from 2005 to 2023, highlighting the predominance of DENV-1 and DENV-2 and their association with clinical phenotypes.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer valuable insights for future research on dengue epidemics, particularly for surveillance strategies and clinical management in regions with imported cases and emerging local transmission risk.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on literature-derived data and aggregated case reports, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective nature of the data and lack of primary laboratory confirmation in all included studies.

papers.title_zh: 2005-2023年中国登革热暴发:系统分析
papers.source_body_en: Objectives Dengue fever is a major global public health concern. While China has not yet established stable, local transmission of the disease, imported cases frequently lead to local dengue epidemics throughout the year. This paper aims to outline the characteristics of dengue outbreaks in China between 2005 and 2023. Methods We collected literature on dengue in China from various databases and extracted relevant data for analysis. This data included patients’ sociodemographic characteristics, serotype composition, and clinical manifestations, which we then summarized and compared, evaluating the relationship between dengue virus (DENV) serotypes and clinical manifestations, and analyzing the monthly and regional distribution patterns of dengue fever cases based on case data obtained from the China Public Science and Health Data Center (CPC). Results In the included studies, the ratio of male to female was approximately 1:1, The age group with the highest proportion of dengue patients is those aged 30 to 39. Their occupations were predominantly business service, and the predominant serotype of the infection was DENV-1, followed by DENV-2. The major clinical signs and symptoms in dengue patients were fever, asthenia, and headache. Patients infected with DENV-1, 3 were associated with some specific clinical phenotypes. Dengue cases typically peak between September and October each year. Although these cases are primarily concentrated in the southern regions of China, there is a noticeable trend of increasing incidence in northern areas over time. Conclusions This study offers an in-depth examination of the molecular epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and the seasonal and geographic distribution of dengue cases in China from 2005 to 2023. The findings provide valuable insights for future research on dengue epidemics.

papers.title: Mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction
papers.abstract: More than one billion individuals worldwide are at risk of contracting dengue. Dengue virus (DENV) is a ssRNA(+)-flavivirus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. While most infections are mild (uncomplicated dengue), severe/hemorrhagic dengue carries substantial mortality and lacks specific treatment. Severe dengue is characterized by endothelial dysfunction, which can arise during both primary and secondary infection. In the latter, antibody-dependent enhancement of infection is a well-recognized risk factor, although the mechanistic links between viral infection and endothelial barrier failure remain unclear in either setting. Beyond inflammatory injury to the endothelium, DENV and other flaviviruses can trigger endothelial trans-differentiation toward a mesenchymal, migratory phenotype, weakening cell–cell junctions and compromising vascular integrity. In this review, we discuss the mechanical component of flavivirus-induced endothelial trans-differentiation and its impact on endothelial dysfunction, highlighting prospective mechanobiological targets for therapeutic intervention.

papers.title_original: Mechanical drivers of dengue virus-induced endothelial dysfunction

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines dengue virus (DENV) infection, focusing on the mechanical drivers of endothelial dysfunction in dengue disease, particularly severe dengue, across DENV-1 to DENV-4. The central question addresses how mechanical and mechanobiological processes contribute to endothelial barrier failure during DENV infection, irrespective of primary or secondary infection contexts.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis that discusses mechanobiological mechanisms underlying DENV-induced endothelial trans-differentiation and its impact on vascular integrity. It highlights prospective mechanobiological targets for therapeutic intervention without reporting databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or included-study counts.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: DENV infection can induce endothelial trans-differentiation toward a mesenchymal, migratory phenotype, weakening cell–cell junctions and compromising vascular integrity. This process contributes to endothelial dysfunction, a hallmark of severe dengue, regardless of whether infection occurs during primary or secondary exposure.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The mechanistic links between DENV infection and endothelial barrier failure remain unclear, particularly regarding how antibody-dependent enhancement in secondary infections influences these processes. Additionally, the specific molecular pathways driving endothelial trans-differentiation and their relative contributions to vascular compromise are not fully resolved.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Prospective mechanobiological targets for therapeutic intervention should be prioritized to mitigate endothelial dysfunction in dengue. Further research is needed to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying DENV-induced endothelial trans-differentiation and its role in severe dengue pathogenesis.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the mechanical drivers of dengue virus (DENV)-induced endothelial dysfunction, a key feature of severe dengue. It highlights that DENV infection can trigger endothelial cells to adopt a mesenchymal, migratory phenotype, weakening cell–cell junctions and compromising vascular integrity. While endothelial dysfunction occurs in both primary and secondary infections, the mechanistic pathways linking DENV to barrier failure remain incompletely understood, particularly in the context of antibody-dependent enhancement. The review underscores the need for mechanobiological research to identify therapeutic targets that could prevent or reverse endothelial damage, thereby reducing the severity of dengue disease.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了 重症登革热 (DENV) 感染,重点关注登革热疾病中内皮功能障碍的机械驱动因素,特别是 DENV-1 至 DENV-4 中的 重症登革热。核心问题涉及 DENV 感染期间机械和机械生物学过程如何导致内皮屏障失效,无论原发或继发感染情况如何。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一篇叙述性综合文章,讨论了 DENV 诱导的内皮转分化的机械生物学机制及其对血管完整性的影响。它强调了治疗干预的前瞻性机械生物学目标,但没有报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准或纳入研究计数。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: DENV 感染可诱导内皮细胞向间充质迁移表型转分化,削弱细胞间连接并损害血管完整性。这一过程会导致内皮功能障碍,这是 重症登革热 的一个标志,无论感染是在初次还是二次暴露期间发生。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: DENV 感染与内皮屏障衰竭之间的机制联系仍不清楚,特别是继发感染中的 抗体依赖性增强 如何影响这些过程。此外,驱动内皮转分化的特定分子途径及其对血管损害的相对贡献尚未完全解决。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 应优先考虑治疗干预的预期机械生物学目标,以减轻登革热的内皮功能障碍。需要进一步的研究来阐明 DENV 诱导的内皮转分化的分子机制及其在 重症登革热 发病机制 中的作用。

papers.abstract_zh: 全球有超过十亿人面临感染登革热的风险。登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种由伊蚊传播的 ssRNA(+)-黄病毒。虽然大多数感染是轻微的(无并发症的登革热),但严重/出血性登革热携带大量 死亡率 且缺乏特定的 死亡率。重症登革热 的特点是内皮功能障碍,在原发和继发感染期间都可能出现。在后者中,感染的 抗体依赖性增强 是一个公认的危险因素,尽管在这两种情况下病毒感染与内皮屏障衰竭之间的机制联系仍不清楚。除了对内皮细胞造成炎症损伤外,DENV 和其他黄病毒还可以引发内皮细胞向间充质迁移表型的转分化,从而削弱细胞间的连接并损害血管完整性。在这篇综述中,我们讨论了黄病毒诱导的内皮转分化的机械成分及其对内皮功能障碍的影响,强调了治疗干预的前瞻性机械生物学目标。
papers.summary_zh: 全球有超过十亿人面临感染登革热的风险。登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种由伊蚊传播的 ssRNA(+)-黄病毒。虽然大多数感染是轻微的(无并发症的登革热),但严重/出血性登革热携带大量 死亡率 且缺乏特定的 死亡率。重症登革热 的特点是内皮功能障碍,在原发和继发感染期间都可能出现。在后者中,感染的 抗体依赖性增强 是一个公认的危险因素,尽管在这两种情况下病毒感染与内皮屏障衰竭之间的机制联系仍不清楚。除了对内皮细胞造成炎症损伤外,DENV 和其他黄病毒还可以引发内皮细胞向间充质迁移表型的转分化,从而削弱细胞间的连接并损害血管完整性。在这篇综述中,我们讨论了黄病毒诱导的内皮转分化的机械成分及其对内皮功能障碍的影响,强调了治疗干预的前瞻性机械生物学目标。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了 重症登革热 (DENV) 感染,重点关注登革热疾病中内皮功能障碍的机械驱动因素,特别是 DENV-1 至 DENV-4 中的 重症登革热。核心问题涉及 DENV 感染期间机械和机械生物学过程如何导致内皮屏障失效,无论原发或继发感染情况如何。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一篇叙述性综合文章,讨论了 DENV 诱导的内皮转分化的机械生物学机制及其对血管完整性的影响。它强调了治疗干预的前瞻性机械生物学目标,但没有报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准或纳入研究计数。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: DENV 感染可诱导内皮细胞向间充质迁移表型转分化,削弱细胞间连接并损害血管完整性。这一过程会导致内皮功能障碍,这是 重症登革热 的一个标志,无论感染是在初次还是二次暴露期间发生。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: DENV 感染与内皮屏障衰竭之间的机制联系仍不清楚,特别是继发感染中的 抗体依赖性增强 如何影响这些过程。此外,驱动内皮转分化的特定分子途径及其对血管损害的相对贡献尚未完全解决。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 应优先考虑治疗干预的预期机械生物学目标,以减轻登革热的内皮功能障碍。需要进一步的研究来阐明 DENV 诱导的内皮转分化的分子机制及其在 重症登革热 发病机制 中的作用。

papers.title: PEMBERANTASAN SARANG NYAMUK (PSN) - DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD) DI DESA BANING KOTA DAN JERORA, SINTANG (Implementation of Mosquito Nest Eradication - Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever)
papers.abstract: The Dengue Fever Eradication Movement (PSN-DBD) is a crucial activity aimed at combating the transmission of Dengue Fever (DBD). This action aims to break the chain of mosquito breeding and its transmission. A mosquito-free, clean, and healthy environment will decrease the incidence and mortality rates due to DBD. The objective of this community engagement initiative is to reduce DBD cases in Sintang Regency through collaboration and cross-sectoral efforts. The activity spans two periods and involves monitoring larval sites, providing abate, and conducting fogging under the supervision of the Tanjung Puri Sintang Community Health Center. The results of this initiative include fogging and abate application in all households in RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang, along with abate application at Rainwater Collection Points (PAH). In Jerora Village, fogging was conducted at SMPN 7 Sintang, TK Santa Yohana, the Jerora Village Office, SDN 12 Sintang, and the Panca Setya Sintang School Complex (Elementary, Junior High, Vocational High School, and High School). Sustainable activities and monitoring evaluations are necessary to support this initiative by increasing community awareness and concern for PSN-DBD. Recommendations include continuous surveillance, community education campaigns, and intersectoral collaboration to sustain efforts in combating DBD transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public-health burden of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD) and the need for community-based interventions to reduce transmission. It frames the Dengue Fever Eradication Movement (PSN-DBD) as a crucial activity to break mosquito breeding chains and lower incidence and mortality.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The initiative is a community engagement program conducted in Sintang Regency, involving collaboration across sectors and households. It spans two periods and is supervised by the Tanjung Puri Sintang Community Health Center.
analysis.methods: The methods included monitoring larval sites, providing abate larvicide, and conducting fogging interventions in targeted locations. Activities were implemented in specific households and public facilities to reduce mosquito breeding and transmission.
analysis.main_results: Fogging and abate application were carried out in all households in RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang, including abate application at Rainwater Collection Points. In Jerora Village, fogging was conducted at SMPN 7 Sintang, TK Santa Yohana, the Jerora Village Office, SDN 12 Sintang, and the Panca Setya Sintang School Complex.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the initiative as a necessary step to reduce DBD cases through environmental management and community participation. They emphasize the importance of sustainable activities and monitoring evaluations to support these efforts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted mosquito control measures and intersectoral collaboration can contribute to lowering dengue transmission and improving community awareness of PSN-DBD practices.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report quantitative outcomes, control groups, or statistical analyses to assess the effectiveness of the interventions. The strength of evidence is low due to the lack of rigorous evaluation and generalizability beyond the specific locations.

analysis.summary_en: This community-based initiative in Sintang Regency implemented the Dengue Fever Eradication Movement (PSN-DBD) to reduce dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD) transmission through mosquito control activities. The program involved monitoring larval sites, distributing abate larvicide, and conducting fogging in households and public facilities across two periods under health-center supervision. While fogging and abate application were carried out in targeted areas including RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang and multiple schools in Jerora Village, the evidence does not provide quantitative results or comparisons to evaluate impact. The authors recommend continuous surveillance, community education, and intersectoral collaboration to sustain efforts. However, the lack of rigorous design, control groups, and statistical analysis limits the strength of evidence and generalizability of findings.

elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括监测幼虫地点、提供减少杀幼虫剂以及在目标地点进行雾化干预。在特定家庭和公共设施中开展了减少蚊虫滋生和传播的活动。
elements_zh.main_results: RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang 的所有家庭都进行了雾化和消减应用,包括在雨水收集点进行了消减应用。在 Jerora 村,SMPN 7 Sintang、TK Santa Yohana、Jerora 村办公室、SDN 12 Sintang 和 Panca Setya Sintang 学校综合楼进行了雾化处理。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将该倡议解释为通过环境管理和社区参与减少 DBD 病例的必要步骤。他们强调可持续活动和监测评估对支持这些努力的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有针对性的蚊虫控制措施和部门间合作有助于降低登革热 传播 并提高社区对 PSN-DBD 做法的认识。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告定量结果、对照组或统计分析来评估干预措施的有效性。由于缺乏严格的评估和超出特定地点的普遍性,证据的强度较低。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public-health burden of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD) and the need for community-based interventions to reduce transmission. It frames the Dengue Fever Eradication Movement (PSN-DBD) as a crucial activity to break mosquito breeding chains and lower incidence and mortality.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The initiative is a community engagement program conducted in Sintang Regency, involving collaboration across sectors and households. It spans two periods and is supervised by the Tanjung Puri Sintang Community Health Center.
analysis_en.methods: The methods included monitoring larval sites, providing abate larvicide, and conducting fogging interventions in targeted locations. Activities were implemented in specific households and public facilities to reduce mosquito breeding and transmission.
analysis_en.main_results: Fogging and abate application were carried out in all households in RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang, including abate application at Rainwater Collection Points. In Jerora Village, fogging was conducted at SMPN 7 Sintang, TK Santa Yohana, the Jerora Village Office, SDN 12 Sintang, and the Panca Setya Sintang School Complex.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the initiative as a necessary step to reduce DBD cases through environmental management and community participation. They emphasize the importance of sustainable activities and monitoring evaluations to support these efforts.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted mosquito control measures and intersectoral collaboration can contribute to lowering dengue transmission and improving community awareness of PSN-DBD practices.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report quantitative outcomes, control groups, or statistical analyses to assess the effectiveness of the interventions. papers.title_zh: PEMBERANTASAN SARANG NYAMUK (PSN) - DEMAM BERDARAH 登革热 (DBD) DI DESA BANING KOTA DAN JERORA,SINTANG(实施消灭蚊巢 - 登革出血热)
papers.source_body_en: The Dengue Fever Eradication Movement (PSN-DBD) is a crucial activity aimed at combating the transmission of Dengue Fever (DBD). This action aims to break the chain of mosquito breeding and its transmission. A mosquito-free, clean, and healthy environment will decrease the incidence and mortality rates due to DBD. The objective of this community engagement initiative is to reduce DBD cases in Sintang Regency through collaboration and cross-sectoral efforts. The activity spans two periods and involves monitoring larval sites, providing abate, and conducting fogging under the supervision of the Tanjung Puri Sintang Community Health Center. The results of this initiative include fogging and abate application in all households in RT 14 Rw 03 Baning Kota Sintang, along with abate application at Rainwater Collection Points (PAH). In Jerora Village, fogging was conducted at SMPN 7 Sintang, TK Santa Yohana, the Jerora Village Office, SDN 12 Sintang, and the Panca Setya Sintang School Complex (Elementary, Junior High, Vocational High School, and High School). Sustainable activities and monitoring evaluations are necessary to support this initiative by increasing community awareness and concern for PSN-DBD. Recommendations include continuous surveillance, community education campaigns, and intersectoral collaboration to sustain efforts in combating DBD transmission.
