papers.title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Eggs Supports Vertical Transmission in Natural Settings
papers.abstract: Dengue remains one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases worldwide, and vector control continues to be the cornerstone of disease prevention. Vertical transmission has been proposed as a mechanism contributing to the maintenance of dengue virus (DENV) during interepidemic periods. In this study, field-collected egg pools and second-generation eggs derived from field-collected females from the state of Rio de Janeiro were analyzed by RT-qPCR, Sanger sequencing, plaque assay, and transmission electron microscopy. The second-generation egg samples (E1–E4), corresponding to F2 eggs of the AEDES-RIO strain, were all DENV positive. Sample E1 was positive for DENV-1, whereas samples E2–E4 were positive for DENV-4, confirming transovarial vertical transmission. The detection of DENV-1 and DENV-2 in field-collected egg pools further supports the occurrence of vertical transmission. All PCR-amplified viral fragments were confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Furthermore, homogenized egg samples naturally infected with DENV successfully infected Vero cells, demonstrating that the virus remained infectious. Transmission electron microscopy revealed virus-like particles of approximately 50 nm in diameter within egg tissues, providing ultrastructural evidence that corroborated the molecular and virological findings. Collectively, these findings provide additional evidence supporting vertical transmission of DENV in naturally infected Aedes aegypti populations and highlight the potential of egg-based surveillance as a complementary tool for entomological monitoring. However, further longitudinal studies are needed to establish its epidemiological value.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated vertical transmission of dengue virus (DENV) in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, addressing a key gap in understanding DENV persistence during interepidemic periods. Field-collected egg pools and second-generation eggs were analyzed using RT-qPCR, Sanger sequencing, plaque assay, and transmission electron microscopy. papers.title: A qualitative evaluation of dengue surveillance system implementation in southern Iran following autochthonous transmission
papers.abstract: Dengue fever, a re-emerging mosquito-borne viral disease, poses an escalating global health threat exacerbated by climate change and globalization. While Iran has historically reported only imported dengue cases, autochthonous transmission has been documented in southern provinces, particularly Hormozgan, following the first confirmed local transmission in 2024. Understanding stakeholders’ perspectives on the implementation of the national dengue surveillance system is therefore critical for informing evidence-based preparedness and policy-making. This retrospective qualitative study was conducted in Hormozgan Province between February and March 2025. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and analyzed using directed content analysis guided by the CDC surveillance evaluation framework. Key surveillance attributes—including simplicity, data quality, acceptability, sensitivity, representativeness, and timeliness—were used as analytical categories to interpret participants’ perceptions of system performance. Nineteen participants—including senior and mid-level managers, public health experts, and provincial officials—were recruited through purposive sampling with maximum variation until data saturation was achieved. Data were analyzed using MAXQDA 2020, and trustworthiness was ensured based on Lincoln and Guba’s criteria. Five major themes emerged: (1) Simplicity of processes and system adaptability, (2) Data quality, integration, and acceptability challenges, (3) Early detection, clinical recognition, and diagnostic workflow limitations, (4) Comprehensive population coverage and rapid response, and (5) System sustainability and data utilization challenges. Participants identified reference laboratories and successful local initiatives as important strengths, alongside challenges such as parallel reporting systems, limited private-sector engagement, perceived false-negative rapid diagnostic test results during early-stage illness, incomplete migrant population coverage, and unstable digital infrastructure. The findings suggest that dengue surveillance in Iran is transitioning from a focus on imported cases to the management of local transmission. Participants highlighted challenges related to data integration, intersectoral coordination, and the coverage of vulnerable populations despite existing surveillance capacities. Strengthening surveillance integration, digital reporting systems, early diagnostic capacity, and cross-sector collaboration may improve timeliness, coverage, and overall preparedness.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines dengue virus (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and dengue disease in the context of autochthonous transmission in southern Iran, focusing on the implementation of the national dengue surveillance system and stakeholders’ preparedness needs. The central question addresses how surveillance system attributes influence the detection and management of locally acquired dengue cases following the first confirmed transmission in 2024.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This retrospective qualitative study was conducted in Hormozgan Province, Iran, between February and March 2025. Data were collected via semi-structured interviews with 19 purposively sampled participants, including senior and mid-level managers, public health experts, and provincial officials, until data saturation. Analysis used directed content analysis guided by the CDC surveillance evaluation framework, with MAXQDA 2020 and trustworthiness ensured via Lincoln and Guba’s criteria.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies five major themes characterizing dengue surveillance performance: simplicity and adaptability of processes, data quality and integration challenges, limitations in early detection and diagnostic workflows, gaps in comprehensive population coverage and rapid response, and sustainability and data utilization issues. Key strengths include reference laboratories and successful local initiatives, while challenges include parallel reporting systems, limited private-sector engagement, perceived false-negative rapid diagnostic test results, incomplete migrant population coverage, and unstable digital infrastructure.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights unresolved issues such as the perceived unreliability of rapid diagnostic tests during early-stage illness, incomplete coverage of migrant populations, and unstable digital infrastructure. Additionally, there are gaps in intersectoral coordination and data integration, despite existing surveillance capacities. The qualitative nature of the study limits generalizability and does not quantify surveillance performance metrics.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends strengthening surveillance integration, enhancing digital reporting systems, improving early diagnostic capacity, and fostering cross-sector collaboration to address timeliness, coverage, and preparedness for locally transmitted dengue. It emphasizes the need to transition from a focus on imported cases to managing local transmission, particularly in southern provinces like Hormozgan.

Strengths include reference laboratories and local initiatives, while weaknesses involve parallel reporting systems, private-sector disengagement, and unstable digital infrastructure. The findings underscore the need to strengthen integration, digital reporting, early diagnostics, and cross-sector collaboration to improve timeliness and coverage for locally transmitted dengue.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查在伊朗南部本土 传播 的背景下审查了 登革病毒(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)和登革热疾病,重点关注国家登革热 监测 系统的实施和利益相关者的准备需求。中心问题解决了继 2024 年首次确认 监测 后,监测 系统属性如何影响本地获得的登革热病例的检测和管理。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项回顾性定性研究于 2025 年 2 月至 3 月在伊朗霍尔木兹甘省进行。通过半结构化访谈收集了 19 名有意抽样的参与者,包括高级和中层管理人员、公共卫生专家和省级官员,直到数据饱和。分析使用以 CDC 监测 评估框架为指导的定向内容分析,并通过 MAXQDA 2020 和林肯和古巴的标准确保可信度。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查确定了表征登革热 监测 性能的五个主要主题:流程的简单性和适应性、数据质量和集成挑战、早期检测和诊断工作流程的局限性、全面人口覆盖和快速响应方面的差距以及可持续性和数据利用问题。主要优势包括参考实验室和成功的地方举措,而挑战包括并行报告系统、有限的私营部门参与、快速诊断检测结果的假阴性、移民人口覆盖不完整以及数字基础设施不稳定。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了尚未解决的问题,例如早期疾病期间快速诊断检测不可靠、流动人口覆盖不完全以及数字基础设施不稳定等。此外,尽管现有 监测 能力,但在部门间协调和数据集成方面仍存在差距。该研究的定性性质限制了普遍性,并且没有量化 监测 绩效指标。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议加强 监测 整合,增强数字报告系统,提高早期诊断能力,并促进跨部门合作,以解决本地传播登革热的及时性、覆盖范围和防备问题。它强调需要从关注输入病例转向管理本地 传播,特别是在霍尔木兹甘等南部省份。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查在伊朗南部本土 传播 的背景下审查了 登革病毒(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)和登革热疾病,重点关注国家登革热 监测 系统的实施和利益相关者的准备需求。中心问题解决了继 2024 年首次确认 监测 后,监测 系统属性如何影响本地获得的登革热病例的检测和管理。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项回顾性定性研究于 2025 年 2 月至 3 月在伊朗霍尔木兹甘省进行。通过半结构化访谈收集了 19 名有意抽样的参与者,包括高级和中层管理人员、公共卫生专家和省级官员,直到数据饱和。分析使用以 CDC 监测 评估框架为指导的定向内容分析,并通过 MAXQDA 2020 和林肯和古巴的标准确保可信度。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该审查确定了表征登革热 监测 性能的五个主要主题:流程的简单性和适应性、数据质量和集成挑战、早期检测和诊断工作流程的局限性、全面人口覆盖和快速响应方面的差距以及可持续性和数据利用问题。主要优势包括参考实验室和成功的地方举措,而挑战包括并行报告系统、有限的私营部门参与、快速诊断检测结果的假阴性、移民人口覆盖不完整以及数字基础设施不稳定。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了尚未解决的问题,例如早期疾病期间快速诊断检测不可靠、流动人口覆盖不完全以及数字基础设施不稳定等。此外,尽管现有 监测 能力,但在部门间协调和数据集成方面仍存在差距。该研究的定性性质限制了普遍性,并且没有量化 监测 绩效指标。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议加强 监测 整合,增强数字报告系统,提高早期诊断能力,并促进跨部门合作,以解决本地传播登革热的及时性、覆盖范围和防备问题。它强调需要从关注输入病例转向管理本地 传播,特别是在霍尔木兹甘等南部省份。

papers.title: Analysis of Dengue-Related Deaths in Colombia During the 2024 Outbreak
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by vectors, mainly by Aedes mosquitoes. Objective: To analyze dengue-related deaths in Colombia during the 2024 outbreak. Methodology: An observational, descriptive, and retrospective study. Secondary sources provided by Instituto Nacional de Salud de Colombia, were used. Absolute and relative frequencies with 95% confidence intervals were calculated for categorical variables, and measures of central tendency and dispersion were computed for quantitative variables. Results: In 2024, 284 confirmed dengue-related deaths were recorded in Colombia, with a higher predominance in females during the adult stage; the department with the highest number of deaths was Valle del Cauca. The departments of Guainía (0.35), La Guajira, and Putumayo (0.26) showing the highest case fatality rates. Differences were identified among age groups: individuals aged 50 to 59 years showed the greatest delay in seeking care, with an average of 4.93 days (SD: 1.73), while children aged 1 to 4 years sought care more promptly, with an average of 2.9 days (SD: 2.5). Additionally, children under 1 year of age had the shortest mean interval between hospitalization and death, with only 1.8 days (SD: 0.7) . Conclusion: These findings highlight the need to strengthen surveillance actions, timely diagnosis, and the problem-solving capacity of health services, especially in vulnerable contexts and during periods of higher transmission.
papers.journal: Journal of Intelligent Decision Making and Information Science

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease of public-health importance in Colombia, yet detailed analyses of fatal outcomes during the 2024 outbreak were lacking. The study aimed to quantify and characterize dengue-related deaths to inform control priorities.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An observational, descriptive, and retrospective study was conducted using secondary surveillance data from the Instituto Nacional de Salud de Colombia covering the 2024 dengue outbreak.
analysis.methods: Absolute and relative frequencies with 95% confidence intervals were calculated for categorical variables, and measures of central tendency and dispersion were computed for quantitative variables using national surveillance records.
analysis.main_results: In 2024, 284 confirmed dengue-related deaths were recorded in Colombia, with a higher predominance in females during the adult stage; the department with the highest number of deaths was Valle del Cauca. The departments of Guainía (0.35), La Guajira, and Putumayo (0.26) showed the highest case fatality rates.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the geographic and demographic patterns as evidence that surveillance, timely diagnosis, and health-service capacity must be strengthened, particularly in high-fatality departments and among adults with delayed care-seeking.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can guide targeted surveillance and clinical interventions in departments with elevated case fatality and among adult populations with prolonged pre-hospital delays.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on secondary surveillance data and its retrospective design limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting a moderate strength of evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective observational study analyzed 284 confirmed dengue-related deaths in Colombia during the 2024 outbreak using national surveillance data. Females in the adult stage predominated among fatalities, and Valle del Cauca reported the highest absolute number of deaths. Case fatality rates were highest in Guainía (0.35), La Guajira, and Putumayo (0.26). Adults aged 50–59 years had the longest delay before seeking care (mean 4.93 days), while children under 1 year had the shortest interval between hospitalization and death (mean 1.8 days). The authors conclude that strengthening surveillance, timely diagnosis, and health-service capacity is critical, especially in high-fatality departments and among vulnerable groups.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: An observational, descriptive, and retrospective study was conducted using secondary surveillance data from the Instituto Nacional de Salud de Colombia covering the 2024 dengue outbreak.
analysis_en.methods: Absolute and relative frequencies with 95% confidence intervals were calculated for categorical variables, and measures of central tendency and dispersion were computed for quantitative variables using national surveillance records.
analysis_en.main_results: In 2024, 284 confirmed dengue-related deaths were recorded in Colombia, with a higher predominance in females during the adult stage; the department with the highest number of deaths was Valle del Cauca. The departments of Guainía (0.35), La Guajira, and Putumayo (0.26) showed the highest case fatality rates.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the geographic and demographic patterns as evidence that surveillance, timely diagnosis, and health-service capacity must be strengthened, particularly in high-fatality departments and among adults with delayed care-seeking.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can guide targeted surveillance and clinical interventions in departments with elevated case fatality and among adult populations with prolonged pre-hospital delays.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s reliance on secondary surveillance data and its retrospective design limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting a moderate strength of evidence.

papers.title_zh: 2024 年 暴发 哥伦比亚登革热相关死亡分析
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by vectors, mainly by Aedes mosquitoes. Objective: To analyze dengue-related deaths in Colombia during the 2024 outbreak. Methodology: An observational, descriptive, and retrospective study. Secondary sources provided by Instituto Nacional de Salud de Colombia, were used. Absolute and relative frequencies with 95% confidence intervals were calculated for categorical variables, and measures of central tendency and dispersion were computed for quantitative variables. Results: In 2024, 284 confirmed dengue-related deaths were recorded in Colombia, with a higher predominance in females during the adult stage; the department with the highest number of deaths was Valle del Cauca. The departments of Guainía (0.35), La Guajira, and Putumayo (0.26) showing the highest case fatality rates. Differences were identified among age groups: individuals aged 50 to 59 years showed the greatest delay in seeking care, with an average of 4.93 days (SD: 1.73), while children aged 1 to 4 years sought care more promptly, with an average of 2.9 days (SD: 2.5). Additionally, children under 1 year of age had the shortest mean interval between hospitalization and death, with only 1.8 days (SD: 0.7) . Conclusion: These findings highlight the need to strengthen surveillance actions, timely diagnosis, and the problem-solving capacity of health services, especially in vulnerable contexts and during periods of higher transmission.

papers.title: Association of Dengue Virus Serotypes with Disease Severity and Clinical-Hematological Parameters: A Hospital-Based Analytical Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Dengue disease severity varies by viral serotype and host factors. This study examined associations between dengue virus (DENV) serotypes, disease severity, and clinical-hematological parameters. Aims & Objectives: To investigate the molecular epidemiology of circulating dengue serotypes, identify DENV-1 to DENV-4 by RT-PCR, determine their demographic and clinical distribution, assess associations with disease severity, and generate data to strengthen dengue surveillance and public health interventions. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 290 clinically suspected dengue patients at Index Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Indore, from January 2023 to January 2026. Serum samples were screened using the SD BIOLINETM Dengue Duo Rapid Test, followed by viral RNA extraction and real-time RT-PCR with the RealStar® Dengue Type RT-PCR Kit 1.0. Dengue serotypes were identified, and clinical and hematological parameters were compared according to disease severity. Results: Real-time RT-PCR confirmed dengue infection in 67 (23.1%) patients. DENV-2 was the predominant serotype (46.3%), followed by DENV-3 (26.9%), DENV-1 (20.9%), DENV-4 (3.0%), and mixed infections (3.0%). Serotype was significantly associated with disease severity (p=0.012). Mean platelet count declined significantly from 142,800/μL in dengue without warning signs to 42,300/μL in severe dengue (p<0.001). Thrombocytopenia was the most common hematological abnormality (88.1%). DENV-2 infection, platelet count <50,000/μL, bleeding manifestations, and abdominal pain were independently associated with severe dengue. Conclusion: DENV-2 predominated and was significantly associated with severe dengue. Molecular serotyping combined with clinical and hematological assessment may facilitate early identification of patients at risk of severe disease.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue disease severity varies by viral serotype and host factors, creating a need to clarify how specific dengue virus (DENV) serotypes influence clinical outcomes and hematological parameters to inform surveillance and public health interventions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A hospital-based cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 290 clinically suspected dengue patients at Index Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Indore, from January 2023 to January 2026.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were screened using the SD BIOLINETM Dengue Duo Rapid Test, followed by viral RNA extraction and real-time RT-PCR with the RealStar® Dengue Type RT-PCR Kit 1.0 to identify DENV serotypes, and clinical and hematological parameters were compared according to disease severity.
analysis.main_results: Real-time RT-PCR confirmed dengue infection in 67 (23.1%) patients, with DENV-2 predominating (46.3%), followed by DENV-3 (26.9%), DENV-1 (20.9%), DENV-4 (3.0%), and mixed infections (3.0%). Serotype was significantly associated with disease severity (p=0.012), and mean platelet count declined from 142,800/μL in dengue without warning signs to 42,300/μL in severe dengue (p<0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that DENV-2 predominated and was significantly associated with severe dengue, suggesting that molecular serotyping combined with clinical and hematological assessment may facilitate early identification of patients at risk of severe disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform dengue surveillance strategies by prioritizing DENV-2 monitoring and integrating serotype-specific risk stratification into clinical management to improve early detection of severe cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design and hospital-based sampling limit causal inference and generalizability to the broader population, and the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential selection bias and unmeasured confounding.

analysis.summary_en: This hospital-based cross-sectional study in Indore, India, analyzed 290 clinically suspected dengue patients from 2023 to 2026 to investigate associations between dengue virus (DENV) serotypes, disease severity, and clinical-hematological parameters. Using RT-PCR, DENV-2 was identified as the predominant serotype (46.3%), followed by DENV-3 (26.9%), DENV-1 (20.9%), DENV-4 (3.0%), and mixed infections (3.0%). Serotype was significantly associated with disease severity (p=0.012), and severe dengue cases showed marked thrombocytopenia (mean platelet count 42,300/μL). DENV-2 infection, platelet count <50,000/μL, bleeding manifestations, and abdominal pain were independently associated with severe disease. The authors propose that molecular serotyping combined with clinical and hematological assessment could aid early identification of high-risk patients. However, the cross-sectional design and hospital-based sampling limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热疾病的严重程度因病毒血清型和 宿主 因素而异,因此需要澄清特定的 登革病毒 (DENV) 血清型如何影响临床结果和血液学参数,以便为 监测 和公共卫生干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 1 月,印多尔 Index 医学院医院和研究中心对 290 名临床疑似登革热患者进行了一项以医院为基础的横断面分析研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 SD BIOLINETM Dengue Duo Rapid Test 筛选血清样本,然后使用 RealStar® Dengue Type RT-PCR Kit 1.0 进行病毒 RNA 提取和实时 RT-PCR,以确定 DENV 血清型,并根据疾病严重程度比较临床和血液学参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 实时RT-PCR证实67例(23.1%)患者感染登革热,其中以DENV-2为主(46.3%),其次是DENV-3(26.9%)、DENV-1(20.9%)、DENV-4(3.0%)和混合感染(3.0%)。血清型与疾病严重程度显着相关(p=0.012),平均血小板计数从无警告信号的登革热中的 142,800/μL 下降至 重症登革热 中的 42,300/μL(p<0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,DENV-2 占主导地位,并且与 重症登革热 显着相关,这表明分子血清分型与临床和血液学评估相结合可能有助于早期识别处于严重疾病风险的患者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过优先考虑 DENV-2 监测并将血清型特异性风险分层纳入临床管理来为登革热 监测 策略提供信息,以改善重症病例的早期发现。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计和基于医院的抽样限制了因果推断和对更广泛人群的普遍性,并且由于潜在的选择偏差和无法测量的混杂因素,证据强度被评估为中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 使用 SD BIOLINETM Dengue Duo Rapid Test 筛选血清样本,然后使用 RealStar® Dengue Type RT-PCR Kit 1.0 进行病毒 RNA 提取和实时 RT-PCR,以确定 DENV 血清型,并根据疾病严重程度比较临床和血液学参数。
analysis_zh.main_results: 实时RT-PCR证实67例(23.1%)患者感染登革热,其中以DENV-2为主(46.3%),其次是DENV-3(26.9%)、DENV-1(20.9%)、DENV-4(3.0%)和混合感染(3.0%)。血清型与疾病严重程度显着相关(p=0.012),平均血小板计数从无警告信号的登革热中的 142,800/μL 下降至 重症登革热 中的 42,300/μL(p<0.001)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,DENV-2 占主导地位,并且与 重症登革热 显着相关,这表明分子血清分型与临床和血液学评估相结合可能有助于早期识别处于严重疾病风险的患者。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过优先考虑 DENV-2 监测并将血清型特异性风险分层纳入临床管理来为登革热 监测 策略提供信息,以改善重症病例的早期发现。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计和基于医院的抽样限制了因果推断和对更广泛人群的普遍性,并且由于潜在的选择偏差和无法测量的混杂因素,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.title_original: Impacts of climate change on dengue.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study examines why climate change is driving surges in dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, identifying a critical knowledge gap in understanding how climatic and socioeconomic factors interact to alter dengue transmission dynamics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The paper is a narrative review synthesizing evidence on climate change impacts on dengue, drawing on global studies and meta-analyses to assess transmission patterns and risk factors.
analysis.methods: The review employs a meta-analysis approach to evaluate temperature impacts on dengue incidence, integrating climatic and socioeconomic mediators to model nonlinear relationships.
analysis.main_results: The review reports that climate warming is expanding the dengue burden in the Americas and Asia, with temperature effects on dengue incidence being nonlinear and mediated by climatic and socioeconomic factors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that climate change is reshaping dengue epidemiology through complex interactions, highlighting the need for integrated climate-resilient strategies to mitigate transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the urgency of strengthening vector control, surveillance, and climate-informed disease burden projections to build dengue resilience in a changing climate.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The review relies on synthesized evidence rather than primary data, limiting causal inference and generalisability; the strength of evidence is moderate due to heterogeneity in included studies and potential confounding.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review evaluates how climate change is driving surges in dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases by synthesizing global evidence on climatic and socioeconomic drivers. The authors use a meta-analysis to demonstrate that temperature impacts on dengue incidence are nonlinear and mediated by climatic and socioeconomic factors, with climate warming expanding dengue burden in the Americas and Asia. They argue that strengthening vector control, surveillance, climate-informed projections, sustainable urban management, and community engagement is critical for building dengue resilience. The review highlights the need for cross-sectoral partnerships to create climate-resilient systems that improve health outcomes. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on synthesized data, heterogeneity in studies, and potential confounding, limiting causal conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了气候变化为何导致登革热和其他蚊媒疾病激增,并确定了理解气候和社会经济因素如何相互作用以改变登革热 传播 动态的关键知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该论文是一篇叙述性综述,综合了气候变化对登革热影响的证据,利用全球研究和荟萃分析来评估 传播 模式和风险因素。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述采用荟萃分析方法来评估温度对登革热 发病率 的影响,整合气候和社会经济中介因素来模拟非线性关系。
elements_zh.main_results: 该评论报告称,气候变暖正在扩大美洲和亚洲的登革热负担,温度对登革热的影响是非线性的,并受到气候和社会经济因素的调节。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为气候变化正在通过复杂的相互作用重塑登革热 流行病学 的证据,强调需要采取综合气候适应策略来缓解 传播 的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了加强 媒介 控制、监测 和气候信息疾病负担预测的紧迫性,以增强气候变化中登革热的抵御能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该审查依赖于综合证据而不是原始数据,限制了因果推断和普遍性;由于纳入研究的异质性和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Integrated Clinical and Proteomic Precision Subgrouping for Severe Dengue Endotype Signature
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Severe dengue remains difficult to predict because patients with different clinical trajectories may present with overlapping features, and conventional severity classifications may not fully capture underlying biological heterogeneity. In this study, we applied an integrated clinical and proteomic endotyping approach to dissect dengue disease heterogeneity and identify molecular signatures associated with severity. Methods Plasma proteomic profiles were analyzed together with detailed clinical, biochemical, hematological, coagulation, and immunological parameters from healthy controls and dengue patients classified according to WHO 2009 severity criteria. High-throughput proteomic analysis, unsupervised clustering, pathway enrichment, and machine-learning–based classification were used to identify dengue endotypes and define molecular features associated with predicted severe disease. Results Increasing dengue severity was associated with progressive abnormalities in liver function, coagulation parameters, hematological indices, and inflammatory mediators, including IL-6, IL-15, HGF, and MUC-16. However, proteomic profiling revealed substantial overlap across conventional severity categories, indicating that clinical classification alone does not fully resolve dengue host-response heterogeneity. Integrated clinical-proteomic clustering identified distinct dengue endotypes, including a predicted severe endotype enriched for inflammatory, antiviral, and cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated pathways. This high-risk endotype was characterized by elevated IL-15, IFN-γ, and granzymes, consistent with coordinated activation of cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated antiviral responses. Machine-learning analysis further showed that proteomic features were strong discriminators of this endotype, supporting their potential utility as biomarkers of severe host-response states. Conclusion Integrated clinical-proteomic endotyping provides molecular resolution beyond conventional severity grading and identifies immune pathways associated with severe dengue. This framework may improve biological understanding of dengue progression and support future risk stratification and biomarker development.

Machine-learning analysis further demonstrated that proteomic features strongly discriminated this endotype, supporting their potential as biomarkers of severe host-response states. The authors conclude that integrated clinical-proteomic endotyping provides molecular resolution beyond conventional severity grading and may improve biological understanding of dengue progression and future risk stratification.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 重症登革热 仍然难以预测,因为具有不同临床轨迹的患者可能呈现重叠的特征,并且传统的严重程度分类可能无法完全捕捉潜在的生物异质性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项研究中,采用综合的临床和蛋白质组内分型方法来剖析登革热疾病的异质性并识别与严重程度相关的分子特征。
elements_zh.methods: 对健康对照者和根据 WHO 2009 年严重程度标准分类的登革热患者的血浆蛋白质组图谱以及详细的临床、生化、血液学、凝血和免疫学参数进行了分析。高通量蛋白质组分析、无监督聚类、通路富集和基于机器学习的分类被用来识别登革热内型并定义与预测的严重疾病相关的分子特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热严重程度的增加与肝功能、凝血参数、血液学指标和炎症介质(包括 IL-6、IL-15、HGF 和 MUC-16)的进行性异常相关。蛋白质组学分析显示传统严重程度类别之间存在大量重叠,表明仅临床分类并不能完全解决登革热 宿主 反应异质性。综合临床蛋白质组聚类鉴定出不同的登革热内型,包括预测的富含炎症、抗病毒药物 和细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关途径的严重内型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 集成的临床蛋白质组内分型提供了超越传统严重程度分级的分子分辨率,并确定了与 重症登革热 相关的免疫途径。该框架可以提高对登革热进展的生物学理解,并支持未来的风险分层和生物标志物开发。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 确定的蛋白质组学特征和内型可以为 重症登革热 风险分层生物标志物的开发提供信息,并增强对驱动疾病进展的 宿主 反应机制的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的证据,缺乏详细的方法、统计或数字报告,这限制了结论的强度。由于缺乏完整的方法和结果细节,证据强度被评估为低。

papers.title_zh: 重症登革热 内型特征的综合临床和蛋白质组精确亚组
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Severe dengue remains difficult to predict because patients with different clinical trajectories may present with overlapping features, and conventional severity classifications may not fully capture underlying biological heterogeneity. In this study, we applied an integrated clinical and proteomic endotyping approach to dissect dengue disease heterogeneity and identify molecular signatures associated with severity. Methods Plasma proteomic profiles were analyzed together with detailed clinical, biochemical, hematological, coagulation, and immunological parameters from healthy controls and dengue patients classified according to WHO 2009 severity criteria. High-throughput proteomic analysis, unsupervised clustering, pathway enrichment, and machine-learning–based classification were used to identify dengue endotypes and define molecular features associated with predicted severe disease. Results Increasing dengue severity was associated with progressive abnormalities in liver function, coagulation parameters, hematological indices, and inflammatory mediators, including IL-6, IL-15, HGF, and MUC-16. However, proteomic profiling revealed substantial overlap across conventional severity categories, indicating that clinical classification alone does not fully resolve dengue host-response heterogeneity. Integrated clinical-proteomic clustering identified distinct dengue endotypes, including a predicted severe endotype enriched for inflammatory, antiviral, and cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated pathways. This high-risk endotype was characterized by elevated IL-15, IFN-γ, and granzymes, consistent with coordinated activation of cytotoxic lymphocyte-associated antiviral responses. Machine-learning analysis further showed that proteomic features were strong discriminators of this endotype, supporting their potential utility as biomarkers of severe host-response states. Conclusion Integrated clinical-proteomic endotyping provides molecular resolution beyond conventional severity grading and identifies immune pathways associated with severe dengue. This framework may improve biological understanding of dengue progression and support future risk stratification and biomarker development.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 重症登革热 仍然难以预测,因为具有不同临床轨迹的患者可能表现出重叠的特征,并且传统的严重程度分类可能无法完全捕捉潜在的生物异质性。在这项研究中,我们应用综合的临床和蛋白质组内分型方法来剖析登革热疾病的异质性并确定与严重程度相关的分子特征。方法 对健康对照者和根据 WHO 2009 年严重程度标准分类的登革热患者的血浆蛋白质组谱以及详细的临床、生化、血液学、凝血和免疫学参数进行分析。高通量蛋白质组分析、无监督聚类、通路富集和基于机器学习的分类被用来识别登革热内型并定义与预测的严重疾病相关的分子特征。结果 登革热严重程度的增加与肝功能、凝血参数、血液学指标和炎症介质(包括 IL-6、IL-15、HGF 和 MUC-16)的进行性异常相关。然而,蛋白质组学分析显示传统严重程度类别之间存在大量重叠,表明仅临床分类并不能完全解决登革热 宿主 反应异质性。综合临床蛋白质组聚类鉴定出不同的登革热内型,包括预测的富含炎症、抗病毒药物 和细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关途径的严重内型。这种高风险内型的特点是 IL-15、IFN-γ 和颗粒酶升高,与细胞毒性淋巴细胞相关 抗病毒药物 反应的协调激活一致。机器学习分析进一步表明,蛋白质组学特征是这种内型的强有力的鉴别器,支持它们作为严重 宿主 反应状态的生物标志物的潜在用途。结论 整合的临床蛋白质组内分型提供了超越传统严重程度分级的分子分辨率,并确定了与 重症登革热 相关的免疫途径。该框架可以提高对登革热进展的生物学理解,并支持未来的风险分层和生物标志物开发。

papers.title: Parameters affecting dengue virus replication in Vero cells
papers.abstract: Dengue has become a global threat affecting millions of people annually and contributing to a significant mortality burden. Although vaccination is the most effective approach to prevent this disease in dengue-endemic regions, the development of a robust and scalable production process is urgently required to maximize vaccine yield. The current study aimed to optimize the key growth parameters of four recombinant live attenuated dengue serotypes, including harvest schedule, temperature, Multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration. Growth kinetics data, followed by a scale-up study, established the feasibility of multiple harvests for all four serotypes within a defined production window, with the first harvest optimally occurring between Days 4 and 8. All serotypes demonstrated strong responsiveness to low MOIs and temperature shifts, resulting in 2- to 25-fold increases in titer within a reduced time frame. Furthermore, metabolite profiling revealed distinct glutamine and glucose consumption dynamics, highlighting its importance for optimizing infection media. Taken together, these findings provide valuable insights into dengue virus production and define critical parameters that can support future optimization studies and large-scale production.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue poses a major global health burden, and while vaccination is the most effective preventive measure, scalable vaccine production remains a bottleneck. The study was needed to identify parameters that could optimize dengue virus replication for vaccine manufacturing.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated four recombinant live attenuated dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) in Vero cells to determine optimal growth conditions for virus replication.
analysis.methods: The authors evaluated key growth parameters including harvest schedule, temperature, multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration, followed by growth kinetics analysis and a scale-up study.
analysis.main_results: All four dengue serotypes showed strong responsiveness to low MOIs and temperature shifts, resulting in 2- to 25-fold increases in viral titer within a reduced time frame. Metabolite profiling identified distinct glutamine and glucose consumption dynamics critical for optimizing infection media.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings define critical parameters for dengue virus production, demonstrating that optimized MOI, temperature, and metabolite conditions can enhance viral yield and reduce production time.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results directly inform efforts to scale up dengue vaccine production, potentially improving vaccine availability in endemic regions by optimizing bioprocess parameters.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro Vero cell culture systems and does not address in vivo replication or clinical outcomes, warranting caution in extrapolating findings to vaccine manufacturing or public health impact.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to optimize dengue virus replication in Vero cells for vaccine production by evaluating harvest schedule, temperature, multiplicity of infection (MOI), and metabolite concentration. Growth kinetics and scale-up analyses showed that all four dengue serotypes responded robustly to low MOI and temperature shifts, achieving 2- to 25-fold titer increases within a shortened timeframe. Metabolite profiling revealed distinct glutamine and glucose consumption patterns, highlighting their role in optimizing infection media. The findings provide actionable parameters for enhancing viral yield and reducing production time, which are critical for scaling dengue vaccine manufacturing. However, the study is limited to in vitro systems and does not address in vivo replication or clinical efficacy, restricting direct translation to public health applications.

analysis_zh.methods: 作者评估了关键生长参数,包括收获时间表、温度、感染复数 (MOI) 和代谢物浓度,然后进行生长动力学分析和放大研究。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有四种登革热血清型均对低 MOI 和温度变化表现出强烈的响应性,导致病毒滴度在较短的时间内增加 2 至 25 倍。代谢分析确定了不同的谷氨酰胺和葡萄糖消耗动态,这对于优化感染介质至关重要。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果定义了 登革病毒 生产的关键参数,证明优化的 MOI、温度和代谢条件可以提高病毒产量并缩短生产时间。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果直接为扩大登革热 疫苗 生产的努力提供了信息,通过优化生物工艺参数,有可能提高 疫苗 在流行地区的可用性。

papers.title: Hesitancy and Perceptions Regarding Dengue Vaccination Among Educated Ecuadorians.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Global dengue cases have surged in recent years. In Ecuador, reported cases increased from 27,906 in 2023 to 57,712 in 2024. Despite the availability of multiple vaccines in other countries, factors such as socioeconomic disparities, climate change, and vaccine hesitancy continue to hinder prevention efforts. This study aims to analyze the perceptions of the Ecuadorian population and explore possible reasons for hesitancy toward the dengue vaccine. METHODS: This cross-sectional observational study was conducted in accordance with the STROBE guidelines. Online surveys, adapted from Kricorian et al., were distributed via the Qualtrics app between June 1st, 2024, and June 25, 2025. Eligible participants were Ecuadorian, at least 18 years old, and had a minimal education level of bachelor. Statistical analysis included descriptive percentages and chi-square tests, with significance set at p < 0.05. RESULTS: A total of 735 participants were included. Most perceived a dengue vaccine as safe (87.2%, n = 641), while 12.8% (n = 94) considered it unsafe. Overall, 75.9% expressed willingness to be vaccinated. Perceived vaccine safety was significantly associated with vaccination willingness, region of residence, and willingness to vaccinate offspring (all p < 0.001), but not with education level, dengue understanding (p = 0.747), or prior dengue experience (p = 0.111). CONCLUSION: Most Ecuadorians perceive dengue vaccines as safe, yet hesitancy persists. Targeted educational efforts are essential to improve acceptance and coverage.
papers.journal: Vector borne and zoonotic diseases (Larchmont, N.Y.)

papers.title: Epidemiology and Serology of Dengue in Imphal Valley: An Institutional Study
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue is a pandemic disease with a substantial global burden and can be fatal. Effective dengue control measures should consider the location of outbreaks, relevant demographic parameters, and the diagnostic testing techniques used. Aims: This study evaluated the epidemiological and demographic characteristics of dengue and the diagnostic testing techniques used in Imphal Valley. Materials and Methods: This prospective study was conducted at the Escent Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Research (NABL-accredited Diagnostic Laboratory), Imphal, Manipur. All clinically suspected dengue cases reported by government and private hospitals in Imphal were included from September 2023 to December 2025. Microsoft Excel 2019 was used for data analysis. Results: Of 3,424 samples received from clinically suspected dengue cases, 1,514 (44.22%) were positive, comprising 735 male and 779 female cases. Cases positive only for NS1 were the most frequent, indicating early infection, followed by cases positive for both NS1 and IgM. Conclusion: Imphal experienced dengue outbreaks in three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025. The largest outbreak during the study period occurred in 2025, driven by a sharp increase in cases. Efforts to control mosquito breeding habitats in high-risk areas should be intensified by removing containers of stagnant water to reduce the density of Aedes mosquitoes.
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology

papers.title: Understanding dengue dynamics: spatiotemporal evidence of control failure, inequalities, and the role of climate factors
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue remains a pressing public health issue in Brazil, where vector control strategies often suffer from limited effectiveness and sustainability. Although the Brazilian National Dengue Control Program (PNCD) operates with standardized guidelines, few studies have evaluated its long-term effectiveness at the local level, with a consistent dengue transmission history and structured intervention efforts under the PNCD. Moreover, previous research at aggregated scales has shown conflicting associations between socioeconomic development and dengue incidence, highlighting the need for small-area spatiotemporal analyses. Methods We conducted a Bayesian spatiotemporal analysis using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA) to assess quarterly dengue incidence in São José do Rio Preto (SJRP), Brazil, from 2012–2024. The model incorporated environmental, entomological, and socioeconomic covariates from census tracts. Results The findings revealed that vector control actions were predominantly reactive and intensified after case surges. Increased literacy rates were associated with a decreased dengue incidence rate, whereas higher relative deprivation increased the risk. These results differ from those of regional studies that associate higher socioeconomic development with an increased dengue burden, emphasizing the value of small-scale analysis to uncover local vulnerabilities. Climatic variables had nonlinear effects, with elevated temperatures and rainfall associated with increased risk. Spatial risk patterns varied significantly over time, with no consistent high-risk clusters. Given the standardized implementation of the PNCD, the SJRP serves as a suitable proxy for assessing the program’s broader effectiveness across Brazil. Conclusion This study underscores the limitations of reactive dengue control strategies and the need for more proactive, integrated, and socially contextualized approaches to address this issue. Small-area analyses provide critical insights into the heterogeneous dynamics of disease transmission and social vulnerability. Expanding the use of innovative tools, such as Wolbachia-based control and sterile insects, among others, may strengthen long-term prevention and guide the development of more resilient national policies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热在巴西仍然是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题,媒介 控制策略的有效性和可持续性往往有限。尽管巴西国家登革热控制计划 (PNCD) 按照标准化指南运作,但很少有研究评估其在地方一级的长期有效性,以及 PNCD 下一致的登革热 传播 历史和结构化干预工作。此外,之前的总体规模研究表明,社会经济发展与登革热 发病率 之间存在相互矛盾的关联,凸显了小区域时空分析的必要性。方法 我们使用综合嵌套拉普拉斯近似 (INLA) 进行贝叶斯时空分析,以评估 2012 年至 2024 年巴西普雷图河畔圣若泽 (SJRP) 的季度登革热 发病率。该模型结合了人口普查区的环境、昆虫学和社会经济协变量。结果 调查结果显示,媒介 控制行动主要是反应性的,并且在病例激增后得到加强。识字率的提高与登革热 发病率 率的降低相关,而相对剥夺程度的提高则增加了风险。这些结果不同于区域研究的结果,区域研究将较高的社会经济发展与登革热负担增加联系起来,强调了小规模分析发现当地脆弱性的价值。气候变量具有非线性效应,气温升高和降雨量增加与风险增加相关。空间风险模式随时间变化显着,没有一致的高风险集群。鉴于 PNCD 的标准化实施,SJRP 可以作为评估该计划在巴西各地更广泛有效性的合适代理。结论 本研究强调了反应性登革热控制策略的局限性,以及需要采取更主动、综合和社会背景化的方法来解决这一问题。小区域分析为疾病 传播 和社会脆弱性的异质动态提供了重要见解。扩大创新工具的使用,例如基于沃尔巴克氏体的控制和昆虫不育等,可以加强长期预防并指导制定更具弹性的国家政策。

papers.title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Intracerebral Haemorrhage, Acute Respiratory Failure and Nosocomial Pneumonia: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral illness caused by the dengue virus. Majority of cases have self-limiting course, rarely severe dengue causes fatal neurological complications like encephalitis and haemorrhage. This is case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, one day of altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. Serological testing confirmed dengue IgM positivity. The clinical course was complicated by a rapid decline in Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) from 15 to 11, necessitating endotracheal intubation on day two in the setting of blood-stained pulmonary secretions. Highresolution Computed Tomography (CT) of the thorax suggested consolidation with pulmonary oedema. CT of the brain revealed a 3.9×3.8×3.5 cm Intracerebral Parenchymal Haemorrhage (IPH) with surrounding oedema causing significant mass effect. Laboratory parameters documented severe thrombocytopaenia (nadir 0.6 lac/cumm), coagulopathy, hepatocellular injury with peak SGOT/ SGPT of 227/276 IU/L, and elevated C-reactive protein at 85.6 mg/L. Endotracheal aspirate cultures grew extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii on day five, requiring escalation of antimicrobial therapy to meropenem and polymyxin. Supportive management included platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP) transfusion. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged home on day twelve. Notably, the simultaneous occurrence of dengue-associated Intracerebral Haemorrhage (ICH), acute hypoxaemic respiratory failure, and Multi-Drug Resistant (MDR) nosocomial pneumonia in a young immunocompetent adult represents a triad that is rarely documented in the published literature. Early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy with conservative management of ICH remains critical determinants of a favourable outcome.

The study highlights the need to document atypical and severe presentations of dengue infection to improve clinical recognition and management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a case report of a 38-year-old male who presented with three days of high-grade fever, altered sensorium, headache, and generalised weakness. The patient received supportive management including platelet and Fresh Frozen Plasma transfusions.
analysis.methods: The diagnosis of dengue was confirmed by serological testing showing dengue IgM positivity. Supportive care included blood product transfusions, and clinical monitoring was performed throughout the hospital course.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed a Glasgow Coma Scale decline from 15 to 11, requiring endotracheal intubation on day two due to blood-stained pulmonary secretions. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The case underscores the importance of early recognition of neurological deterioration, timely neuroimaging, aggressive blood product support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy in managing severe dengue complications.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old male with dengue fever confirmed by IgM serology who developed severe complications including intracerebral haemorrhage, acute respiratory failure requiring intubation, and multi-drug resistant nosocomial pneumonia. Clinically, he exhibited rapid neurological deterioration, severe thrombocytopaenia, coagulopathy, and hepatocellular injury. Management involved supportive care with platelet and FFP transfusions, early neuroimaging, and targeted antimicrobial therapy. The patient was successfully extubated on day nine and discharged on day twelve. The simultaneous occurrence of these severe complications in a young immunocompetent adult is rarely documented, highlighting the need for heightened clinical vigilance in dengue cases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是一种蚊媒病毒性疾病,病程主要为自限性,但严重病例可导致罕见但致命的神经系统并发症,如脑炎和出血。该研究强调需要记录登革热感染的非典型和严重表现,以提高临床识别和管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一名 38 岁男性的 病例报告,他出现三天高烧、感觉改变、头痛和全身无力。患者接受了支持治疗,包括血小板和新鲜冰冻血浆输注。
elements_zh.methods: 血清学检测显示登革热 IgM 阳性,证实了登革热 诊断。支持治疗包括输血,并在整个住院期间进行临床监测。
elements_zh.main_results: 该患者的格拉斯哥昏迷评分从 15 分下降至 11 分,由于肺部分泌物带血,需要在第二天进行气管插管。脑部CT扫描显示3.9×3.8×3.5厘米的脑实质出血,周围水肿,造成明显的占位效应。实验室检查结果包括严重血小板减少症(最低 0.6 lac/cumm)、凝血病、肝细胞损伤(SGOT/SGPT 峰值为 227/276 IU/L)以及 C 反应蛋白升高(85.6 mg/L)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在免疫功能正常的年轻成人中同时发生登革热相关脑出血、急性低氧血症性呼吸衰竭和多重耐药医院肺炎是已发表文献中很少记录的三联征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了早期识别神经功能恶化、及时进行神经影像学检查、积极的血液制品支持和靶向抗菌治疗在管理 重症登革热 并发症中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为单个 病例报告,证据的普遍性有限,无法建立因果关系。由于缺乏比较数据或更广泛的临床背景,证据强度较低。

papers.title: Monocyte TLR2/4 as predictive biomarkers for progression from dengue warning signs to severe disease
papers.abstract: Background The World Health Organization (WHO) classification system, comprising dengue fever (DF), dengue with warning signs (DWS), and severe dengue (SD), has been widely adopted globally; however, clinical management remains challenging. Current warning sign criteria lack specificity, frequently failing to distinguish patients progressing to severe disease from those with transient illness, thereby contributing to delayed interventions and missed therapeutic windows. Although Toll-like receptors (TLRs) mediate innate antiviral immunity and are implicated in severe dengue pathogenesis, their expression dynamics during the critical DWS transition window, a phase in which intervention could prevent progression to severe disease, remain entirely unknown. Methods An integrated biomarker discovery study was conducted, comprising bioinformatics analysis of publicly available single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data (GSE220969) and experimental validation in an independent clinical cohort of 45 dengue patients and 10 healthy controls (H) in Guangdong Province, China. Phase-specific immune signatures were identified from the scRNA-seq data. TLRs expression was quantified by multiparameter flow cytometry. Diagnostic performance was assessed using ROC curve analysis, and correlations with clinical laboratory parameters were evaluated using Spearman’s rank correlation. Results Bioinformatics analysis of 23 cell clusters revealed that TLR2/4/7/8 expression peaked specifically during the DWS phase, predominantly in monocytes. Flow cytometry confirmed elevated surface TLR2 (AUC 0.874) and TLR4 (AUC 0.763) in DWS versus other phases, with discriminatory capacity to distinguish DWS from SD (TLR2: AUC 0.833; TLR4: AUC 0.810). Moreover, correlation analysis of TLRs expression with clinical indicators demonstrated that the expression levels of TLR2 and TLR4 were associated with the development of SD. Conclusions Elevated monocyte TLR2/4 expression during DWS identifies patients at risk for progression to severe dengue before clinical decompensation. These mechanism-informed biomarkers provide a foundation for point-of-care risk stratification in endemic regions.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 世界卫生组织(WHO)分类系统,包括登革热(DF)、带有警告标志的登革热(DWS)和重症登革热(SD),已在全球广泛采用;然而,临床管理仍然具有挑战性。目前的警告信号标准缺乏特异性,常常无法区分进展为严重疾病的患者与短暂性疾病的患者,从而导致干预措施延迟和错过治疗窗口。尽管 Toll 样受体 (TLR) 介导先天 抗病毒药物 免疫并与 重症登革热 发病机制 相关,但它们在关键 DWS 转换窗口(干预可以防止进展为严重疾病的阶段)期间的表达动态仍然完全未知。方法进行了一项综合生物标志物发现研究,包括对公开的单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据 (GSE220969) 进行生物信息学分析,并在中国广东省 45 名登革热患者和 10 名健康对照 (H) 的独立临床 队列研究 中进行实验验证。从 scRNA-seq 数据中鉴定出阶段特异性免疫特征。通过多参数流式细胞术对 TLR 表达进行定量。使用 ROC 曲线分析评估诊断性能,并使用 Spearman 等级相关性评估与临床实验室参数的相关性。结果 23 个细胞簇的生物信息学分析表明,TLR2/4/7/8 表达在 DWS 阶段达到峰值,主要在单核细胞中。流式细胞术证实,与其他阶段相比,DWS 中表面 TLR2 (AUC 0.874) 和 TLR4 (AUC 0.763) 升高,具有区分 DWS 和 SD 的辨别能力 (TLR2: AUC 0.833;TLR4: AUC 0.810)。此外,TLRs表达与临床指标的相关性分析表明,TLR2和TLR4的表达水平与SD的发生发展相关。结论 DWS 期间单核细胞 TLR2/4 表达升高可识别患者在临床失代偿前有进展为 重症登革热 的风险。这些基于机制的生物标志物为流行地区的护理点风险分层提供了基础。

papers.title: A Hybrid Agent-Based Model of Urban Dengue Transmission: City Specific Adaptation and Validation in Santa Marta, Colombia
papers.abstract: Urban transmission of dengue and other Aedes aegypti-borne diseases is shaped by the interaction of vector ecology, human mobility, climate, and spatial heterogeneity. Capturing these interactions in city-specific settings requires models that are detailed enough to represent local transmission processes, while remaining computationally feasible for calibration, validation, and sensitivity analysis. This study presents a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) approach, supported by high-performance computing (HPC), for simulating urban vector-borne disease transmission. Human residents are represented as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics, while mosquito populations are represented at the patch level through discrete-time equations. The model incorporates geospatial structure, temperature, land-use-based human movement, and local contextual information to represent transmission within urban environments. The framework was applied to Santa Marta, Colombia, as a city-specific case study. Transmission parameters were calibrated using surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, and their influence was assessed through sensitivity analysis. High-performance computing made the large number of stochastic simulations required for calibration and sensitivity analysis feasible. The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic, including the peak and early decline. However, the model did not fully reproduce the late low-incidence tail of the season, indicating the need to incorporate external introductions of infection and rainfall-driven seasonal forcing of vector recruitment in future versions. A control scenario run on the calibrated baseline, a 30% reduction in larval carrying capacity, lowered the simulated seasonal attack rate by about three quarters and moved the system below the threshold at which local transmission is self-sustaining, illustrating the relative comparisons the calibrated model supports. This study contributes an adaptable hybrid model architecture and a high-performance implementation that make city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis computationally feasible, demonstrated through a case study in Santa Marta.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Urban dengue transmission involves complex interactions among vector ecology, human mobility, climate, and spatial heterogeneity, but existing models often lack the detail needed for city-specific calibration and validation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) framework with high-performance computing to simulate urban dengue transmission, applying it as a city-specific case study in Santa Marta, Colombia.
analysis.methods: Human residents were modeled as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics, while mosquito populations were represented at the patch level using discrete-time equations, incorporating geospatial structure, temperature, land-use-based human movement, and local contextual information.
analysis.main_results: The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic in Santa Marta, including the peak and early decline, but did not fully capture the late low-incidence tail of the season.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the model’s performance as demonstrating the feasibility of city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis using a hybrid architecture, while noting the need to incorporate external infection introductions and rainfall-driven vector recruitment to improve late-season fit.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted reductions in larval carrying capacity could substantially lower seasonal dengue attack rates and push transmission below self-sustaining thresholds, informing local vector control strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The model’s inability to reproduce the late-season tail and the absence of explicit validation against external introductions limit confidence, warranting a moderate evidence strength despite computational feasibility.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a hybrid agent-based modeling and simulation (HABMS) framework, supported by high-performance computing, to simulate urban dengue transmission in a city-specific context. The model represents human residents as mobile agents with stochastic infection dynamics and mosquito populations at the patch level, integrating geospatial structure, temperature, human movement, and local contextual factors. Applied to Santa Marta, Colombia, the calibrated model reproduced the observed epidemic’s magnitude and seasonal shape, including the peak and early decline, but failed to capture the late low-incidence tail. The authors attribute this gap to unmodeled external infection introductions and rainfall-driven vector recruitment. A control scenario reducing larval carrying capacity by 30% lowered the simulated attack rate by about three quarters and pushed transmission below self-sustaining thresholds. While the framework demonstrates computational feasibility for city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis, limitations include the model’s inability to fully reproduce late-season dynamics and the lack of validation against external introductions, resulting in a moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种具有高性能计算的基于代理的混合建模和模拟 (HABMS) 框架,用于模拟城市登革热 传播,并将其应用于哥伦比亚圣玛尔塔的城市特定案例研究。
elements_zh.methods: 人类居民被建模为具有随机感染动态的移动代理,而蚊子种群则使用离散时间方程在斑块级别上表示,并结合了地理空间结构、温度、基于土地利用的人类运动和当地背景信息。
elements_zh.main_results: 校准模型再现了在圣玛尔塔观察到的登革热疫情的强度和主要季节形状,包括峰值和早期下降,但没有完全捕捉到季节后期的低发病率尾部。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将该模型的性能解释为证明了使用混合架构进行特定于城市的校准和敏感性分析的可行性,同时指出需要结合外部感染引入和降雨驱动的 媒介 招募来改善季末适应性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有针对性地减少幼虫携带能力可以大大降低季节性登革热发病率,并使 传播 低于自我维持阈值,从而为当地的 媒介 控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该模型无法重现季末尾部,并且缺乏针对外部引入的明确验证,这限制了信心,尽管计算可行性,但仍需要适度的证据强度。

The framework was applied to Santa Marta, Colombia, as a city-specific case study. Transmission parameters were calibrated using surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, and their influence was assessed through sensitivity analysis. High-performance computing made the large number of stochastic simulations required for calibration and sensitivity analysis feasible. The calibrated model reproduced the magnitude and main seasonal shape of the observed dengue epidemic, including the peak and early decline. However, the model did not fully reproduce the late low-incidence tail of the season, indicating the need to incorporate external introductions of infection and rainfall-driven seasonal forcing of vector recruitment in future versions. A control scenario run on the calibrated baseline, a 30% reduction in larval carrying capacity, lowered the simulated seasonal attack rate by about three quarters and moved the system below the threshold at which local transmission is self-sustaining, illustrating the relative comparisons the calibrated model supports. This study contributes an adaptable hybrid model architecture and a high-performance implementation that make city-specific calibration and sensitivity analysis computationally feasible, demonstrated through a case study in Santa Marta.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 城市登革热 传播 涉及 媒介 生态、人类流动性、气候和空间异质性之间的复杂相互作用,但现有模型往往缺乏特定城市校准和验证所需的细节。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种具有高性能计算的基于代理的混合建模和模拟 (HABMS) 框架,用于模拟城市登革热 传播,并将其应用于哥伦比亚圣玛尔塔的城市特定案例研究。

analysis_zh.main_results: 校准模型再现了在圣玛尔塔观察到的登革热疫情的强度和主要季节形状,包括峰值和早期下降,但没有完全捕捉到季节后期的低发病率尾部。

papers.title: Obesity in children is associated with increased dengue virus binding, but not neutralizing, antibody responses following primary infection
papers.abstract: Obesity has been associated with higher risk of dengue virus (DENV) infection and disease, yet its influence on antibody responses to DENV remains undefined. We evaluated whether nutritional status -- based on BMI z-score (BMIz) -- or blood markers of body fat -- leptin and adiponectin --are associated with binding and/or neutralizing antibody responses to DENV in 85 children in the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary DENV infection in 2019. Associations were estimated using linear models adjusting for age, sex, and DENV infection outcome. Compared to children with normal weight, those with obesity had higher quantities of DENV binding antibodies (fold-change [FC] 1.89, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies. Likewise, leptin concentration was associated with higher quantities of binding antibodies (FC 1.22, 95%CI 1.09, 1.37), while adiponectin was associated with lower quantities (FC 0.79, 95%CI 0.67, 0.94), and neither was associated with neutralizing antibodies. Lower neutralizing efficiency (neutralizing/binding antibodies) was observed in children with obesity (FC 0.67, 95%CI 0.48, 0.93). Our results indicate that obesity is associated with higher antibody quantity (binding) but not higher quality (neutralization) post-primary DENV infection -- implying that antibodies generated by children with obesity have lower neutralization efficiency, requiring greater quantities to reach similar levels of neutralization than children with normal weight. Further, the agreement among the three models using distinct proxies of body fat -- BMIz, leptin, and adiponectin -- demonstrates that adipokines are useful in supplementing BMIz analysis or as independent predictors of immune responses.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 85 children from the Nicaraguan Pediatric Dengue Cohort Study who experienced a primary DENV infection in 2019, evaluating associations between nutritional status or body fat markers and antibody responses.
analysis.methods: Associations between body mass index z-score (BMIz), leptin, adiponectin, and DENV antibody responses were estimated using linear models adjusted for age, sex, and DENV infection outcome.
analysis.main_results: Children with obesity had 1.89-fold higher DENV binding antibodies (95% CI 1.02, 3.48) but no difference in neutralizing antibodies compared to normal-weight children. Leptin was associated with 1.22-fold higher binding antibodies (95% CI 1.09, 1.37), while adiponectin was associated with 0.79-fold lower binding antibodies (95% CI 0.67, 0.94). Lower neutralizing efficiency was observed in children with obesity (FC 0.67, 95% CI 0.48, 0.93).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that obesity is associated with higher antibody quantity but not higher quality (neutralization) after primary DENV infection, implying reduced neutralization efficiency in children with obesity. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the need to consider nutritional status and adipokine levels in dengue surveillance and vaccine strategies, as obesity may influence antibody-mediated protection and vaccine response heterogeneity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size, single-cohort design, and lack of mechanistic exploration, which constrains generalizability and causal inference. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether obesity and body fat markers (BMI z-score, leptin, adiponectin) influence dengue virus (DENV) antibody responses in 85 children from Nicaragua who experienced primary DENV infection in 2019. Using linear models adjusted for age, sex, and infection outcome, the authors found that children with obesity had significantly higher DENV binding antibody levels but no increase in neutralizing antibodies compared to normal-weight children. Leptin was positively associated with binding antibodies, while adiponectin showed an inverse association, and neither correlated with neutralizing antibodies. Neutralizing efficiency was lower in children with obesity. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that obesity may lead to higher antibody quantity but reduced functional quality, requiring greater antibody levels to achieve similar neutralization. They also suggest adipokines could complement BMIz in predicting immune responses. The study’s small sample size, single-cohort design, and observational nature limit generalizability and causal conclusions, warranting further research.

papers.title: Odorant receptor coexpression and multi-expression in the dengue mosquito
papers.abstract: Drosophila olfactory sensory neurons tend to express a single ligand-specific receptor, following a one-receptor-per-neuron rule expected to apply broadly across insects. Recent work challenges this view by showing that some neurons in the mosquito Aedes aegypti coexpress multiple receptors. However, the full extent and nature of coexpression in Ae. aegypti remains unclear. We sequenced the transcriptomes of 46,000 female antennal neurons to resolve all olfactory neuron subtypes and identify expressed receptors. Half of all subtypes coexpress multiple receptors. However, coexpression occurs almost exclusively among receptors from the same family; cross-family coexpression of odorant receptors with ionotropic receptors is rare. We also document a phenomenon called multi-expression, wherein one receptor is expressed in multiple neuron subtypes, often alongside distant paralogs. Drosophila provides rare examples of both coexpression and multi-expression, suggesting that Drosophila and Aedes are not fundamentally different, but instead located at different positions along a continuum likely to encompass diverse insects. Dengue mosquito olfactory neurons are known to show complex patterns of receptor expression, but the details of this complexity remain unclear. Here, the authors build a comprehensive molecular atlas of antennal neurons, showing that half express multiple receptors and that some receptors are expressed in multiple neurons.

papers.abstract_original: Drosophila olfactory sensory neurons tend to express a single ligand-specific receptor, following a one-receptor-per-neuron rule expected to apply broadly across insects. Recent work challenges this view by showing that some neurons in the mosquito Aedes aegypti coexpress multiple receptors. However, the full extent and nature of coexpression in Ae. aegypti remains unclear. We sequenced the transcriptomes of 46,000 female antennal neurons to resolve all olfactory neuron subtypes and identify expressed receptors. Half of all subtypes coexpress multiple receptors. However, coexpression occurs almost exclusively among receptors from the same family; cross-family coexpression of odorant receptors with ionotropic receptors is rare. We also document a phenomenon called multi-expression, wherein one receptor is expressed in multiple neuron subtypes, often alongside distant paralogs. Drosophila provides rare examples of both coexpression and multi-expression, suggesting that Drosophila and Aedes are not fundamentally different, but instead located at different positions along a continuum likely to encompass diverse insects. Dengue mosquito olfactory neurons are known to show complex patterns of receptor expression, but the details of this complexity remain unclear. Here, the authors build a comprehensive molecular atlas of antennal neurons, showing that half express multiple receptors and that some receptors are expressed in multiple neurons.

papers.title: Prognosis of vector borne dengue disease outbreak in urban areas using multivariate analysis
papers.abstract: Vector borne disease like dengue continues to pose a significant climate-sensitive public health challenge in tropical regions such as Brazil, Peru, and India. This study examines the feasibility of predicting dengue outbreaks using weekly multivariate time-series data from San Juan (SJ), Puerto Rico and Iquitos (IQ), Peru. Dengue incidence was analyzed alongside meteorological, environmental, and vegetation-based variables to capture key climatic influences. Several machine learning and deep learning approaches were evaluated, including LightGBM. Model performance was assessed using root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE). The results show that LightGBM achieved the low est RMSE/MAE, indicating strong short-term predictive accuracy and excellent interpretability. Feature importance analysis and principal component analysis (PCA) identified precipitation, dew point temperature, and humidity as the most influential predictors of dengue incidence. The study demonstrates that advanced machine learning models can serve as reliable early warning systems for vector-borne diseases. While this research focuses on dengue, the methodology is adaptable to other vector-bone datasets and diseases, offering a flexible tool for public health authorities to predict and mitigate outbreaks in diverse urban contexts.

papers.title: REFLEXÕES SOBRE A INFLUÊNCIA DE FATORES METEOROLÓGICOS E DE SANEAMENTO AMBIENTAL NA OCORRÊNCIA DA DENGUE REFLECTIONS ON THE INFLUENCE OF METEOROLOGICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL SANITATION FACTORS ON THE OCCURRENCE OF DENGUE REFLEXIONES SOBRE LA INFLUENCIA DE LOS FACTORES METEOROLÓGICOS Y DE SANEAMIENTO AMBIENTAL EN LA APARICIÓN DEL DENGUE
papers.abstract: Introdução: A dengue é uma das arboviroses de maior persistência com impacto global, cuja ocorrência da doença é potencializada por condições climáticas e precariedade do saneamento ambiental que favorecem o ciclo de vida do mosquito transmissor Aedes aegypti. Objetivo: Este texto tem por objetivo relatar a experiência de uma ação de extensão universitária voltada à educação básica para discutir a influência de fatores ambientais na ocorrência da dengue. Metodologia: Foi planejada uma ação de extensão para o desenvolvimento de atividades educativas no formato de palestra voltada para estudantes da rede pública de ensino, no município de Feira de Santana-Ba. Atividade foi estruturada a partir do levantamento de materiais didáticos para implementação da palestra, que ocorreu de forma dialogada, foi proposto à aplicação de quiz interativo; e mapeamento socioambiental via questionário, além da utilização de materiais informativos como folders, para ampliar o acesso a informações oficiais além da palestra. Resultados: Atividade demonstrou alta potencialidade pedagógica, sobretudo quanto aplicação do quiz que promoveu intensa participação espontânea. Os relatos dos estudantes revelam um cenário de vulnerabilidade quanto as condições de saneamento ambiental que rodeiam suas moradias. Além disso, observou-se baixa adesão ao questionário escrito impossibilitando uma análise quantitativa. Conclusão: Diante dos resultados a ação de extensão mostrou-se uma estratégia eficaz para a promoção da conscientização e combate ao mosquito transmissor da dengue no âmbito escolar, favorecendo a ampliação do conhecimento e dos seus fatores condicionantes. Dessa forma, evidencia-se a importância da integração entre universidade e escola na construção de ações educativas contínuas, para compreensão e redução dos fatores de risco associados à doença.

source_records.abstract: Introdução: A dengue é uma das arboviroses de maior persistência com impacto global, cuja ocorrência da doença é potencializada por condições climáticas e precariedade do saneamento ambiental que favorecem o ciclo de vida do mosquito transmissor Aedes aegypti. Objetivo: Este texto tem por objetivo relatar a experiência de uma ação de extensão universitária voltada à educação básica para discutir a influência de fatores ambientais na ocorrência da dengue. Metodologia: Foi planejada uma ação de extensão para o desenvolvimento de atividades educativas no formato de palestra voltada para estudantes da rede pública de ensino, no município de Feira de Santana-Ba. Atividade foi estruturada a partir do levantamento de materiais didáticos para implementação da palestra, que ocorreu de forma dialogada, foi proposto à aplicação de quiz interativo; e mapeamento socioambiental via questionário, além da utilização de materiais informativos como folders, para ampliar o acesso a informações oficiais além da palestra. Resultados: Atividade demonstrou alta potencialidade pedagógica, sobretudo quanto aplicação do quiz que promoveu intensa participação espontânea. Os relatos dos estudantes revelam um cenário de vulnerabilidade quanto as condições de saneamento ambiental que rodeiam suas moradias. Além disso, observou-se baixa adesão ao questionário escrito impossibilitando uma análise quantitativa. Conclusão: Diante dos resultados a ação de extensão mostrou-se uma estratégia eficaz para a promoção da conscientização e combate ao mosquito transmissor da dengue no âmbito escolar, favorecendo a ampliação do conhecimento e dos seus fatores condicionantes. Dessa forma, evidencia-se a importância da integração entre universidade e escola na construção de ações educativas contínuas, para compreensão e redução dos fatores de risco associados à doença.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the persistent global burden of dengue, a mosquito-borne arboviral disease, and highlights environmental sanitation deficits and climatic conditions as drivers of Aedes aegypti proliferation and transmission. It frames the need for educational interventions to raise awareness of these risk factors among school-aged populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study reports a university extension activity conducted as an educational lecture for public school students in Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil. The activity targeted basic education settings to discuss environmental factors influencing dengue occurrence.
analysis.methods: The intervention consisted of a dialogic lecture supplemented by interactive quiz activities, socio-environmental mapping via questionnaire, and distribution of informational folders. Materials were prepared and delivered to enhance access to official information beyond the lecture format.
analysis.main_results: The activity demonstrated high pedagogical potential, particularly through the interactive quiz that elicited spontaneous participation. However, low adherence to the written questionnaire prevented quantitative analysis of socio-environmental conditions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the activity as an effective strategy for raising awareness and combating the dengue vector within schools, expanding knowledge of risk factors. They emphasize the novelty of integrating university and school efforts to foster continuous educational actions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that school-based educational interventions can enhance community understanding of dengue risk factors and support vector control efforts. They underscore the value of partnerships between universities and schools for sustained public health education.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s evidence strength is limited by the absence of quantitative data due to low questionnaire response rates and the lack of target-specific laboratory or epidemiological measurements. The design restricts generalizability beyond the local educational context.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes a university-led educational intervention in Feira de Santana, Brazil, aimed at raising awareness among public school students about environmental and sanitation factors influencing dengue transmission. The activity combined a dialogic lecture with an interactive quiz, socio-environmental questionnaires, and informational materials. While the quiz demonstrated strong pedagogical engagement, low questionnaire response rates precluded quantitative analysis of local sanitation vulnerabilities. The authors conclude that such school-based initiatives effectively promote dengue vector control awareness and knowledge of risk factors, advocating for sustained university–school partnerships. However, the evidence is constrained by the absence of quantitative data and target-specific measurements, limiting broader public health inferences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了登革热(一种蚊媒虫媒病毒性疾病)在全球范围内持续造成的负担,并强调环境卫生缺陷和气候条件是埃及伊蚊扩散和 传播 的驱动因素。它提出了教育干预的必要性,以提高学龄人口对这些风险因素的认识。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究报告了在巴西巴伊亚州费拉德桑塔纳为公立学校学生举办的一项大学推广活动,作为教育讲座。该活动针对基础教育环境,讨论影响登革热发生的环境因素。
elements_zh.methods: 干预措施包括对话讲座,辅以互动测验活动、通过问卷绘制社会环境图以及分发信息文件夹。材料的准备和交付是为了增强对讲座形式之外的官方信息的获取。
elements_zh.main_results: 该活动展示了很高的教学潜力,特别是通过引发自发参与的互动测验。然而,对书面调查问卷的遵守率较低,阻碍了对社会环境条件的定量分析。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此活动解释为在学校内提高认识和抗击登革热 媒介、扩大对危险因素的了解的有效策略。他们强调整合大学和学校的努力以促进持续教育行动的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,以学校为基础的教育干预措施可以增强社区对登革热危险因素的了解,并支持 媒介 控制工作。他们强调大学和学校之间的伙伴关系对于持续公共卫生教育的价值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于问卷答复率低以及缺乏针对具体目标的实验室或流行病学测量,导致缺乏定量数据,该研究的证据强度受到限制。该设计限制了当地教育背景之外的普遍性。

papers.title: A LUDICIDADE NA PREVENÇÃO DA DENGUE EM ESCOLARES: RELATO DE EXPERIÊNCIA DE CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO EM CURITIBA PLAYFUL APPROACHES TO DENGUE PREVENTION IN SCHOOLCHILDREN: AN ACCOUNT OF CURRICULAR EXTENSION EXPERIENCE IN CURITIBA
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a significant public health problem in Brazil, requiring ongoing health education strategies for vulnerable populations. This article reports a health education extension experience focused on dengue prevention, conducted with 32 second-grade elementary school students at Escola Municipal Irati, in the Cajuru neighborhood of Curitiba, during the first semester of 2024, linked to the Teaching and Community Integration curricular unit of the Medicine course at Faculdades Pequeno Principe. The intervention combined a dialogued conversation with a playful activity called Dengue Informant, in which children identified Aedes aegypti breeding sites across the school yard. Good adherence, progressive understanding of preventive behaviors, and high engagement were observed. The experience highlighted the potential of playful methodologies for child health promotion and reinforced the role of curricular extension in shaping socially committed medical professionals.
