papers.title: Kiến thức, thực hành về phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết dengue của sinh viên nội trú Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge and practices on dengue Fever Prevention among Domitory Students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025
papers.abstract: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 402 sin h viên nội tr ú Trường Đại h ọc Y H à Nội nhằm mô tảkiế n thức và thực hành phòng chống sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD). Dữ liệu được thu thập bằng bảnghỏi trực tuyến và phân tích bằng thống kê mô tả kết hợp với phân tích nhân tố khám phá. Kết quả cho thấy53,5% sinh viên có kiến thức tốt, trong khi chỉ 13,2% có thực hành phòng bệnh tốt. Phần lớn sinh viênbiết các biện pháp phòng chống SXHD như bôi thuốc chống muỗi (86,1%), mặc quần áo dài (79,1%), ngủmàn chống muỗi (74,1%), kiểm tra dụng cụ chứa nước (84,3%), thu gom phế thải (83,6%) và lật úp dụngcụ chứa nước (81,8%). Tuy nhiên, kiến thức về sử dụng hóa chất diệt bọ gậy còn hạn chế (49,0%). Phântích nhân tố khám phá xác định 3 nhóm thực hành gồm: “Thực hành phòng chống chủ động”, “Kiểm soátmuỗi và bọ gậy” và “Phòng tránh cá nhân”, với điểm trung bình từ 2,0 đến 2,9. Các thực hành được thựchiện ở mức “rất thường xuyên” với tỷ lệ cao hơn là ngủ màn vào ban đêm (12,4%), cọ rửa dụng cụ chứanước (11,2%), mặc quần áo dài và lật úp dụng cụ chứa nước (9,5%). Ngược lại, thả hóa chất diệt bọ gậyvào dụng cụ đọng nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất, chỉ 2,7%. Kết quả cho thấy mặc dù hơn một nửa sinh viên cókiến thức tốt, thực hành phòng chống SXHD vẫn còn hạn chế. Do đó, cần tăng cường giáo dục sức khỏevà các chiến lược thay đổi hành vi để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng bền vững các biện pháp phòng ngừa sốt xuấthuyết trong sinh viên đại học.

papers.title_original: Kiến thức, thực hành về phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết dengue của sinh viên nội trú Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge and practices on dengue Fever Prevention among Domitory Students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of dengue fever among university students in Hanoi by assessing knowledge and practices for its prevention. It aimed to describe current levels of dengue-related knowledge and preventive practices among dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 402 dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025. Data were collected using an online questionnaire and analyzed with descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis.
analysis.methods: An online questionnaire was used to collect data on knowledge and practices regarding dengue prevention. Descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis were applied to categorize and interpret the responses.
analysis.main_results: 53.5% of students demonstrated good knowledge of dengue prevention, while only 13.2% exhibited good preventive practices. Commonly known measures included using mosquito repellent (86.1%), wearing long clothing (79.1%), using bed nets (74.1%), checking water containers (84.3%), waste collection (83.6%), and turning over water containers (81.8%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Despite high awareness of preventive measures, actual practice levels were low, indicating a gap between knowledge and behavior. The study identified three practice domains: active prevention, mosquito and larval control, and personal protection, with average scores ranging from 2.0 to 2.9.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for targeted health education and behavior-change strategies to improve the adoption of dengue prevention measures among university students in Hanoi.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit causal inference and may introduce reporting bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the single-center setting and lack of validation of reported practices.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated knowledge and preventive practices against dengue fever among 402 dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025. Using an online questionnaire and descriptive statistics with exploratory factor analysis, it found that 53.5% of students had good knowledge of dengue prevention, but only 13.2% demonstrated good preventive practices. While students were aware of measures such as using mosquito repellent (86.1%), wearing long clothing (79.1%), and using bed nets (74.1%), actual practice levels were low. The study identified three practice domains: active prevention, mosquito and larval control, and personal protection, with average scores between 2.0 and 2.9. Despite high awareness, the gap between knowledge and practice underscores the need for targeted health education and behavior-change interventions to promote sustainable dengue prevention among university students.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,对河内医科大学402名宿舍学生进行了一项横断面研究。通过在线问卷收集数据,并通过描述性统计和探索性因素分析进行​​分析。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of dengue fever among university students in Hanoi by assessing knowledge and practices for its prevention. It aimed to describe current levels of dengue-related knowledge and preventive practices among dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 402 dormitory students at Hanoi Medical University in 2025. Data were collected using an online questionnaire and analyzed with descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis.
analysis_en.methods: An online questionnaire was used to collect data on knowledge and practices regarding dengue prevention. Descriptive statistics and exploratory factor analysis were applied to categorize and interpret the responses.
analysis_en.main_results: 53.5% of students demonstrated good knowledge of dengue prevention, while only 13.2% exhibited good preventive practices. Commonly known measures included using mosquito repellent (86.1%), wearing long clothing (79.1%), using bed nets (74.1%), checking water containers (84.3%), waste collection (83.6%), and turning over water containers (81.8%).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Despite high awareness of preventive measures, actual practice levels were low, indicating a gap between knowledge and behavior. The study identified three practice domains: active prevention, mosquito and larval control, and personal protection, with average scores ranging from 2.0 to 2.9.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for targeted health education and behavior-change strategies to improve the adoption of dengue prevention measures among university students in Hanoi.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit causal inference and may introduce reporting bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the single-center setting and lack of validation of reported practices.

papers.source_body_en: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 402 sin h viên nội tr ú Trường Đại h ọc Y H à Nội nhằm mô tảkiế n thức và thực hành phòng chống sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD). Dữ liệu được thu thập bằng bảnghỏi trực tuyến và phân tích bằng thống kê mô tả kết hợp với phân tích nhân tố khám phá. Kết quả cho thấy53,5% sinh viên có kiến thức tốt, trong khi chỉ 13,2% có thực hành phòng bệnh tốt. Phần lớn sinh viênbiết các biện pháp phòng chống SXHD như bôi thuốc chống muỗi (86,1%), mặc quần áo dài (79,1%), ngủmàn chống muỗi (74,1%), kiểm tra dụng cụ chứa nước (84,3%), thu gom phế thải (83,6%) và lật úp dụngcụ chứa nước (81,8%). Tuy nhiên, kiến thức về sử dụng hóa chất diệt bọ gậy còn hạn chế (49,0%). Phântích nhân tố khám phá xác định 3 nhóm thực hành gồm: “Thực hành phòng chống chủ động”, “Kiểm soátmuỗi và bọ gậy” và “Phòng tránh cá nhân”, với điểm trung bình từ 2,0 đến 2,9. Các thực hành được thựchiện ở mức “rất thường xuyên” với tỷ lệ cao hơn là ngủ màn vào ban đêm (12,4%), cọ rửa dụng cụ chứanước (11,2%), mặc quần áo dài và lật úp dụng cụ chứa nước (9,5%). Ngược lại, thả hóa chất diệt bọ gậyvào dụng cụ đọng nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất, chỉ 2,7%. Kết quả cho thấy mặc dù hơn một nửa sinh viên cókiến thức tốt, thực hành phòng chống SXHD vẫn còn hạn chế. Do đó, cần tăng cường giáo dục sức khỏevà các chiến lược thay đổi hành vi để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng bền vững các biện pháp phòng ngừa sốt xuấthuyết trong sinh viên đại học.

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends a layered diagnostic strategy for CHIKV in co-endemic settings: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, and cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance, with a focus on strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing in African settings such as Nigeria.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses serological cross-reactivity challenges in diagnosing Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in co-endemic regions where multiple arboviruses circulate. It introduces a framework distinguishing biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification, noting that CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with related alphaviruses like O'nyong-nyong, Mayaro, and Ross River viruses, supported by functional cross-neutralisation. However, CHIKV reactivity in dengue or Zika virus-associated sera lacks biological basis and is classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity. The review underscores that unadjusted seropositivity can distort CHIKV transmission estimates and that no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity across all virus pairs. It advocates for a multi-layered diagnostic approach—molecular testing acutely, antigenically informed multiplex serology subsequently, neutralisation-based confirmation when necessary, and statistical modelling that accounts for cross-reactivity—with emphasis on improving assay validation and confirmatory testing in high-risk regions such as Nigeria.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述研究了在共流行环境中影响基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 诊断的血清学交叉反应性,重点关注病原体 CHIKV、其疾病表现,以及如何改进基于抗体的检测以避免在多种虫媒病毒共同传播的地区发生错误分类的核心问题。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,使用 CHIKV 和相关甲病毒(包括 CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong 病毒 (ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV) 和 CHIKV-Ross River 病毒 (RRV))研究的证据区分了三种现象——生物交叉反应性、检测相关的非靶标反应性和诊断错误分类,同时指出 CHIKV 反应性缺乏生物学基础。登革病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,CHIKV 与 ONNV、MAYV 和 RRV 具有相同的抗原结构,并得到多项研究中共享的甲病毒抗原结构和功能性交叉中和的支持,而 DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中的 CHIKV 反应性在没有既定生物学基础的情况下,更好地归类为与检测相关的非靶标反应性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调,未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的交叉反应性,特别是在多种虫媒病毒一起传播的共流行环境中。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议在共流行环境下对 CHIKV 采取分层诊断策略:急性期进行分子检测,之后进行抗原信息和多重 血清学,基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),以及 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型,重点是加强尼日利亚等非洲地区的测定验证和确认性测试。

papers.title: Molecular and biophysical requirements for B cell receptor-dependent enhancement of dengue virus infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the molecular and biophysical mechanisms underlying B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Dengue virus is a significant public health burden, and immune-mediated enhancement, particularly antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), is a key factor in disease severity. The research identifies that DENV entry into B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and occurs in late endosomes. Immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are shown to support active viral replication of all four serotypes, suggesting BDE complements existing models of ADE. The findings offer new insights into DENV immunopathogenesis and may help explain why some individuals progress to severe dengue. The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits detailed analysis but supports a high confidence assessment due to the direct observation of DENV interactions with B cells.

papers.title_zh: B 细胞受体依赖性增强 登革病毒 感染的分子和生物物理要求
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is the causative agent of dengue, a mosquito-borne disease that represents a significant and growing public health burden around the world. A unique pathophysiological feature of dengue is immune-mediated enhancement, wherein preexisting immunity elicited by a primary infection can enhance the severity of a subsequent infection by a heterologous DENV serotype. A leading mechanistic explanation for this phenomenon is antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), where sub-neutralizing concentrations of DENV-specific IgG antibodies facilitate the entry of DENV into FcγR-expressing cells. Accordingly, this model posits that phagocytic mononuclear cells are the primary reservoir of DENV. However, multiple independent groups have shown that B cells are the largest reservoir of virally infected cells in circulation during acute dengue, representing a disconnect in our understanding of immune-mediated DENV tropism. In response to this persistent knowledge gap, our team has previously identified a novel mechanism of immune-mediated enhancement we have termed B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement (BDE) of DENV infection. In this study, we show that DENV infection of DENV-reactive B cells is highly sensitive to BCR/DENV envelope (E) protein interactions. DENV entry into this subset of B cells is dynamin-mediated, requires proximal BCR signaling, and involves localization to late endosomes. Finally, we show that immortalized DENV-reactive B cells are productively infected by live DENV, capable of supporting active viral replication of all four serotypes. We propose that BDE provides an additional layer of pathogen-specific immune-mediated infection risk that complements existing models of ADE and offers additional insight into potential mechanisms of DENV immunopathogenesis. IMPORTANCE This study provides mechanistic insight into the process of B cell receptor (BCR)-dependent enhancement of dengue virus (DENV) infection. Immune-mediated enhancement of infection is a cornerstone of dengue immunopathogenesis and is most often attributed to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). BCR-dependent enhancement of DENV infection is an alternative and complementary mechanism for immune-mediated enhancement that addresses several persistent knowledge gaps in the dengue field and may offer mechanistic insight into why some people progress to severe dengue after infection.

papers.title: Characteristic skin rash among patients with dengue fever: case series
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever (DF) is caused by the dengue virus, which manifests with systemic features such as fever, malaise, and headache. More than 50% of cases present with a variety of skin lesions. Case Presentation: We present a series of three cases that presented to the clinic with fever associated with gastrointestinal symptoms, including nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Other systematic reviews were unremarkable. The patients subsequently developed a pruritic skin rash characterized by diffuse confluent erythema with petechiae and rounded islands of sparing. After excluding alternative etiologies such as malaria, HIV, and hepatitis C, all three patients were diagnosed with DF. Conclusion: This case series highlights the presence of a characteristic rash in DF. We emphasize the clinical description of this cutaneous manifestation, which is not well-described in previous literature. Although cutaneous manifestations are common in dengue, identifying these specific rash patterns can contribute to accurate and early diagnosis. Patients presenting with fever and rashes in an endemic area should be suspected of having DF.

papers.title: Virus del dengue: estructura, patogenia, respuesta inmunitaria, diagnóstico y vacunas
papers.abstract: Introducción: El dengue constituye una de las arbovirosis de mayor impacto en la salud pública mundial. Objetivo: Analizar la evidencia científica reciente sobre la estructura, patogenia, respuesta inmunitaria, diagnóstico y vacunas del virus del dengue. Método: Se realizó una revisión documental descriptiva y analítica mediante la búsqueda en PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, SciELO, Dialnet, Redalyc y ERIC, con selección de 20 estudios según el protocolo PRISMA. Resultados: Se evidenció que las proteínas estructurales y no estructurales del virus cumplen funciones esenciales en la replicación y la evasión inmunitaria, que la potenciación dependiente de anticuerpos y la disfunción endotelial son determinantes en el dengue grave, y que las pruebas moleculares y el antígeno NS1 permiten el diagnóstico temprano. Conclusión: El control efectivo del dengue requiere estrategias integrales que combinen vigilancia, diagnóstico, control vectorial y vacunación.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the significant public health impact of dengue and the need for updated scientific understanding of its structure, pathogenesis, immune response, diagnosis and vaccines. The research was motivated by the global burden of dengue disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study conducted a descriptive and analytical documentary review, selecting 20 studies based on the PRISMA protocol. It focused on dengue virus and related aspects of dengue disease.
analysis.methods: The authors performed a documentary review using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, SciELO, Dialnet, Redalyc and ERIC databases. They followed the PRISMA protocol to select and analyze 20 studies.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that structural and non-structural proteins of the dengue virus are essential for replication and immune evasion. Antibody-dependent enhancement and endothelial dysfunction were identified as key factors in severe dengue. Molecular tests and NS1 antigen detection enable early diagnosis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the importance of understanding the virus's structure and immune interactions to develop effective strategies for dengue control. This study provides a comprehensive overview of current scientific knowledge on dengue.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, early diagnosis and vaccine development efforts for dengue. They emphasize the need for integrated approaches to manage the disease effectively.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a review of existing literature and does not include original data. The evidence is strong due to the systematic selection of studies using PRISMA, but it may not capture the most recent developments.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides a comprehensive review of the scientific evidence on the dengue virus, focusing on its structure, pathogenesis, immune response, diagnosis and vaccines. The authors conducted a descriptive and analytical documentary review of 20 studies selected via the PRISMA protocol, highlighting the essential roles of structural and non-structural proteins in viral replication and immune evasion. They also identified antibody-dependent enhancement and endothelial dysfunction as critical factors in severe dengue and emphasized the importance of molecular tests and NS1 antigen detection for early diagnosis. The study concludes that effective dengue control requires integrated strategies involving surveillance, diagnosis, vector control and vaccination. The findings are significant for advancing understanding and management of dengue but are limited to a literature review without original data. The evidence is strong due to the systematic approach, but it may not fully capture recent advancements in the field.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究进行了描述性和分析性文献综述,根据 PRISMA 协议选择了 20 项研究。它重点关注 登革病毒 和登革热疾病的相关方面。
elements_zh.methods: 作者使用 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、SciELO、Dialnet、Redalyc 和 ERIC 数据库进行了文献综述。他们按照 PRISMA 协议选择并分析了 20 项研究。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,登革病毒 的结构和非结构蛋白对于复制和免疫逃避至关重要。抗体依赖性增强 和内皮功能障碍被确定为 重症登革热 的关键因素。分子测试和 NS1 抗原检测可实现早期 诊断。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调了解病毒结构和免疫相互作用对于制定有效的登革热控制策略的重要性。这项研究全面概述了当前有关登革热的科学知识。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 监测、早期 诊断 和 疫苗 登革热的开发工作提供信息。他们强调需要采取综合方法来有效管理该疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于对现有文献的回顾,不包括原始数据。由于使用 PRISMA 系统地选择了研究,因此证据很充分,但它可能无法反映最新的进展。

papers.title: Ecoregion-specific dengue risk prediction in Peru using remote sensing, machine learning, and spatiotemporal modeling
papers.abstract: : Dengue fever has been a significant public health issue in Peru due to its highly localized and cyclical nature and to changes in the environment, demography, and climate. While many existing models can assess dengue risk at the country level, they often fail to account for the fine-scale landscape variation that drives varying transmission rates. We developed a spatiotemporal dengue risk model at a 1 km spatial resolution by integrating high-resolution climatic, land-cover, and demographic variables across 20 years (2003-2022) of dengue surveillance data. Tree-based approaches achieved higher predictive accuracy than linear models, with XGBoost achieving the highest R 2 value of 0.68. Additionally, model performance increased when spatially and temporally lagged predictors were included. Land surface temperature and precipitation showed strong neighborhood effects on dengue suitability. Specifically, there exists a strong spatial dependency in model validation across 14 ecoregions, with Amazon moist forest and transitional Yungas yielding high predictive accuracy (R 2 = 0.78), while high-altitude Andean Puna and coastal mangrove zones had poor predictive accuracy, performing worse than the mean prediction, suggesting non-climatic factors such as human mobility and imported transmission also play a role in dengue infection and transmissions. Overall, the predictability of dengue is strongly dependent on the ecoregion where it occurs, with national-level averages masking local dynamics. Our research demonstrates the potential for scalable high-resolution risk mapping when combined with ecoregion-specific performance metrics to predict and inform targeted vector control and public health interventions for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases.

papers.abstract_zh: :由于其高度局部化和周期性以及环境、人口和气候的变化,登革热 一直是秘鲁的一个重大公共卫生问题。虽然许多现有模型可以评估国家一级的登革热风险,但它们往往无法考虑导致 传播 发生率变化的精细景观变化。我们通过整合 20 年(2003-2022 年)登革热 监测 数据的高分辨率气候、土地覆盖和人口变量,开发了 1 公里空间分辨率的时空登革热风险模型。基于树的方法比线性模型实现了更高的预测精度,XGBoost 实现了最高 R 2 值 0.68。此外,当包含空间和时间滞后的预测变量时,模型性能会提高。地表温度和降水对登革热适宜性表现出强烈的邻域效应。具体而言,14个生态区的模型验证存在很强的空间依赖性,其中亚马逊潮湿森林和过渡性云加斯地区的预测精度较高(R 2 = 0.78),而高海拔安第斯普纳和沿海红树林区的预测精度较差,表现差于平均预测,这表明人口流动和进口传播等非气候因素也在登革热感染和传播中发挥作用。总体而言,登革热的可预测性在很大程度上取决于其发生的生态区,国家水平的平均值掩盖了当地的动态。我们的研究表明,与特定生态区域的绩效指标相结合,可进行可扩展的高分辨率风险测绘,以预测和告知针对气候敏感型 媒介 传播疾病的有针对性的 媒介 控制和公共卫生干预措施。

papers.title: Efektivitas Kompres Hangat dan Tepid Water Sponge pada Anak dengan Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever: Studi Kasus
papers.abstract: Pendahuluan: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) merupakan penyakit infeksi yang banyak menyerang anak dan ditandai dengan demam tinggi. Selain terapi farmakologis, intervensi non-farmakologis seperti kompres hangat dan teknik tepid sponge sering digunakan, namun bukti perbandingan efektivitas keduanya masih terbatas. Tujuan: Tujuan studi kasus ini adalah untuk mengetahui perbedaan efektivitas kompres hangat konvensional dan teknik tepid sponge dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh pada anak dengan DHF. Metode: Desain studi kasus deskriptif komparatif pada dua pasien anak dengan DHF yang di ruang rawat inap RS Indriati Solo Baru. Masing-masing pasien diberikan intervensi berbeda selama tiga hari. Pengukuran suhu tubuh dilakukan sebelum dan sesudah intervensi menggunakan termometer digital, serta respon subjektif dan objektif dicatat melalui lembar observasi. Analisis data dilakukan secara deskriptif dengan membandingkan perubahan suhu tubuh antar intervensi. Hasil: Kedua intervensi terbukti efektif menurunkan suhu tubuh. Pada pasien dengan kompres hangat, suhu menurun dari 38,9°C menjadi 37,2°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 0,87°C. Pada pasien dengan tepid sponge, suhu menurun dari 39,7°C menjadi 37,4°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 1,20°C. Respon klinis menunjukkan perbaikan kondisi, termasuk penurunan nadi dan peningkatan aktivitas. Simpulan: Teknik tepid sponge lebih efektif dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh dibandingkan kompres hangat, meskipun kompres hangat lebih nyaman bagi pasien anak.

Selain terapi farmakologis, intervensi non-farmakologis seperti kompres hangat dan teknik tepid sponge sering digunakan, namun bukti perbandingan efektivitas keduanya masih terbatas. Tujuan: Tujuan studi kasus ini adalah untuk mengetahui perbedaan efektivitas kompres hangat konvensional dan teknik tepid sponge dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh pada anak dengan DHF. Metode: Desain studi kasus deskriptif komparatif pada dua pasien anak dengan DHF yang di ruang rawat inap RS Indriati Solo Baru. Masing-masing pasien diberikan intervensi berbeda selama tiga hari. Pengukuran suhu tubuh dilakukan sebelum dan sesudah intervensi menggunakan termometer digital, serta respon subjektif dan objektif dicatat melalui lembar observasi. Analisis data dilakukan secara deskriptif dengan membandingkan perubahan suhu tubuh antar intervensi. Hasil: Kedua intervensi terbukti efektif menurunkan suhu tubuh. Pada pasien dengan kompres hangat, suhu menurun dari 38,9°C menjadi 37,2°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 0,87°C. Pada pasien dengan tepid sponge, suhu menurun dari 39,7°C menjadi 37,4°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 1,20°C. Respon klinis menunjukkan perbaikan kondisi, termasuk penurunan nadi dan peningkatan aktivitas. Simpulan: Teknik tepid sponge lebih efektif dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh dibandingkan kompres hangat, meskipun kompres hangat lebih nyaman bagi pasien anak.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) merupakan penyakit infeksi yang banyak menyerang anak dan ditandai dengan demam tinggi. Studi ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui perbedaan efektivitas kompres hangat konvensional dan teknik tepid sponge dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh pada anak dengan DHF.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Studi kasus ini menggunakan desain deskriptif komparatif pada dua pasien anak dengan DHF yang dirawat di ruang rawat inap RS Indriati Solo Baru. Masing-masing pasien diberikan intervensi berbeda selama tiga hari.
analysis.methods: Pengukuran suhu tubuh dilakukan sebelum dan sesudah intervensi menggunakan termometer digital, serta respon subjektif dan objektif dicatat melalui lembar observasi. Analisis data dilakukan secara deskriptif dengan membandingkan perubahan suhu tubuh antar intervensi.
analysis.main_results: Kedua intervensi terbukti efektif menurunkan suhu tubuh. Pada pasien dengan kompres hangat, suhu menurun dari 38,9°C menjadi 37,2°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 0,87°C. Pada pasien dengan tepid sponge, suhu menurun dari 39,7°C menjadi 37,4°C dengan rata-rata penurunan 1,20°C.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Teknik tepid sponge lebih efektif dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh dibandingkan kompres hangat, meskipun kompres hangat lebih nyaman bagi pasien anak.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Temuan ini dapat memberikan informasi untuk memilih metode pengobatan non-farmakologis yang lebih efektif dalam menurunkan suhu tubuh pada anak dengan DHF, sehingga dapat meningkatkan manajemen klinis dan kenyamanan pasien.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Studi ini memiliki ukuran sampel kecil dan tidak mencakup analisis statistik formal, sehingga kekuatan bukti terbatas. Namun, hasilnya menunjukkan perbedaan efektivitas antara kedua intervensi dengan dasar pengamatan langsung.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare the effectiveness of warm compress and tepid sponge techniques in reducing body temperature in children with Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF). It was a descriptive comparative case study conducted on two patients at RS Indriati Solo Baru. Each patient received a different intervention over three days, with body temperature measured before and after using a digital thermometer. Subjective and objective responses were recorded via an observation sheet. Both interventions were found effective, with tepid sponge showing a greater reduction in temperature (from 39.7°C to 37.4°C, average decrease of 1.20°C) compared to warm compress (from 38.9°C to 37.2°C, average decrease of 0.87°C). The authors concluded that tepid sponge is more effective in lowering body temperature in children with DHF, although warm compress is more comfortable. The study's small sample size and lack of formal statistical analysis limit the strength of the evidence, but the findings provide practical insights for clinical management of DHF in pediatric patients.

papers.title: Intrauterine exposure to the dengue virus and the neurodevelopment of offspring
papers.abstract: Dengue is the most widespread and rapidly growing vector-borne infectious disease. It is estimated 2.5 billion people across 129 countries live in tropical and subtropical regions where the disease is endemic and are at risk of contracting dengue. An estimated 105 million people are infected worldwide each year. Many studies have reported associations between exposure to dengue virus infection and gestational complications. Similarly, there is evidence linking dengue to impaired placental blood flow and compromised fetal development, including the formation of fetal nervous system structures. Furthermore, it has been proposed that infection-related Maternal Immune Activation (MIA) increases the risk of neurodevelopmental disorders. Thus, this study is justified by the need to gather and compile data on the impact of dengue during pregnancy on offspring neurodevelopment, providing scientific evidence to inform the care of children exposed to DENV in utero. The objective is to map the evidence in the literature regarding intrauterine exposure to DENV and structural and functional neurodevelopmental outcomes in the offspring. Given the context presented, children exposed to DENV during gestation are expected to be at higher risk of neurodevelopmental delays compared to unexposed children.

papers.title: Strain-Specific Reduction of Ndel1 Enzymatic Activity During Early Zika Virus Infection in the Neonatal Brain
papers.abstract: Zika virus (ZIKV) infection during early development is associated with severe neurodevelopmental impairment, including congenital microcephaly, yet the molecular mechanisms linking viral exposure to neuronal dysfunction remain incompletely understood. Ndel1 (nudE neurodevelopment protein 1 like 1) is an oligopeptidase critically involved in neuronal migration, neurite outgrowth, and cytoskeletal dynamics, processes essential for proper brain development. Building on previous observations that Ndel1 enzymatic activity is reduced in ZIKV-infected embryonic and neonatal brains, we investigated whether this modulation represents a conserved host response or a strain-specific molecular effect. Using a neonatal intracerebroventricular infection model in Swiss mice at postnatal day 0, we compared the effects of a Brazilian ZIKV strain (ZIKV BR ), an African lineage strain (ZIKV AF ), and dengue virus (DENV) on Ndel1 regulation in the brain. We found that Ndel1 enzymatic activity was significantly reduced at early post-infection time points (P3 and P7) exclusively in ZIKV BR -infected animals, whereas ZIKV AF and DENV did not alter enzyme activity relative to controls. Notably, at the earliest timepoint (P3), this reduction occurred in the absence of changes in Ndel1 mRNA expression, indicating an initial post-transcriptional or functional mechanism of regulation, although Ndel1 mRNA expression was also significantly reduced by P7. Although both ZIKV strains induced robust inflammatory gene expression, only ZIKV BR infection resulted in decreased Ndel1 activity, dissociating neuroinflammatory signaling from enzymatic modulation. Importantly, this strain-specific reduction parallels the unique capacity of ZIKV BR to induce microcephaly and supports Ndel1 dysfunction as an early molecular event associated with neurodevelopmental impairment. Together, these findings identify a virus- and strain-specific regulation of a key neuronal enzyme and provide mechanistic insight into the molecular basis of ZIKV BR -associated neurodevelopmental outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether the reduction in Ndel1 enzymatic activity during Zika virus (ZIKV) infection is a conserved host response or a strain-specific effect. Using a neonatal mouse model, researchers compared the effects of a Brazilian ZIKV strain (ZIKV BR), an African lineage strain (ZIKV AF), and dengue virus (DENV) on Ndel1 regulation. Ndel1 enzymatic activity was significantly reduced only in ZIKV BR-infected animals at early post-infection time points (P3 and P7), with no changes observed for ZIKV AF or DENV. Both ZIKV strains induced neuroinflammation, but only ZIKV BR altered Ndel1 activity, dissociating inflammation from enzymatic modulation. These findings suggest a strain-specific regulation of Ndel1 that may contribute to ZIKV BR-associated neurodevelopmental impairment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 早期发育过程中的寨卡病毒(ZIKV)感染与严重的神经发育障碍有关,但病毒暴露与神经元功能障碍之间的分子机制仍不完全清楚。该研究旨在确定 ZIKV 感染期间观察到的 Ndel1 酶活性降低是否代表保守的 宿主 反应或毒株特异性分子效应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用瑞士小鼠出生后第 0 天的新生儿脑室内感染模型,比较巴西 ZIKV 毒株 (ZIKV BR)、非洲谱系毒株 (ZIKV AF) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 对大脑中 Ndel1 调节的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用新生小鼠模型比较了 ZIKV BR、ZIKV AF 和 DENV 对大脑中 Ndel1 调节的影响。在感染后早期时间点(P3 和 P7)测量 Ndel1 酶活性和 mRNA 表达。还评估了炎症基因表达,以将神经炎症信号传导与酶调节分离。
elements_zh.main_results: 仅在 ZIKV BR 感染动物中,Ndel1 酶活性在感染后早期时间点(P3 和 P7)显着降低,而 ZIKV AF 和 DENV 相对于对照动物并未改变酶活性。在 P3 时,这种减少在 Ndel1 mRNA 表达没有变化的情况下发生,尽管 mRNA 水平在 P7 时显着降低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 仅在 ZIKV BR 中观察到 Ndel1 酶活性的菌株特异性降低表明关键神经元酶存在病毒和菌株特异性调节。这一发现为 ZIKV BR 相关神经发育结果的分子基础提供了机制见解,并将神经炎症与酶调节分开。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果将 Ndel1 功能障碍确定为可能导致 ZIKV BR 相关神经发育障碍的早期分子事件,突出了未来机制和治疗研究的特定目标。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖新生小鼠模型而受到限制,该模型可能无法完全重现人类神经发育过程。由于缺乏人类数据并且关注感染后早期时间点,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 早期发育过程中的寨卡病毒(ZIKV)感染与严重的神经发育障碍有关,包括先天性小头畸形,但将病毒暴露与神经元功能障碍联系起来的分子机制仍不完全清楚。Ndel1(nudE 神经发育蛋白 1 like 1)是一种寡肽酶,与神经元迁移、神经突生长和细胞骨架动力学以及正常大脑发育所必需的过程密切相关。基于先前观察到 Ndel1 酶活性在 ZIKV 感染的胚胎和新生儿大脑中降低,我们研究了这种调节是否代表保守的 宿主 反应或毒株特异性分子效应。使用瑞士小鼠出生后第 0 天的新生儿脑室内感染模型,我们比较了巴西 ZIKV 毒株 (ZIKV BR )、非洲谱系毒株 (ZIKV AF ) 和 登革病毒 (DENV) 对大脑中 Ndel1 调节的影响。我们发现,仅在 ZIKV BR 感染的动物中,Ndel1 酶活性在感染后早期时间点(P3 和 P7)显着降低,而相对于对照组,ZIKV AF 和 DENV 并未改变酶活性。值得注意的是,在最早的时间点 (P3),这种减少发生在 Ndel1 mRNA 表达没有变化的情况下,表明最初的转录后或功能调节机制,尽管 P7 时 Ndel1 mRNA 表达也显着减少。尽管两种 ZIKV 毒株均诱导了强烈的炎症基因表达,但只有 ZIKV BR 感染导致 Ndel1 活性降低,从而将神经炎症信号传导与酶促调节分离。重要的是,这种菌株特异性的减少与 ZIKV BR 诱导小头畸形的独特能力相似,并支持 Ndel1 功能障碍作为与神经发育障碍相关的早期分子事件。总之,这些发现确定了关键神经元酶的病毒和毒株特异性调节,并为 ZIKV BR 相关神经发育结果的分子基础提供了机制见解。

papers.title: A dengue sob uma perspectiva epidemiológica e sociodemográfica: uma análise sobre o estado de Minas Gerais
papers.abstract: O contexto epidemiológico da dengue no Brasil caracteriza-se por oscilações entre períodos endêmicos e surtos epidêmicos, representando um desafio contínuo à saúde pública. Este estudo tem como objetivo geral analisar o perfil epidemiológico e sociodemográfico da dengue no estado de Minas Gerais, com ênfase no município de Uberlândia, a partir de evidências da literatura científica recente. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de caráter descritivo e exploratório, realizada em bases de dados nacionais e internacionais. Os resultados indicam elevada incidência da doença em determinados períodos do ano, forte associação com fatores socioambientais, desigualdades regionais e impacto significativo sobre o Sistema Único de Saúde. Conclui-se que a dengue permanece como um importante problema de saúde pública em Minas Gerais, exigindo estratégias integradas de vigilância epidemiológica, controle vetorial e ações intersetoriais.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了巴西登革热面临的持续挑战,其特点是流行期和流行病 暴发 之间的振荡,旨在分析米纳斯吉拉斯州登革热的流行病学和社会人口学概况,重点是乌贝兰迪亚。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项描述性和探索性的书目研究,使用国家和国际数据库进行,以分析米纳斯吉拉斯州登革热的流行病学和社会人口学概况,重点关注乌贝兰迪亚。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用描述性和探索性的文献研究方法,利用国家和国际数据库收集和分析有关登革热的最新科学证据。
analysis_zh.main_results: 结果表明,在一年中的某些时段,登革热的 发病率 较高,与社会环境因素、区域不平等密切相关,并对统一卫生系统产生重大影响。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,登革热仍然是米纳斯吉拉斯州的一个重大公共卫生问题,需要采取流行病学 监测、媒介 控制和跨部门行动的综合策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要采取综合的 监测 和控制策略,强调解决社会环境因素和区域不平等以减轻登革热对卫生系统影响的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对书目研究的依赖而受到限制,书目研究可能无法捕获所有当前或本地数据;然而,最近科学证据的使用为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.title: Liver Organoids: From Disease Modelling to Regenerative Medicine
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Liver organoids are three‐dimensional miniature liver models that recapitulate the complex architecture and key functions of the human liver in vitro, offering powerful platforms for both fundamental research and translational applications. This review systematically summarises current fabrication strategies, disease‐modelling utilities and regenerative potentials of liver organoids, alongside the major challenges and future directions. In recent years, the field has witnessed several breakthroughs. Through endothelial co‐culture approaches, vascularised and metabolically zonated liver organoids have been successfully generated, achieving endothelial coverage exceeding 85%. Prime editing enables precise correction of pathogenic mutations in patient‐derived organoids, with no off‐target effects detected at the genome‐wide level. In disease modelling, iPSC‐derived liver organoids faithfully recapitulate the pathological progression of metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and verify the lipid‐lowering efficacy of semaglutide. Macrophage‐integrated organoid models support the full life cycles of HEV, SARS‐CoV‐2 and dengue virus, providing new tools for antiviral drug screening. Large‐scale patient‐derived tumour organoid biobanks successfully preserve the heterogeneity and clinical drug‐resistance signatures of liver cancers. In regenerative medicine, encapsulated hepatocyte organoids and the UTOpiA bioartificial liver system have effectively rescued acute liver failure in animal models, while gene‐edited autologous organoids offer potential curative strategies for genetic disorders such as Wilson disease. Nevertheless, insufficient hepatocyte functional maturity, difficulties in constructing vascular networks, and the lack of standardised culture protocols remain major obstacles to clinical translation. By bridging fundamental liver biology and clinical practice, liver organoid technology lays a solid foundation for precision hepatology and regenerative therapies. Continued interdisciplinary efforts are still required to overcome current limitations and facilitate its clinical adoption.

analysis.scope_and_question: The scope examines liver organoids as in vitro models for human liver biology and translational applications, with a central question on their utility in disease modelling and regenerative medicine. The topic boundary excludes non-liver systems and non-organoid platforms.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis summarising fabrication strategies, disease-modelling utilities, and regenerative potentials of liver organoids. It reports breakthroughs such as endothelial co-culture achieving >85% endothelial coverage and prime editing with no off-target effects, but does not provide databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or included-study counts.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Major areas of agreement include the successful generation of vascularised and metabolically zonated liver organoids through endothelial co-culture, precise correction of pathogenic mutations in patient-derived organoids using prime editing, and the recapitulation of MASLD pathology with verification of semaglutide efficacy in iPSC-derived liver organoids.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Key unresolved challenges include insufficient hepatocyte functional maturity, difficulties in constructing vascular networks, and the lack of standardised culture protocols, which hinder clinical translation. Additionally, while macrophage-integrated organoid models support the full life cycles of certain viruses, their relevance to dengue virus remains unaddressed.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Specific priorities include advancing hepatocyte functional maturity, standardising culture protocols, and developing vascularised organoid systems for clinical applications. The review also highlights the need for interdisciplinary efforts to overcome current limitations and facilitate clinical adoption of liver organoid technology.

analysis.summary_en: Liver organoids are three-dimensional in vitro models that replicate human liver architecture and functions, serving as platforms for disease modelling and regenerative medicine. papers.title_zh: 肝脏类器官:从疾病建模到再生医学
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Liver organoids are three‐dimensional miniature liver models that recapitulate the complex architecture and key functions of the human liver in vitro, offering powerful platforms for both fundamental research and translational applications. This review systematically summarises current fabrication strategies, disease‐modelling utilities and regenerative potentials of liver organoids, alongside the major challenges and future directions. In recent years, the field has witnessed several breakthroughs. Through endothelial co‐culture approaches, vascularised and metabolically zonated liver organoids have been successfully generated, achieving endothelial coverage exceeding 85%. Prime editing enables precise correction of pathogenic mutations in patient‐derived organoids, with no off‐target effects detected at the genome‐wide level. In disease modelling, iPSC‐derived liver organoids faithfully recapitulate the pathological progression of metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and verify the lipid‐lowering efficacy of semaglutide. Macrophage‐integrated organoid models support the full life cycles of HEV, SARS‐CoV‐2 and dengue virus, providing new tools for antiviral drug screening. Large‐scale patient‐derived tumour organoid biobanks successfully preserve the heterogeneity and clinical drug‐resistance signatures of liver cancers. In regenerative medicine, encapsulated hepatocyte organoids and the UTOpiA bioartificial liver system have effectively rescued acute liver failure in animal models, while gene‐edited autologous organoids offer potential curative strategies for genetic disorders such as Wilson disease. Nevertheless, insufficient hepatocyte functional maturity, difficulties in constructing vascular networks, and the lack of standardised culture protocols remain major obstacles to clinical translation. By bridging fundamental liver biology and clinical practice, liver organoid technology lays a solid foundation for precision hepatology and regenerative therapies. Continued interdisciplinary efforts are still required to overcome current limitations and facilitate its clinical adoption.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 肝脏类器官是三维微型肝脏模型,在体外概括了人类肝脏的复杂结构和关键功能,为基础研究和转化应用提供了强大的平台。这篇综述系统地总结了肝脏类器官当前的制造策略、疾病建模实用性和再生潜力,以及主要挑战和未来方向。近年来,该领域取得了多项突破。通过内皮共培养方法,已成功生成血管化和代谢分区的肝脏类器官,内皮覆盖率超过 85%。Prime 编辑能够精确校正患者来源的类器官中的致病性 突变,并且在 基因组 范围内未检测到脱靶效应。在疾病建模中,iPSC 衍生的肝脏类器官忠实地再现了代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病 (MASLD) 的病理进展,并验证了索马鲁肽的降脂功效。巨噬细胞整合类器官模型支持 HEV、SARS-CoV-2 和 登革病毒 的整个生命周期,为 抗病毒药物 药物筛选提供新工具。大规模患者来源的肿瘤类器官生物库成功保留了肝癌的异质性和临床耐药特征。在再生医学中,封装的肝细胞类器官和 UTOpiA 生物人工肝系统已有效挽救动物模型中的急性肝功能衰竭,而基因编辑的自体类器官则为威尔逊病等遗传性疾病提供了潜在的治疗策略。然而,肝细胞功能成熟度不足、血管网络构建困难以及缺乏标准化培养方案仍然是临床转化的主要障碍。通过连接基础肝脏生物学和临床实践,肝脏类器官技术为精准肝病学和再生治疗奠定了坚实的基础。仍需要持续的跨学科努力来克服当前的局限性并促进其临床采用。

papers.title: A network-driven antiviral discovery pipeline for emerging RNA viruses: a critical perspective from the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA).
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: RNA viruses impose a disproportionate burden of emerging and reemerging infectious diseases in Latin America, yet antiviral discovery in the region remains fragmented, target-limited, and frequently disconnected from translational pathways. This perspective discusses the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA) as a network-driven model to organize antiviral discovery against clinically relevant RNA viruses. AREAS COVERED: The authors describe the conceptual architecture of RMDA, a multi-institutional Mexican initiative that integrates computational prioritization, cell-based antiviral evaluation under BSL-2/BSL-3 conditions, mechanistic virology, assessment of pharmacological synergy, in vivo validation, and clinical linkage through healthcare systems such as the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social. The framework is supported by prior work from participating groups on host-directed and virus-directed candidates, including metabolic modulators, lipid-lowering agents, nuclear transport inhibitors, natural products, polyphenols, melatonin, and rational drug combinations evaluated against dengue virus, Zika virus, SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, and related RNA viruses. EXPERT OPINION: RMDA provides a scalable and regionally adaptable model for antiviral drug discovery in low- and middle-income settings. By aligning distributed expertise, standardized workflows, and translational decision points, this framework may accelerate candidate prioritization, reduce duplication, and strengthen preparedness against RNA virus threats in Mexico and Latin America.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:RNA 病毒对拉丁美洲新出现和重新出现的传染病造成了不成比例的负担,但该地区的 抗病毒药物 发现仍然支离破碎、目标有限,并且经常与转化途径脱节。本视角讨论了 Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de 抗病毒药物 (RMDA) 作为网络驱动模型来组织针对临床相关 RNA 病毒的 抗病毒药物 发现。涵盖领域:作者描述了 RMDA 的概念架构,这是一项墨西哥多机构倡议,整合了计算优先级、BSL-2/BSL-3 条件下基于细胞的 抗病毒药物 评估、机械病毒学、药理学协同评估、体内验证以及通过医疗保健系统(例如 Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social)的临床联系。该框架得到了参与小组先前关于 宿主 导向和病毒导向候选药物的工作的支持,包括代谢调节剂、降脂剂、核转运抑制剂、天然产物、多酚、褪黑激素和针对 登革病毒、寨卡病毒、SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒和相关 RNA 病毒进行评估的合理药物组合。专家意见:RMDA 为中低收入环境中的 抗病毒药物 药物发现提供了一个可扩展且区域适应性强的模型。通过协调分布式专业知识、标准化工作流程和转化决策点,该框架可以加速候选者的优先级排序、减少重复并加强墨西哥和拉丁美洲针对 RNA 病毒威胁的准备。

papers.title: IFNL1 gene promoter single nucleotide polymorphism rs7247086 enhances transcription through a STAT-binding site.
papers.abstract: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) within the human interferon lambda 1 (IFN-L1, IFN-λ1) gene promoter, rs7247086 (C/T) has been reported to be associated with severe dengue and possibly with psoriasis and COVID-19. However, its functional nature is unknown. The present study was undertaken to examine the effect of rs7247086 on transcription, by utilizing promoter and enhancer-reporter assays. We see that the T allele completes a consensus signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT)-binding site. While we did not find strong evidence to show that the STAT-binding site drove transcription from the IFNL1 gene promoter, we saw that it acts like an enhancer in reporter assays. The T allele of rs7247086 within the STAT-binding site significantly increased transcription of the reporter gene compared to the C allele when incorporated into enhancer-reporter constructs in both HEK293 and A549 cell lines. Mechanistically, we obtained evidence from electrophoretic mobility shift assays to show that the T allele binds to STAT proteins more strongly than the C allele. In a cohort of healthy individuals, we saw that the T allele carriers, specifically males but not females, had significantly increased secretion of IFN-λ1 from their peripheral blood mononuclear cells after stimulation. Lastly, rs7247086 significantly associated with psoriasis, only in males but not in females.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed why the IFNL1 gene promoter SNP rs7247086 (C/T) might influence disease severity in dengue and other conditions, despite its functional role being unknown.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used promoter and enhancer-reporter assays in HEK293 and A549 cell lines to examine the effect of rs7247086 on transcription, alongside electrophoretic mobility shift assays to assess STAT protein binding.
analysis.methods: Promoter and enhancer-reporter constructs incorporating the T or C allele of rs7247086 were tested in HEK293 and A549 cells, and STAT protein binding was evaluated using electrophoretic mobility shift assays.
analysis.main_results: The T allele of rs7247086 significantly increased reporter gene transcription compared to the C allele in both HEK293 and A549 cells, and the T allele showed stronger binding to STAT proteins in electrophoretic mobility shift assays.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the T allele enhances IFNL1 transcription via a STAT-binding site, acting as an enhancer rather than a promoter, and note sex-specific differences in IFN-λ1 secretion and psoriasis association.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that rs7247086 may modulate IFN-λ1 expression, potentially influencing host responses relevant to dengue pathogenesis and other inflammatory conditions, particularly in males.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on in vitro assays and a small cohort, with sex-specific effects observed but not mechanistically explained, warranting cautious interpretation of the evidence strength as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the functional impact of the IFNL1 gene promoter SNP rs7247086 (C/T), previously associated with severe dengue, psoriasis, and COVID-19, but whose functional role was unknown. Using promoter and enhancer-reporter assays in HEK293 and A549 cells, the authors found that the T allele significantly increased reporter gene transcription compared to the C allele. Mechanistically, electrophoretic mobility shift assays showed stronger binding of the T allele to STAT proteins, indicating that the T allele enhances IFNL1 transcription via a STAT-binding site acting as an enhancer. In a small cohort of healthy individuals, male carriers of the T allele exhibited significantly increased IFN-λ1 secretion from peripheral blood mononuclear cells after stimulation, and rs7247086 was significantly associated with psoriasis in males but not females. While these findings suggest a sex-specific modulation of IFN-λ1 expression by rs7247086, the study is limited by its in vitro focus and small sample size, warranting cautious interpretation of the evidence strength.

papers.title_zh: IFNL1 基因启动子单核苷酸多态性 rs7247086 通过 STAT 结合位点增强转录。
papers.source_body_en: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) within the human interferon lambda 1 (IFN-L1, IFN-λ1) gene promoter, rs7247086 (C/T) has been reported to be associated with severe dengue and possibly with psoriasis and COVID-19. However, its functional nature is unknown. The present study was undertaken to examine the effect of rs7247086 on transcription, by utilizing promoter and enhancer-reporter assays. We see that the T allele completes a consensus signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT)-binding site. While we did not find strong evidence to show that the STAT-binding site drove transcription from the IFNL1 gene promoter, we saw that it acts like an enhancer in reporter assays. The T allele of rs7247086 within the STAT-binding site significantly increased transcription of the reporter gene compared to the C allele when incorporated into enhancer-reporter constructs in both HEK293 and A549 cell lines. Mechanistically, we obtained evidence from electrophoretic mobility shift assays to show that the T allele binds to STAT proteins more strongly than the C allele. In a cohort of healthy individuals, we saw that the T allele carriers, specifically males but not females, had significantly increased secretion of IFN-λ1 from their peripheral blood mononuclear cells after stimulation. Lastly, rs7247086 significantly associated with psoriasis, only in males but not in females.

papers.title: Efficacy of an attractive lethal ovitrap to reduce populations of Aedes mosquitoes: a controlled trial in Iquitos, Peru
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue, one of the most important arboviral infections worldwide, is transmitted primarily by the mosquito Aedes aegypti , a vector closely associated with human habitations. Because vector control is the primary prevention strategy for this disease novel tools are urgently needed. We evaluated an Attractive Lethal OviTrap (ALOT) that targets epidemiologically relevant gravid female mosquitoes for public health impact against dengue disease. Methods We conducted a proof-of-concept field efficacy trial in the Amazonian city of Iquitos, Peru, to quantify the reduction of vector density, parity, and sex ratio and symptomatic human dengue infection over a 3.5 year follow-up period. After three baseline entomological surveys in core (753 houses), and buffer (1,549 houses) areas where traps were placed in and around homes, and a control (1,233 houses) area without traps, entomological surveys were carried out every 2 months, and household residents were monitored for dengue disease 3 times a week. Trap maintenance was conducted at 2-3 week intervals by study staff during the first 2.5 years and by residents in the final year. Results Total and female Ae. aegypti abundance demonstrated a strong initial effect with 52% and 47% fewer mosquitoes after trap placement, respectively (Total: RR = 0.48, 95% CI: 0.40 – 0.58, p < 0.001; Females: RR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.43 – 0.66, p < 0.001). The effect diminished significantly, however, over the study period (interaction coefficient = 0.035 per month, p < 0.001; interaction coefficient = 0.030 per month, p < 0.001). Female-to-male ratio decreased after trap deployment and impact on non- Aedes abundance was like that of Aedes . Cumulative symptomatic dengue incidence was 1.40% (95% CI: 1.00%-1.70%) in the ALOT area versus 3.20% (95% CI: 2.60%-3.80%) in the control area, a 56% relative reduction (log-rank χ2=30.0, p<0.001). Restricted mean survival time analysis showed participants in the intervention area on average remained dengue-free for 15.5 additional days (95% CI: 11.1-20.0, p<0.001). Conclusions The ALOT strategy functioned as predicted, decreasing but not eliminating female vector densities, with a clear public health impact, lowering dengue disease in areas where traps were deployed. Our study also illustrates the challenges associated with conducting large-scale vector control trials and the need to consider programmatic implementation early in the process of bringing a new product to market. Author Summary Dengue is one of the most important mosquito transmitted infections worldwide. Aedes aegypti, the most important species involved, has a unique biology living in containers associated with households. New methods to control this mosquito are needed and we present our evaluation of a novel trap called the Attractive Lethal OviTrap (ALOT) that targets older female mosquitoes that are the most important for dengue disease transmission. We conducted a trial in the Amazonian city of Iquitos, Peru, to measure reductions in mosquito numbers, age, and sex ratio and symptomatic human dengue infections over a 3.5 years. After baseline entomological surveys prior to placing ALOT traps in homes in a treatment area, which included a central core area with 753 houses and a protective buffer area with 1,549 houses areas. We also had a control area without any traps in 1,233 houses. Mosquito surveys were carried out every 2 months, and household residents were monitored for dengue disease 3 times per week. The number of all Ae. aegypti were initially reduced by 52% after trap placement whereas females were reduced by 47%. The effect diminished significantly, however, over the study period. Female-to-male ratio decreased after trap deployment and impact on other mosquito species was like that of Aedes . Dengue incidence was 56% less in the area with traps compared to the control area, estimating that participants in the intervention area on average remained dengue-free for 15.5 additional days. The ALOT strategy functioned as predicted, decreasing but not eliminating female mosquitos and had a clear public health impact, lowering dengue disease in areas where traps were deployed.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Dengue, one of the most important arboviral infections worldwide, is transmitted primarily by the mosquito Aedes aegypti , a vector closely associated with human habitations. Because vector control is the primary prevention strategy for this disease novel tools are urgently needed. We evaluated an Attractive Lethal OviTrap (ALOT) that targets epidemiologically relevant gravid female mosquitoes for public health impact against dengue disease. Methods We conducted a proof-of-concept field efficacy trial in the Amazonian city of Iquitos, Peru, to quantify the reduction of vector density, parity, and sex ratio and symptomatic human dengue infection over a 3.5 year follow-up period. After three baseline entomological surveys in core (753 houses), and buffer (1,549 houses) areas where traps were placed in and around homes, and a control (1,233 houses) area without traps, entomological surveys were carried out every 2 months, and household residents were monitored for dengue disease 3 times a week. Trap maintenance was conducted at 2-3 week intervals by study staff during the first 2.5 years and by residents in the final year. Results Total and female Ae. aegypti abundance demonstrated a strong initial effect with 52% and 47% fewer mosquitoes after trap placement, respectively (Total: RR = 0.48, 95% CI: 0.40 – 0.58, p < 0.001; Females: RR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.43 – 0.66, p < 0.001). The effect diminished significantly, however, over the study period (interaction coefficient = 0.035 per month, p < 0.001; interaction coefficient = 0.030 per month, p < 0.001). Female-to-male ratio decreased after trap deployment and impact on non- Aedes abundance was like that of Aedes . Cumulative symptomatic dengue incidence was 1.40% (95% CI: 1.00%-1.70%) in the ALOT area versus 3.20% (95% CI: 2.60%-3.80%) in the control area, a 56% relative reduction (log-rank χ2=30.0, p<0.001). Restricted mean survival time analysis showed participants in the intervention area on average remained dengue-free for 15.5 additional days (95% CI: 11.1-20.0, p<0.001). Conclusions The ALOT strategy functioned as predicted, decreasing but not eliminating female vector densities, with a clear public health impact, lowering dengue disease in areas where traps were deployed. Our study also illustrates the challenges associated with conducting large-scale vector control trials and the need to consider programmatic implementation early in the process of bringing a new product to market. Aedes aegypti, the most important species involved, has a unique biology living in containers associated with households. New methods to control this mosquito are needed and we present our evaluation of a novel trap called the Attractive Lethal OviTrap (ALOT) that targets older female mosquitoes that are the most important for dengue disease transmission. papers.title: Evaluation of MTego and BG-Sentinel traps for malaria and arbovirus vector surveillance in Cabo Verde.
papers.abstract: Arboviral outbreaks are rising across Africa, a region that continues to face a substantial malaria burden. Cabo Verde remains vulnerable to the emergence and re-emergence of mosquito-borne diseases, including dengue, Zika, and malaria. In January 2024, the World Health Organization certified the country as malaria-free; however, the risk of reintroduction persists. Maintaining malaria-free status requires continuous robust epidemiological and entomological surveillance to prevent local transmission. Innovative vector monitoring and control tools that deliver accurate infestation data are essential in this context. We evaluated the performance of the MTego trap against the BGS traps routinely used in Cabo Verde applying a 4x4 Latin square design with four configurations: 1) BGS with BG Lure; 2) BGS with BG Lure plus CO2; 3) MTego traps with Clay Balls plus PM6 odour bait; and 4) MTego traps with Clay Balls, PM6 bait plus CO2. Sampling was conducted in Praia, before and after the 2023 rainy season. Trap effectiveness was assessed using negative binomial regression models. Across all configurations, 2,673 mosquitoes were collected. Mean nightly catches were highest for BGS traps baited with CO2: 20.4 (95% CI: 15.4-25.4), and lowest for MTego traps: 13.7 (95% CI: 10.0-17.5). Comparative analysis showed that MTego traps outperformed BGS traps in capturing Anopheles arabiensis, with CO2-supplemented MTego trap being the most effective configuration. BGS traps performed best for Aedes aegypti and Culex pipiens sensu lato. Species-specific behavioural patterns were observed, with higher nigh-time catches of Cx pipiens s.l. arabiensis, alongside differences in gonotrophic state. This study highlights the superior performance of MTego traps for malaria surveillance in Cabo Verde.

papers.title_zh: 对佛得角疟疾和虫媒病毒 媒介 监测 的 MTego 和 BG-Sentinel 陷阱进行评估。
papers.source_body_en: Arboviral outbreaks are rising across Africa, a region that continues to face a substantial malaria burden. Cabo Verde remains vulnerable to the emergence and re-emergence of mosquito-borne diseases, including dengue, Zika, and malaria. In January 2024, the World Health Organization certified the country as malaria-free; however, the risk of reintroduction persists. Maintaining malaria-free status requires continuous robust epidemiological and entomological surveillance to prevent local transmission. Innovative vector monitoring and control tools that deliver accurate infestation data are essential in this context. We evaluated the performance of the MTego trap against the BGS traps routinely used in Cabo Verde applying a 4x4 Latin square design with four configurations: 1) BGS with BG Lure; 2) BGS with BG Lure plus CO2; 3) MTego traps with Clay Balls plus PM6 odour bait; and 4) MTego traps with Clay Balls, PM6 bait plus CO2. Sampling was conducted in Praia, before and after the 2023 rainy season. Trap effectiveness was assessed using negative binomial regression models. Across all configurations, 2,673 mosquitoes were collected. Mean nightly catches were highest for BGS traps baited with CO2: 20.4 (95% CI: 15.4-25.4), and lowest for MTego traps: 13.7 (95% CI: 10.0-17.5). Comparative analysis showed that MTego traps outperformed BGS traps in capturing Anopheles arabiensis, with CO2-supplemented MTego trap being the most effective configuration. BGS traps performed best for Aedes aegypti and Culex pipiens sensu lato. Species-specific behavioural patterns were observed, with higher nigh-time catches of Cx pipiens s.l. arabiensis, alongside differences in gonotrophic state. This study highlights the superior performance of MTego traps for malaria surveillance in Cabo Verde.

papers.title: Insecticide susceptibility and knockdown resistance (Kdr) mutations (F1534C and V1016I) in Aedes aegypti populations from Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue, Zika and chikungunya are Aedes -borne arboviruses that pose a major global public health threat. In the absence of effective treatments or universally available vaccines, disease control in sub-Saharan Africa relies primarily on insecticidal vector control. However, sustained insecticide application imposes selection pressure for insecticide resistance that compromises intervention effectiveness. This study assessed the insecticide resistance profile of Aedes aegypti populations in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Methods Phenotypic resistance of Ae. aegypti was evaluated using WHO-recommended adulticide and larvicide susceptibility bioassays at 1x discriminating concentrations. F 1 progeny derived from wild Ae. aegypti larvae were used for the tests. In adulticide bioassays, groups of 25 female Ae. aegypti were exposed for 1 h to insecticide-treated WHO susceptibility test papers. Larvicide bioassays exposed 25 third- and fourth-instar larvae to a larvicide based on Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis ( Bti ) or temephos for 24 h in 200 ml of water. Mosquito mortality was recorded 24 h post-exposure. Genotypic resistance was assessed using DNA extracted from phenotyped mosquitoes. The extracted DNA was screened for knockdown resistance ( Kdr ) mutations using diagnostic quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) assays. Results Aedes aegypti populations from Ilala and Temeke districts of Dar es Salaam demonstrated phenotypic resistance to pyrethroids, and organochlorine, with adult mortality rates below 20% and 5%, respectively, while remaining susceptible to organophosphates and carbamates. In Kinondoni, resistance was observed across all classes except carbamates, and pre-exposure to piperonlyl butoxide (PBO) increased pyrethroids mortality to an average of 40%. The LD 50 and LD 90 values for Bti and temephos showed resistance ratios (RR) below 5. The F1534C mutation was detected across all study districts; Ilala (77%, n = 77), Kinondoni (90%, n = 90) and Temeke (83%, n = 83), while low frequencies were observed for V1016I mutation. Conclusion Aedes aegypti populations from Dar es Salaam show widespread resistance to pyrethroids, and organochlorines. There was evidence of metabolic involvement suggested by partial restoration of susceptibility to pyrethroids through pre-exposure to PBO. A two-fold increase in LD90 relative to the susceptible reference strain for Bti and temephos indicates no evidence of resistance, although continued monitoring is warranted to detect potential shifts in susceptibility.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti populations from Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, using WHO bioassays and qPCR for Kdr mutations. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热是伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的全球公共卫生构成重大威胁,该地区的疾病控制主要依靠杀虫剂 媒介 控制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用野生伊蚊的 F1 后代评估了坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆埃及伊蚊种群的杀虫剂抗药性。埃及幼虫用于表型和基因型抗性测试。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 WHO 推荐的杀成虫剂和杀幼虫剂敏感性生物测定法以 1 倍区分浓度评估表型抗性,并在暴露后 24 小时记录蚊子 死亡率。通过使用诊断性 qPCR 检测筛选表型蚊子的 DNA 进行击倒抗性 (Kdr) 突变 来评估基因型抗性。
elements_zh.main_results: 来自伊拉拉和特梅克地区的埃及伊蚊种群表现出对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯的表型抗性,成虫 死亡率 分别低于 20% 和 5%,同时仍然对有机磷酸酯和氨基甲酸酯敏感。在 Kinondoni,除氨基甲酸酯外,所有类别均观察到耐药性,并且预先接触胡椒基丁醚可使拟除虫菊酯 死亡率 平均增加 40%。F1534C 突变 在 Ilala (77%)、Kinondoni (90%) 和 Temeke (83%) 中检测到,而 V1016I 突变 频率较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究解释了达累斯萨拉姆地区对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯的广泛耐药性。埃及伊蚊种群,PBO 预暴露后拟除虫菊酯敏感性部分恢复表明代谢参与的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了达累斯萨拉姆需要采取综合的 媒介 管理策略,包括监测抗药性趋势和评估替代杀虫剂以维持 媒介 控制有效性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于达累斯萨拉姆三个地区的表型和基因型评估,没有关于 Kdr 监测 或更广泛的生态因素之外的耐药机制的数据,需要谨慎解释和继续 监测。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热是伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。在缺乏有效的 治疗 或普遍可用的 疫苗 的情况下,撒哈拉以南非洲地区的疾病控制主要依赖于杀虫剂 媒介 控制。然而,持续使用杀虫剂会给杀虫剂抗药性带来选择压力,从而损害干预效果。本研究评估了坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆埃及伊蚊种群的杀虫剂抗药性。方法 伊蚊表型抗性。使用 WHO 推荐的杀成虫剂和杀幼虫剂敏感性生物测定法以 1 倍区分浓度对埃及伊蚊进行评估。F 1 后代源自野生伊蚊。埃及幼虫用于测试。在杀成虫生物测定中,每组 25 只雌性伊蚊。将埃及伊蚊暴露于经过杀虫剂处理的 WHO 药敏试纸上 1 小时。杀幼虫生物测定将 25 只第三龄和第四龄幼虫暴露于基于以色列苏云金芽孢杆菌 (Bti) 或天美磷的杀幼虫剂(溶于 200 毫升水中)24 小时。暴露后 24 小时记录蚊子 死亡率。使用从表型蚊子中提取的 DNA 评估基因型抗性。使用诊断定量聚合酶链式反应 (qPCR) 分析筛选提取的 DNA 的敲低抗性 (Kdr) 突变。结果 达累斯萨拉姆 Ilala 和 Temeke 区的埃及伊蚊种群表现出对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯的表型抗性,成虫 死亡率 率分别低于 20% 和 5%,同时仍然对有机磷酸酯和氨基甲酸酯敏感。在 Kinondoni,除氨基甲酸酯外,所有类别均观察到耐药性,并且预先暴露于胡椒基丁醚 (PBO) 会使拟除虫菊酯 死亡率 平均增加 40%。Bti 和替美磷的 LD 50 和 LD 90 值显示耐药比 (RR) 低于 5。在所有研究区均检测到 F1534C 突变;Ilala (77%,n = 77)、Kinondoni (90%,n = 90) 和 Temeke (83%,n = 83),而 V1016I 突变 则观察到低频。结论 达累斯萨拉姆的埃及伊蚊种群对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯表现出广泛的抗性。通过预先暴露于 PBO,对拟除虫菊酯的敏感性部分恢复,表明代谢参与的证据。LD90 相对于 Bti 和 temephos 敏感参考菌株增加两倍,表明没有证据表明存在耐药性,尽管需要继续监测以检测敏感性的潜在变化。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热是伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的全球公共卫生构成重大威胁,该地区的疾病控制主要依靠杀虫剂 媒介 控制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用野生伊蚊的 F1 后代评估了坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆埃及伊蚊种群的杀虫剂抗药性。埃及幼虫用于表型和基因型抗性测试。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 WHO 推荐的杀成虫剂和杀幼虫剂敏感性生物测定法以 1 倍区分浓度评估表型抗性,并在暴露后 24 小时记录蚊子 死亡率。通过使用诊断性 qPCR 检测筛选表型蚊子的 DNA 进行击倒抗性 (Kdr) 突变 来评估基因型抗性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 来自伊拉拉和特梅克地区的埃及伊蚊种群表现出对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯的表型抗性,成虫 死亡率 分别低于 20% 和 5%,同时仍然对有机磷酸酯和氨基甲酸酯敏感。在 Kinondoni,除氨基甲酸酯外,所有类别均观察到耐药性,并且预先接触胡椒基丁醚可使拟除虫菊酯 死亡率 平均增加 40%。F1534C 突变 在 Ilala (77%)、Kinondoni (90%) 和 Temeke (83%) 中检测到,而 V1016I 突变 频率较低。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究解释了达累斯萨拉姆地区对拟除虫菊酯和有机氯的广泛耐药性。埃及伊蚊种群,PBO 预暴露后拟除虫菊酯敏感性部分恢复表明代谢参与的证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了达累斯萨拉姆需要采取综合的 媒介 管理策略,包括监测抗药性趋势和评估替代杀虫剂以维持 媒介 控制有效性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于达累斯萨拉姆三个地区的表型和基因型评估,没有关于 Kdr 监测 或更广泛的生态因素之外的耐药机制的数据,需要谨慎解释和继续 监测。

papers.title: Temporal Rewiring of Innate Immunity by Vector-Borne Viruses for Host-Directed Antiviral Therapy
papers.abstract: The geographic range and outbreak intensity of vector-borne viral infections are increasing as climate, land use, urbanization, and human mobility reshape vector ecology and human exposure. Despite their growing importance to public health, effective antiviral and preventive options remain limited for many emerging and reemerging vector-borne viruses due to viral genetic diversity, rapid evolutionary capacity, sporadic outbreak patterns, and economic constraints. While these viruses differ in taxonomy, genome organization, vector specificity, tissue tropism, and clinical manifestations, they exploit a shared vulnerability in host antiviral defense, particularly the timing of innate antiviral immunity to support viral replication, immune evasion, inflammatory dysregulation, and disease progression. Rather than simply suppressing antiviral defense, vector-borne viruses can delay early viral nucleic acid sensing, attenuate interferon induction or responsiveness, and extend the initial phase for viral replication. As viral burden increases and infected tissues undergo stress or damage, delayed immune activation can shift toward excessive inflammatory amplification, contributing to disease-specific pathology. In this study, we examine this temporal rewiring of innate antiviral immunity in representative vector-borne viruses such as dengue virus, chikungunya virus, and severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus and propose that understanding these conserved host dependencies may lead to broader, stage-specific, adaptable antiviral strategies that complement conventional virus-directed approaches.

papers.title_zh: 媒介 传播病毒对先天免疫的时间重新布线,用于 宿主 导向的 抗病毒药物 治疗
papers.source_body_en: The geographic range and outbreak intensity of vector-borne viral infections are increasing as climate, land use, urbanization, and human mobility reshape vector ecology and human exposure. Despite their growing importance to public health, effective antiviral and preventive options remain limited for many emerging and reemerging vector-borne viruses due to viral genetic diversity, rapid evolutionary capacity, sporadic outbreak patterns, and economic constraints. While these viruses differ in taxonomy, genome organization, vector specificity, tissue tropism, and clinical manifestations, they exploit a shared vulnerability in host antiviral defense, particularly the timing of innate antiviral immunity to support viral replication, immune evasion, inflammatory dysregulation, and disease progression. Rather than simply suppressing antiviral defense, vector-borne viruses can delay early viral nucleic acid sensing, attenuate interferon induction or responsiveness, and extend the initial phase for viral replication. As viral burden increases and infected tissues undergo stress or damage, delayed immune activation can shift toward excessive inflammatory amplification, contributing to disease-specific pathology. In this study, we examine this temporal rewiring of innate antiviral immunity in representative vector-borne viruses such as dengue virus, chikungunya virus, and severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus and propose that understanding these conserved host dependencies may lead to broader, stage-specific, adaptable antiviral strategies that complement conventional virus-directed approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着气候、土地利用、城市化和人类流动重塑 媒介 生态和人类暴露,媒介 传播的病毒感染的地理范围和 媒介 强度正在增加。尽管它们对公共卫生越来越重要,但由于病毒遗传多样性、快速进化能力、零星的 暴发 模式和经济限制,对于许多新出现和重新出现的 媒介 传播病毒来说,有效的 抗病毒药物 和预防方案仍然有限。虽然这些病毒在分类、基因组 组织、媒介 特异性、组织向性和临床表现方面有所不同,但它们利用了 宿主 抗病毒药物 防御中的共同弱点,特别是先天 抗病毒药物 免疫的时机,以支持病毒复制、免疫逃避、炎症失调和疾病进展。媒介携带的病毒不是简单地抑制抗病毒药物防御,而是可以延迟早期病毒核酸感应,减弱干扰素诱导或反应性,并延长病毒复制的初始阶段。随着病毒负荷的增加和受感染的组织承受压力或损伤,延迟的免疫激活可能会导致过度的炎症放大,从而导致疾病特异性病理。在本研究中,我们研究了代表性 媒介 传播病毒(例如 登革病毒、基孔肯雅病毒和严重发热伴血小板减少综合征病毒)中先天 抗病毒药物 免疫的时间重新布线,并提出了解这些保守的 宿主 依赖性可能会导致更广泛、阶段特异性、适应性强的 抗病毒药物 策略,以补充传统的病毒导向方法。
